title: Technical Product Manager AI Stockbroking App
description:
About KIRA 

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role 

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own 

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

Â 

What We're Looking For 

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Â 

Nice to have 

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Â 

Outcome 

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey 
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role 
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do 

- Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

- Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

- Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

- Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

- Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

- Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

- Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

- Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for 

- Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

- Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

- AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

- High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

- Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

- Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit 

- Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

- MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

- Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting 

- Competitive, top-of-market compensation

- You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

- Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

- Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

description:
About Delinea: 
Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. Leveraging AI-powered intelligence, Delineaâs leading cloud-native Identity Security Platform applies context throughout the entire identity lifecycle â across cloud and traditional infrastructure, data, SaaS applications, and AI. Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Our success is driven by world-class product leadership, outstanding engineers, and strategic investment from TPG. We value diversity, innovation, and a culture of respect and fairness. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.
Â 

Apply today to help us achieve our mission.

Delinea secures human, machine, and AI identities, eliminating standing privilege and reducing the attack surface across on-premises and cloud. As the platform expands into Non-Human Identity governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, and consumption-based licensing, we are hiring a dedicated leader to own how we package value and price capability across the whole portfolio. This is a horizontal L-1 role, peer to the General Managers of Workforce, Workload and AI, reporting to the Chief Product Officer. 

What You Will Own 

- Price and packaging architecture across the portfolio: tiering, licensing metrics, add-on structure, bundling. 

- Proposal quality into our monthly Price Committee: the analysis, the financial model, the recommendation, and the action register through to closure. 

- Discount governance, including band policy and the guardrails behind it. 

- Monetization for new categories: NHI governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, consumption-based licensing. 

- Commercial readiness at launch, so packaging and pricing ship with the product. 

- The single source of truth for pricing, packaging and quoting guidance, partnering with Product Marketing on seller enablement. 

- Price realization, attach rate and competitive position, informed by competitor pricing, market benchmarks and win/loss data. 

What We Are Looking For 

- 12+ years across pricing strategy, monetization, product management or product marketing, including 5+ years owning pricing as a named function. 

- A track record of building a monetization function where none existed: cadence, governance, documentation, analytical bench. 

- Experience preparing and defending recommendations to a formal pricing committee or equivalent decision body. 

- Demonstrated design of tiered packaging for enterprise software, and strong financial modeling (pricing impact, ARR and expansion, discount optimization). 

- Credibility with executive peers, holding a position on pricing under pressure without direct authority over sales or finance. 

Strongly preferred 

- Cybersecurity or identity security (PAM, IAM, SIEM, endpoint); exposure to NHI, machine identity or secrets management. 

- Consumption-, usage-, or outcome-based pricing models alongside seat-based subscription. 

- Working knowledge of CPQ (Salesforce CPQ, Apttus); pricing through M&A integration or a major commercial model transition. MBA a plus. 

Why Now 

Pricing at Delinea has been carried by people doing it well alongside a full portfolio, and the surface area keeps growing. The opportunity is to make monetization a professional discipline, with a decision forum that already works. If you want to own monetization end-to-end rather than manage an approval queue, this role is built for it. 

Why work at Delinea? 

- We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

- We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

- What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success: 

- Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

- Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

- Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

- Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

- Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

title: Senior Level Designer
description:
Blackbird Interactive is a creative-fueled, future-driven, independent game studio where the best talent in the industry can find long-term careers to help grow their abilities while working on a wide range of projects, which encompass world-class IPs as well as our own creations across multiple genres.

Our studio operates as a remote-first workplace, offering flexible work arrangements.

PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who are legally eligible to work in Canada and reside within Canada. 

Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game.

\n 

Responsibilities 

- 
Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars

- 
Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow

- 
Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat

- 
Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression

- 
Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine

- 
Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability

Requirements 

- 
A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

- 
Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

- 
Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

- 
Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

- 
Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

- 
Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities

Pluses 

- 
Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration

- 
Experience designing levels for an isometric or elevated gameplay camera, with an understanding of its impact on combat readability, navigation, and composition

- 
Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs

- 
Appreciation for systemic combat and how level geometry, enemy composition, hazards, and interactive elements combine to create varied encounters

- 
Experience designing dungeons, interconnected environments, procedural or modular level content, or other repeatable gameplay spaces

- 
Strong instincts for environmental storytelling, gameplay readability, polish, and identifying opportunities to improve the player experience through iteration

\n $115,000 - $149,500 a year

title: Senior Specialist Global QMS
description:
More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer. While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives. 

The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. This role will support and lead the internal audit program, supplier management program, and inspection readiness. This role will support the growth and expansion of the global quality program to support manufacturing of our cell therapy products. You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations. Your role will support Orca Bios commercial readiness and ongoing clinical programs by managing and facilitating audits, resolving supplier-related quality issues and interacting with quality management teams at the site levels to ensure consistent application of quality systems across the organization.

\n 

Responsibilities: 
- Plan, schedule and execute internal audits across all sites and functions in accordance with the internal audit program.

- Develop audit agenda, conduct interviews, review processes and generate audit reports.

- Support the global Quality Management Review (QMR) process, ensuring timely data collection, analysis, and reporting to senior leadership.

- Support the supplier qualification and management program, including risk assessments, supplier audits, and ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance with GxP requirements.

- Drive global inspection management activities, ensuring cross-functional and site readiness for FDA, EMA, and other health authority inspections.

- Provide oversight and guidance to site QMR administrators ensuring consistent quality system implementation across all Orca Bio sites.

- Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance.

- Partner with IT and business process owners to identify and implement QMS system enhancements, including defining requirements, driving prioritization and ensuring changes are validated and compliant.

- Review, approve, and provide quality oversight for validation documentation (e.g., equipment qualification, computer system validation, process validation) for global enterprise systems (e.g. MasterControl, ERP systems, Trackwise, etc.) ensuring alignment with regulatory and internal requirements.

- Collaborate with cross-functional and site leadership teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring the QMS evolves in line with business needs and regulatory expectations.

Experience: 
- Bachelorâs degree in a scientific or engineering discipline required; advanced degree preferred.

- Minimum 5+ years of relevant Quality Assurance or Quality Systems experience in a GxP-regulated environment, with at least 2-3 years in a leadership role.

- Strong knowledge of global quality regulations and standards (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO 9001, 21 CFR Parts 210/211/820, EU GMP).

- Proven experience leading Quality Management Review, internal audit programs, supplier management processes, and validation oversight.

- Demonstrated success in establishing and trending quality performance metrics and KPIs.

- Experience supporting and/or administering electronic QMS systems and partnering with IT for system enhancements.

- Experience working in a multi-site or global quality organization strongly preferred.

- Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functional and site boundaries.

\n $90,000 - $120,000 a year

\n The anticipated annual salary range for this job is based on prior experience in the role/industry, education, location, internal equity, and other job-related factors as permitted by law. For remote-based positions, this range may vary based on your local market. Full-time employment positions will also be eligible to receive pre-IPO equity and annual bonus, in addition to competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, PTO, 401(k) plan, life and accidental death and disability coverage, and parental leave benefits. Other perks include subsidized daily lunches and snacks at our on-site locations.

Who we are 

We are driven by a passion for science and compassion for patients. We act with urgency to ensure our treatments are one day accessible to all who need them.

We live by our core values of passion, courage, and integrity. Excellence in our work means the chance to unlock a better quality of life for our patients, and with that comes tremendous responsibility.

We innovate on a path that hasnât been paved. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit and take calculated risks to achieve our mission. We arenât afraid to ask âwhy notâ and challenge the status quo.

We maintain a start-up culture of camaraderie and leadership by example, regardless of title.

Weâre proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and recognize that celebrating our differences creates stronger, lasting solutions that better serve our team, our patients and their healthcare providers.

Notice to staffing firms

Our employment activities, inquiries and offers are managed through our HR/Talent team, and all candidates are presented through this channel only. We do not accept unsolicited resumes, and we rarely outsource recruitment.

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities 

- Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

- Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.

- Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.

- Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

- Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

- Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

- Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.

Required Experience 

- At least 5 years of sales experience within a SaaS or technology environment, including demonstrated experience leading a sales team with direct accountability for team performance and revenue outcomes.

- Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.

- Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

- Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills 

- Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

- Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

- Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.

- Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders.

- Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority.

- Operates effectively with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment: sets own priorities, creates momentum without close direction, and holds a consistently high personal bar for execution and results.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

- Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes. 
- Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements. 
- Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed. 
- Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise. 
- Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility. 
- Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port. 
- Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures. 

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

- Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
- Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
- Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work. 
- Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required. 

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

- Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy. 
- Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations. 
- Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format. 
- Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities. 
- Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work. 
- Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery. 
- Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise. 
- Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions. 
- Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others. 
- Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems. 

Physical Requirements:

- Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory. 
- The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively. 
- The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential. 
- Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment. 
- Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling. 
- The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities. 
- Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs. 
- The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required. 
- Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required. 

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

title: Regional Sales Director
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

An overview of this role

As the Regional Director, Sales for Germany, you’ll lead a high-performing team of Strategic & Major Account Executive professionals to grow adoption of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll be responsible for managing software sales, bookings, and revenue, while building strong relationships with new and existing customers who rely on GitLab to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, and reduce security and compliance risk. Reporting to the VP, Central EMEA, you’ll hire and develop top talent, set clear territory and industry strategies, and ensure your team’s sales plans align with GitLab’s overall growth goals in this market. In your first year, you’ll focus on building a strong team culture, deepening our presence with German clients, and consistently meeting or exceeding performance objectives in a fast-paced, open source software and SaaS environment.

Responsibilities

- Lead, coach, and motivate a team of Strategic & Major Account Executives focused on the German market to deliver software sales, bookings, and revenue results

- Drive territory and industry planning by analyzing market dynamics, customer needs, and competitive trends to identify and execute on growth opportunities

- Develop and own accurate sales forecasts, territory management plans, and growth strategies that align to GitLab’s overall revenue goals

- Establish, track, and report on key performance metrics for the team, and take action to address gaps and improve outcomes

- Collaborate closely with Renewals, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners to manage pipeline health, renewal performance, and deal execution

- Recruit, hire, and onboard top sales talent while building and maintaining a strong pipeline of potential future hires in the region

- Create a high-performing, inclusive, and positive team culture through regular coaching, clear expectations, and ongoing development

- Educate and enable your team on GitLab’s product, pricing, AI-powered DevSecOps positioning, and key industry and regulatory factors relevant to the German market, such as data privacy, data sovereignty, and sector-specific compliance requirements

Requirements

- Progressive experience in field sales and sales operations in an open source software, DevOps, or similar software-as-a-service environment

- Demonstrated success leading and developing account-focused sales teams, including hiring, coaching, and performance management

- Proven track record of meeting or exceeding performance objectives (revenue targets, pipeline targets, etc.)

- Experience building and executing go-to-market strategies for the German market, with a willingness to both lead and participate directly in selling activities

- Commercial and analytical skills to interpret sales performance data and adjust regional plans in ways that drive sustainable, long-term growth

- Practical experience working with CRM and sales/marketing tools (for example Salesforce, Clari, Marketo) to manage forecasts, territories, and pipeline

- Ability to analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitive dynamics to inform territory planning and team enablement

- Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and presentation skills, including executive-level written and verbal communication and the ability to mentor others

- Alignment with GitLab’s values and interest in open source, with openness to candidates who bring transferable leadership and regional sales experience from adjacent software markets

Remote-Global 

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees 

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being 

- Flexible Paid Time Off 

- Team Member Resource Groups 

- Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan 

- Growth and Development Fund 

- Parental Leave 

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

title: Enterprise Account Executive (Germany South)
description:
Recruitment Fraud Alert 

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number. 

What to know: 

- Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.

- We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.

- Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at 

About Commvault 

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI-powered platform combines best-in-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data. 

At Commvault, we help some of the world’s most complex organisations strengthen their cyber resilience and protect what matters most: their data, operations and ability to recover.

We are expanding our Enterprise Sales team in Germany and are looking an Enterprise Account Executive to cover Germany South 

This is not an account-maintenance role. We are looking for proven enterprise sellers who know their market, have built trusted relationships with senior customers and partners, and consistently turn market access into qualified pipeline, strategic opportunities and profitable growth.

What You Will Own 

- Deliver quarterly and annual revenue targets across a defined portfolio of large enterprise customers and high-value prospects.

- Build and execute strategic territory and account plans focused on net-new logo acquisition, competitive displacement and sustainable account expansion.

- Personally create and progress qualified pipeline through executive engagement, targeted prospecting, customer referrals, partners and technology alliances.

- Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving CIOs, CISOs, infrastructure leaders, procurement, partners and executive sponsors.

- Develop compelling business cases that connect cyber resilience and data protection outcomes with financial value, risk reduction and operational priorities.

- Orchestrate an integrated account team across Sales Engineering, Channel, Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services and executive leadership.

- Maintain accurate opportunity management, qualification and forecasting throughout the sales cycle.

- Build long-term customer relationships based on credibility, business value and consistent delivery.

What Successful Candidates Will Bring 

- A demonstrable track record of achieving or exceeding quota in enterprise software, SaaS, cybersecurity, data management, cloud infrastructure or a closely related market.

- Proven experience closing complex six- and seven-figure enterprise transactions with long sales cycles and multiple decision-makers.

- Evidence of winning net-new enterprise customers , not only expanding inherited accounts.

- An established and active network across enterprise customers, C-level decision-makers, channel partners and technology alliances within the relevant German territory.

- Strong knowledge of the German enterprise technology market, including customer priorities, competitive dynamics, procurement structures and partner ecosystems.

- The ability to independently create access, shape opportunities and maintain momentum without relying on continuous management intervention.

- Strong business-value selling, negotiation and executive communication skills.

- Disciplined use of CRM, qualification methodology, account planning and forecasting processes.

- A collaborative leadership style combined with personal accountability, resilience and a strong desire to win.

- Business-fluent German and English.

Territory and Travel 

- The role is field-based and should ideally be located within Germany South with convenient access to major rail, road and air connections.

- Regular customer and partner engagement across the assigned territory is an essential part of the role. Candidates should therefore be comfortable travelling based on customer and business requirements.

How We Define a Winning Mindset 

For us, a winning mindset is about:

- Creating opportunities rather than waiting for them.

- Taking ownership from initial access through successful close.

- Combining ambition with disciplined execution.

- Being transparent about risks, pipeline quality and forecast confidence.

- Mobilising the wider team while remaining personally accountable for the outcome.

- Learning quickly, responding constructively to setbacks and maintaining momentum.

- Winning in a way that strengthens customer trust, partner relationships and the team.

If you have consistently built enterprise pipeline, developed trusted executive relationships and converted complex customer challenges into significant business outcomes, we would like to hear from you.

Commvault is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are always committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status and we will not discriminate against on the basis of such characteristics or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we work.

Commvault’s goal is to make interviewing inclusive and accessible to all candidates and employees. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to participate in the interview process or apply for a position at Commvault, please email

- Interest in robotics and AI as a research field, and the ability to read and understand scientific publications

Nice to Have

-

- Fluent German

- 
Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.

Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.

Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.

In collaboration with GTM, product, and marketing teams, you’ll continuously refine our value proposition, sales methodology, and market positioning to ensure differentiated value across the landscape.

The ideal candidate will have a passion for developing new market segments, pinpointing high-potential opportunities, and executing strategies to capture them. Responsibilities: 

-

Design and execute innovative sales strategies to meet and exceed revenue quotas. Analyze market landscapes, trends, and dynamics to translate high-level plans into targeted sales activities, partnerships, and campaigns

- 
Spearhead market expansion by pinpointing new customer segments and use cases. Collaborate cross-functionally to differentiate our offerings and sustain a competitive edge

- 
Inform product roadmaps and features by gathering customer feedback and conveying market needs. Provide insights that strengthen our value proposition and enhance the customer experience

- 
Continuously refine the sales methodology by incorporating learnings into playbooks, templates, and best practices. Identify process improvements that optimize sales productivity and consistency

You may be a good fit if you have: 

- 
5+ years of enterprise sales experience driving adoption of emerging technologies with a consultative, solutions-oriented sales approach

- 
A track record of managing complex sales cycles and securing strategic deals by understanding multifaceted technical requirements and crafting tailored solutions

- 
Demonstrated ability to navigate dynamic stakeholder ecosystems, building consensus and providing innovative solutions to disparate groups

- 
Extensive experience negotiating highly complex, customized commercial agreements with multiple stakeholders

- 
Proven experience exceeding revenue targets in fast-paced organizations by effectively managing an evolving pipeline and sales process

- 
Excellent communication skills and the ability to present confidently and build connections across all customer levels, from ICs to C-level executives

A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves'' mentality. You are a true team player

- 
A strategic, analytical approach to assessing markets combined with creative, tactical execution to capture opportunities

- 
A passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems. You feel strongly about ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely

title: Grafikdesigner / Mediengestalter (m/w/d) – Print & Digital - Ab sofort · Unbefristet · Vollzeit
description:
Über den Kopp Verlag

Der Kopp Verlag ist ein unabhängiges Medien- und E-Commerce-Unternehmen mit über 30 Jahren Erfahrung am Markt und einem eigenständigen publizistischen Ansatz. Unser Sortiment reicht von Büchern und Zeitschriften über Nahrungsergänzungsmittel, Lebensmittel und Drogerie bis hin zu Outdoor & Survival sowie Haus & Garten.

Von unserem monatlichen Produktkatalog über Anzeigen und Beilagen bis hin zu Newslettern und digitalen Werbemitteln: Unsere Grafik sorgt dafür, dass unsere Produkte und Angebote visuell überzeugend präsentiert werden – gedruckt und digital.

Dich erwartet ein ambitioniertes Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, viel Eigenverantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum. Wenn du Ideen hast, kannst du sie bei uns nicht nur präsentieren, sondern auch umsetzen. 

Deine Aufgaben

Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung, arbeitest präzise und nutzt moderne KI-Tools selbstverständlich als Teil deines kreativen Workflows? Du willst nicht nur einzelne Motive gestalten, sondern unterschiedlichste Werbemittel von der Idee bis zur fertigen Datei begleiten? Dann bist du bei uns richtig. 

Dein Job 

· Du gestaltest und realisierst unseren monatlich erscheinenden Produktkatalog

· Du übernimmst Reinzeichnung und Druckvorlagenherstellung und sorgst für technisch saubere Produktionsdaten

· Du bearbeitest, retuschierst und montierst Bilder für Print- und Digitalmedien

· Du konzipierst und gestaltest Newsletter und Werbebanner

· Du gestaltest Print-Werbemittel wie Anzeigen, Selfmailer, Broschüren und Beilagen

· Du entwickelst bestehende Gestaltungskonzepte weiter und sorgst für einen konsistenten visuellen Auftritt

· Du bereitest unterschiedliche Medienformate für die jeweiligen Kanäle und technischen Anforderungen auf

· Du setzt verschiedene KI-Tools gezielt in deinem Arbeitsalltag ein – beispielsweise für Ideenfindung, Bildwelten, Gestaltungsvarianten und Bildbearbeitung

· Du testest neue KI-Anwendungen im Grafik- und Medienbereich und prüfst, welche davon unsere Arbeitsabläufe sinnvoll verbessern können

· Du kombinierst klassische Gestaltungskompetenz mit KI-gestützten Arbeitsweisen und entwickelst die Ergebnisse gestalterisch sauber weiter

· Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing, E-Commerce und weiteren beteiligten Fachbereichen zusammen

· Du begleitest deine Projekte von der Gestaltung über Korrekturschleifen bis zur finalen Produktionsdatei

· Du achtest dabei gleichermaßen auf Gestaltung, Genauigkeit, Termine und technische Qualität

Das bringst du mit

· Du hast praktische Berufserfahrung im Grafikdesign, als Mediengestalter oder in einem vergleichbaren gestalterischen Bereich

· Du arbeitest sicher mit gängigen professionellen Grafik- und Layoutprogrammen

· Du kennst dich mit Reinzeichnung, Druckvorstufe und der Erstellung druckfähiger Daten aus

· Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Layout, Typografie, Bildsprache und eine saubere visuelle Gestaltung

· Du kannst sowohl für Printmedien als auch für digitale Kanäle gestalten

· Du bist sehr KI-affin und arbeitest bereits praktisch mit verschiedenen generativen KI-Anwendungen im kreativen Umfeld

· Du nutzt KI nicht nur zum Ausprobieren, sondern produktiv für Ideenentwicklung, Bildgenerierung, Bildbearbeitung und die Erstellung unterschiedlicher Gestaltungsvarianten

· Du beschäftigst dich aktiv mit neuen KI-Tools und hast Lust, neue Möglichkeiten früh auszuprobieren und sinnvoll in bestehende Prozesse zu integrieren

· Du kannst KI-Ergebnisse kritisch beurteilen und gestalterisch professionell weiterverarbeiten

· Du arbeitest präzise und sorgfältig und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick

· Du setzt gestalterische Vorgaben zuverlässig um und bringst gleichzeitig eigene Ideen ein

· Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und zuverlässig und stimmst dich gerne mit anderen Fachbereichen ab

· Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

· Eine bestimmte Ausbildung oder ein Studium ist für uns nicht entscheidend. Wenn du praktische Erfahrung und das entsprechende gestalterische Können mitbringst, bist du auch als Quereinsteiger willkommen

Das bieten wir dir

· Eine abwechslungsreiche Position mit einem breiten Spektrum aus Print- und Digitalprojekten

· Eine überdurchschnittliche Vergütung

· 30 Tage Urlaub sowie den 24. und 31. Dezember frei

· Firmenfitness mit EGYM Wellpass

· Eigenes Betriebsrestaurant, gratis Tafelwasser, Kaffee und frisches Obst

· Hohe Mitarbeiterrabatte auf unser komplettes Sortiment

· Vermögenswirksame Leistungen und die Möglichkeit einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge

· Einen modernen, lichtdurchfluteten und klimatisierten Arbeitsplatz im Firmengebäude direkt an der Natur

· B28-Lage mit Parkplätzen, guter ÖPNV-Anbindung und Radabstellflächen

· Gemeinsame Mitarbeiterevents

· Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und eine langfristige Perspektive

· Eine sorgfältige Einarbeitung und eine wertschätzende Du-Kultur

Klingt gut? Dann los.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung – das brauchen wir von dir:

· Kurzes Anschreiben

title: Senior Product Marketing & Exhibitions Specialist
description:
Sécheron Hasler Group is a global leader in railway and industrial electrification systems, offering cutting-edge solutions to enhance transportation and decarbonize industrial processes. With a rich heritage of over a century and a commitment to innovation, Sécheron Hasler Group is growing worldwide.

For the Electrical Safety Solutions (ESS) Business Unit, we are looking for an experienced marketing professional with a strong interest in technical products and industrial markets. The Senior Product Marketing & Exhibitions Specialist will translate ESS business priorities and product value propositions into clear marketing communications, sales tools, product training and customer-facing materials. The candidate will work closely with the Business Development Manager, Product Line Managers, Sales and the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team.

Global objectives:

- Drive the execution of the ESS marketing plan and business growth priorities, in cooperation with the Business Development Manager, Product Line Managers and Sales.
- Develop and maintain marketing and sales materials for existing and new products and applications.
- Develop product marketing communication using various communication channels to promote ESS and its respective products.
- Work with the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team for trade shows/fairs and manage the required preparation and coordination with the respective Business Unit teams.
- Provide marketing inputs and product communication materials to support Product Line Managers and Sales.

Key responsibilities:

- Develop and deliver marketing communication plans based on ESS business priorities agreed with the Business Development Manager. 
- Contribute to product launch plans defined with the Business Development Manager and Product Line Managers; coordinate the preparation and delivery of marketing materials, training and communication activities
- Develop marketing and sales materials, including commercial brochures, PowerPoint presentations, promotional videos and animations for products and applications, and website content.
- Collect and structure market and competitor information; prepare customer-oriented product messages, competitive comparisons and sales enablement materials in collaboration with the Business Development Manager and Product Line Managers.
- Develop product training materials with Product Line Managers and support training for the worldwide Sales network.
- Maintain product documentation for intranet and corporate purposes.
- Coordinate annual exhibition and trade show preparation within ESS, based on priorities agreed with the Business Development Manager and Sales, and in alignment with the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team.
- Develop marketing concepts, communication campaigns, exhibition experiences, templates and customer engagement initiatives aligned with ESS business priorities.
- Contribute to the annual ESS strategy review by preparing marketing performance indicators, communication plans and supporting materials.
- Support the continuous improvement of ESS sales enablement tools and materials, helping ensure that Sales teams have up-to-date product messaging, training and communication.
Requirements 

- Further education in industrial product marketing
- Degree in marketing, communications, business or a technical field; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
- Ability to understand electronic products and translate technical information into clear customer-facing content.
- Solid experience in marketing communications, product marketing or sales enablement in an international industrial B2B environment.
- Experience creating marketing materials for technical products and collaborating with Sales, Product Management or Engineering teams.
- Experience coordinating projects and stakeholders across different countries or functions.
- Experience in product marketing, marketing communications or sales enablement for technical products.
- Good knowledge of at least one of the following industry sectors: high voltage, railway traction systems, power transmission & distribution, renewable energy and e-mobility.
- Interest and ability to understand DC and AC power systems and corresponding product needs.
- Excellent project management, organizational and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills. 
- Ability to translate technical information into clear marketing messages and customer benefits.
- Proven ability to think creatively, identify and resolve problems.
- Experienced to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
- Proficiency in MS-Office programs.

title: Senior Backend-Entwickler – Agents (100% Remote in Deutschland)
description:
Wir suchen Senior Developer, die in unserem vollständig remoten Team an unseren Agenten arbeiten. Wenn du Komplexität magst und willst, dass deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegt, passt du zu uns.

Über uns 
Hausverwalter.ai ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut.

Über die Rolle 
Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst.
Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten.
Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr.

Woran du arbeiten wirst 

- Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen.

- Harness Engineering: Der Agent hat über 100 Tools. Aber er muss eine Anfrage so verstehen, wie ein Hausverwalter sie versteht, und nicht so, wie die Begriffe außerhalb der Branche klingen. Was gehört in den System Prompt, was in Skills?

- Knowledge Base: Unsere Plattform hat eine eigene Knowledge Base, ähnlich wie Notion. Komplett selbst gebaut und gedacht als kollektives Gehirn des Unternehmens. Aber sollte die KI auch von selbst „lernen"? Und wenn ja, wann? Und wie machen wir die Suche in der Knowledge Base besser — über bessere Tools, System Prompts oder Skills?

- Voice-Agents: Dieselben Agenten, nur am Telefon — auf LiveKit gebaut, die Anrufe genauso abwickeln wie unsere Text-Agenten Tickets.

- LLM Infrastructure. Das richtige Modell für die jeweilige Aufgabe wählen, per Caching und Streaming die Latenz drücken, bei Provider-Ausfällen sauber neu versuchen, Context kompakt halten, die RAG-Suche optimieren, Usage über alle Provider tracken, Kosten senken und mit Evals prüfen, was wirklich besser ist.

Unser minimalistischer Tech Stack 
Alles ist TypeScript. Vom Datenbankschema bis ins Frontend.
Backend: Convex (Datenbank & Serverless Functions)
Frontend: Next.js , React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui
Technologien, die dir begegnen werden: Vercel AI SDK, Convex Agent Component

Gehalt 

5000 – 6000 Euro brutto, mit Raum für Wachstum und Beförderungen in den kommenden Monaten und Jahren

Benefits 

- 100 % remote

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten

- So viele KI-Tokens, wie du brauchst

- Wir sind eigenfinanziert und profitabel (und verbrennen kein VC-Geld, um zu überleben)

- Kleines Team, echte Verantwortung — was du baust, geht auch wirklich live

- Schnelle Entscheidungen, keine sinnlosen Meetings und keine Freigabeschleifen, durch die du dich kämpfen musst

Unsere Werte 

- Dinge fertig machen, jeder Tag zählt

- Transparenz und Ehrlichkeit, gerade wenn es unangenehm wird

- Nach Großem streben – dich und andere ständig fordern

Wenn du genauer sehen willst, was wir bauen: Schau auf unserem YouTube-Kanal vorbei — kleiner Hinweis, der ist auf Deutsch.

Du bist 

- fließend in Englisch und Deutsch

- ein erfahrener Entwickler mit mehr als 2 Jahren Erfahrung im Bauen von Agenten für den Produktivbetrieb

- AI-native. Du hast agentische Features ausgeliefert, auf die sich echte Nutzer verlassen, und du hast eine Meinung zu Retrieval, Evals, Tool-Design und dazu, wo die heutigen Spitzenmodelle an ihre Grenzen kommen.

- in erster Linie Builder. Du bringst lieber heute eine grobe v1 raus, als drei Wochen lang die perfekte zu planen.

- auf dem neuesten Stand bei neuen KI-Modellen und der Forschung

- jemand, der fast seinen gesamten Code mit KI schreibt

- es gewohnt, autonom zu arbeiten und volle Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben zu übernehmen

- unter Leistungsdruck sogar noch besser

- schnell darin, Neues zu lernen, und siehst dich als Generalist, nicht als Spezialist

Dein Techstack :

Ist nicht wichtig, da bei uns KI deinen Code schreiben wird.

title: Associate Director Quality Compliance / QA Client
description:
Simtra ist ein erstklassiges Auftragsentwicklungs- & Herstellungsunternehmen, welches seit über 65 Jahren in Zusammenarbeit mit mehr als 60 internationalen Kunden weltweit sterile, injizierbare Arzneimittel auf den Markt bringt. Unser Hauptaugenmerk liegt hierbei auf der Herstellung von Krebstherapeutika. Mit der Unterstützung von über 2.000 Mitarbeitenden an unseren drei Standorten in Bloomington, Indiana, USA; Parsippany, New Jersey, USA und Halle/Westfalen, Deutschland , können wir unseren Kunden ein breites Portfolio von Verabreichungssystemen anbieten, darunter vorgefüllte Spritzen, flüssige/lyophilisierte Fläschchen, Verdünnungsmittel für die Rekonstitution, mit Pulver gefüllte Fläschchen und sterile Kristallisation. Neben der GMP-Herstellung bieten wir auch weitere Dienstleistungen an, darunter Unterstützung bei der Formulierung und Entwicklung, Gefriertrocknungsoptimierung, globale regulatorische Unterstützung sowie Sekundärverpackung. 

Simtra wird aus vielseitigen Teams in verschiedenen Bereichen gebildet! Werden Sie ein Teil des Teams und unterstützen Sie zukünftig dabei Patienten weltweit lebensverändernde Medikamente zur Verfügung zu stellen. 

Wir produzieren in unserem Werk in Halle/Westfalen Arzneimittel zur Therapie verschiedener Krebs- und anderer lebensbedrohenden Erkrankungen. 

Für unser Team suchen wir Sie als Associate Director (m/w/d) Quality Compliance / QA Client (2217). 

In dieser Position sind Sie für die strategische und operative Leitung des Bereichs Quality Compliance inkl. QA Client verantwortlich und stellen die kontinuierliche Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen sowie die Weiterentwicklung des Qualitätsmanagementsystems sicher. Dies bedeutet im Einzelnen:

- Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung sowie Weiterentwicklung von Teams in den Bereichen Client Communication & Auditing, Data Integrity, Regulatory Intelligence und Release Management

- Sicherstellung der Audit- und Inspektionsbereitschaft des Standortes einschließlich Planung, Organisation und Nachverfolgung von Audits, Inspektionen und zugehörigen CAPAs

- Vertretung des Qualitätsbereichs als zentrale Ansprechperson bei Behördeninspektionen und Kundenaudits

- Verantwortung für die Überwachung der Data-Integrity-Compliance innerhalb der GMP-Prozesse sowie Sicherstellung geeigneter Maßnahmen zur Untersuchung und Behebung von Risiken

- Leitung interner Compliance-Assessments und Selbstinspektionsprogramme am Standort

- Aufbau und Pflege eines globalen Netzwerks sowie Förderung der Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Standorten zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung eines effektiven Qualitätsmanagementsystems

- Förderung einer nachhaltigen Qualitäts- und Speak-up-Kultur innerhalb der Organisation

- Unterstützung von Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Operational Excellence

Sie bringen mit: 

- 
Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Promotion oder Masterabschluss in der Pharmazie, Biologie oder eines vergleichbaren naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengangs

- 
Mehr als 10 Jahre Berufserfahrung im pharmazeutischen GMP-Umfeld, idealerweise in der sterilen Herstellung oder im CDMO-Umfeld

- 
Fundierte Erfahrung im Bereich Quality Assurance sowie umfassende Kenntnisse der FDA- und EMA-Anforderungen 

- 
Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung, vorzugsweise mindestens 5 Jahre in der Leitung von QA-Teams 

- 
Erfahrung im Aufbau und der Steuerung von Inspection-Readiness-Programmen sowie in der Leitung von Behördeninspektionen 

- 
Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Führungskompetenzen 

- 
Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Das bieten wir Ihnen: 

- Hauseigene moderne Kantine mit attraktiver Be­zu­schus­sung

- 30 Tage Urlaub plus Sonderurlaub

- Job-Rad Leasing

- Corporate Benefits: Exklusive Rabatte für Mitarbeitende bei zahlreichen bekannten Marken

- Gute Verkehrsanbindung und kostenlose Mitarbeitendenparkplätze 

- Berufsbedingter Umzug? Wir unterstützen finanziell im Rahmen unserer Umzugskostenpauschale

- Kostenlose Betriebssportarten z.B. Badminton, Fußball und Fitnesskurse

Engagierten und begabten Menschen bieten wir interessante Chancen. Geschlecht, Alter, Hautfarbe, Herkunft, sexuelle Orientierung und Beeinträchtigungen spielen dabei keine Rolle - im Gegenteil: Wir fördern Vielfalt und glauben, dass Diversität eine Bereicherung darstellt.

Wir freuen uns über die Zusendung der Unterlagen zu Ihrem bisherigen beruflichen Werdegang direkt über unser Online-System.

title: Regional Sales Director (m/w/d) – Vertriebsleitung Region West
description:
Du willst kein Gebiet verwalten. Du willst ein Team bauen, das auch ohne dich verkauft. Als Regional Sales Director führst du acht Leute im Außendienst zwischen NRW und Hessen, mit KI-basierter Lead-Priorisierung, eigenem Forecast und Key-Account-Verhandlungen, die du selbst zum Abschluss bringst.

Standort: Großraum Münster - du arbeitest eigenständig in der Region West (NRW und Hessen) im Außendienst, mit rund 60 % Kundenterminen und 40 % Homeoffice, langfristig eher 50/50.

Über uns

CarOnSale ist die KI-gestützte Plattform für den B2B-Gebrauchtwagenhandel in Europa. Über 40.000 Käufer aus mehr als 20 Ländern handeln auf unserer Plattform – und 85 % des Inventars ist exklusiv bei uns. Wir verbinden Software, Pricing-Intelligenz, Logistik und Finanzierung in einer Schicht – als Betriebssystem für eine ganze Branche.

One Platform. One Profit Engine. 

Deine Aufgaben

- Du baust das regionale Field-Sales-Team weiter auf und etablierst eine Leistungskultur, in der jede Person ihre Zahlen selbst verantwortet

- Du entwickelst eine hybride Vertriebsstrategie, die digitale Tools mit persönlicher Kundennähe verbindet

- Du implementierst klar strukturierte Vertriebsprozesse mit definierten Rollen

- Du setzt die regionalen Wachstumsziele um und führst strategische Key-Account-Verhandlungen bis zum Abschluss

- Du steuerst den Vertriebserfolg datengetrieben über KPIs, Forecasts und KI-basierte Lead-Priorisierung

- Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale entlang der Customer Journey und hebst Produktivität, Effizienz und Kundenzufriedenheit

- Du präsentierst deine Ergebnisse in KPI-Dashboards und Business Reviews auf Führungsebene

Was du mitbringst

- Mindestens zwei Jahre Führungserfahrung mit einem Vertriebsteam von mehr als sechs Personen

- Erfahrung im Außendienst sowie im Hunting- und Farming-Modell

- Erfahrung im Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger, komplexer Produkte – du überzeugst mit Argumenten und gibst dieses Wissen an dein Team weiter

- Erfahrung im Teamaufbau und Performance-Coaching, mit operativer Nähe zum Tagesgeschäft

- KPIs, Forecasts und datengetriebene Steuerung sind für dich selbstverständlich, ebenso der Umgang mit Salesforce, Google Workspace, Looker oder Tableau

- Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B2 für die Zusammenarbeit im Führungsteam

Von Vorteil 

- Verständnis für skalierbare Vertriebsmodelle in digitalen Umfeldern, idealerweise Start-up, SaaS oder Plattform

- KI-gestützte Sales-Prozesse hast du nicht nur kennengelernt, sondern aktiv mitgestaltet

Was dich bei uns erwartet

- Firmenwagen zur privaten Nutzung inklusive Tankkarte

- 28 Tage Urlaub

- 2× jährliches Karriere- & Entwicklungsgespräch

- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss

- Dienstrad-Leasing zur privaten Nutzung

- FitX-Mitgliedschaft oder Urban Sports Club-Zuschuss

- Virtual Stock Options – du beteiligst dich am Erfolg

- Strukturiertes Onboarding mit Buddy-Programm und Social Events

- Gelebte Vielfalt: aktives Frauennetzwerk

Bewirb dich jetzt – dein Lebenslauf reicht.

title: Senior Campaign Manager DACH (m/w/d)
description:
Du denkst Kampagnen nicht nur strategisch, sondern bringst sie auch selbst ins Ziel? Als Senior Campaign Manager DACH (m/w/d) verantwortest du unsere B2B-Marketingkampagnen über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg – von der Strategie und Zielgruppendefinition über die operative Umsetzung bis zur kontinuierlichen Optimierung. Dein Fokus liegt auf Demand & Lead Generation, Performance Marketing und messbarem Beitrag zur Pipeline. Gemeinsam mit Content, Design, PR, Lead Management und Sales entwickelst du wirkungsvolle Kampagnen für den DACH-Markt. Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung, erkennst Potenziale und Herausforderungen frühzeitig und treibst Themen eigenständig voran. Wir suchen eine Hands-on-Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Ownership, die Initiative ergreift und Ergebnisse liefert.

Deine Aufgaben 

- Entwicklung, Steuerung und Optimierung von B2B-Marketingkampagnen für den DACH-Markt

- Planung und Umsetzung von Demand- und Lead-Generation-Maßnahmen mit Fokus auf Pipeline-Impact

- Definition von Zielgruppen, Messaging und Kanalstrategien

- Eigenständige Steuerung von Paid-Media-Kampagnen (insb. LinkedIn & Google Ads)

- Analyse relevanter KPIs sowie Ableitung von Optimierungsmaßnahmen

- Budgetplanung, Reporting und Performance-Management

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Lead Management sowie internen Marketing-Teams

- Überführung globaler Marketinginitiativen in erfolgreiche DACH-Kampagnen

Dein Profil

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B Campaign-, Demand- oder Performance-Marketing

- Nachweisbare Erfolge in Planung, Umsetzung und Optimierung von Kampagnen

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Lead Generation, Zielgruppensegmentierung und Paid Media

- Sicherer Umgang mit KPIs, Budgetsteuerung und datengetriebenen Entscheidungen

- Starkes Projektmanagement sowie Fähigkeit, mehrere Themen parallel zu steuern

- Ausgeprägte Ownership-, Hands-on- und Umsetzungsmentalität

- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; Erfahrung mit HubSpot oder vergleichbaren Tools von Vorteil

Ein Umfeld, das jederzeit offen für Veränderungen und Optimierungen ist. Ein „das war schon immer so“ gibt es bei uns nicht. - Home-Office Verträge & absolute Flexibilität durch freie Gestaltung der Arbeitszeit 

- Unbefristete Festanstellung und 30 Tage Urlaub 

- FlexWork: Bis zu 3 Monate pro Jahr remote aus dem europäischen Ausland arbeiten 

- Monatliches Budget für individuell wählbare Benefits aus über 50 möglichen Angeboten über emplu, verschiedene Angebote über Corporate Benefits, sowie Fahrrad- und Autoleasing per Gehaltsumwandlung

- Mental Health Benefit 'Nilo' – 12 kostenlose Sessions mit Psycholog:innen jährlich sowie Zugang zu Meditationen und Kursen 

- Wir unterstützen dich gezielt bei deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung bei Natuvion 

- Mentorenprogramm für eine strukturierte und persönliche Einarbeitung 

- Werde Teil des #teamgreen - Bei Natuvion arbeitest du an innovativen Projekten als Teil eines Teams, das füreinander einsteht. Wir setzen auf Zusammenarbeit, Offenheit und Vertrauen 

- Modernes Equipment und zentrale Büros in Walldorf, Berlin, München und Leipzig 

- Uns ist deine langfristige Perspektive wichtig, deshalb bezuschussen wir deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge sowie vermögenswirksame Leistungen 

Join #teamgreen - Natuvion ist ein digitales Umzugsunternehmen.

- Design and maintain backend services, APIs, data models, and business logic that support intuitive source code workflows.

- Collaborate across functions and teams, both asynchronously and synchronously, and involve domain experts when their input will improve the outcome.

- Use AI agents for well-scoped work when they can speed up delivery without sacrificing quality, and critically review their output.

- Write maintainable code that follows GitLab's standards and contribute to constructive code reviews.

- Help strengthen reliability by monitoring production health metrics, participating in Tier 2 on-call, troubleshooting incidents, contributing to root cause analysis, and improving observability and resiliency.

- Share knowledge through code review, technical documentation, and everyday collaboration while learning from others.

What you’ll bring 

- Professional experience building backend web applications, services, or application programming interfaces, with experience using Ruby and GraphQL.

- An understanding of relational databases, structured query language, data modeling, caching, background processing, and backend performance practices.

- Experience with full-stack development to build and maintain user-facing workflows and their underlying systems.

- Experience writing backend unit and integration tests, with familiarity with the testing pyramid, Git, and collaborative code review processes.

- Clear written and spoken English communication skills, including sharing useful status updates in a remote, asynchronous environment.

- The ability to manage assigned priorities, work through ambiguity, take ownership of your work, and seek guidance when needed.

- Experience using AI coding agents to speed up software development while critically reviewing their output.

- Bonus: you’ve built agents or agent-based workflows that run in production, not just prototypes.

About the team 

The functional team works across Europe and North America, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous collaboration. It includes four engineers, comprising both backend and frontend engineers. We work closely with other Source Code teams, Agentic Preview, Repository Services, and Hardening, as well as other teams in the company such as the Gitaly team, and the AI Governance team.

description:

title: Growth Associate - M&A Platform
description:
You’re joining manda, iwoca’s M&A platform, at a pivotal moment. After early success working with existing iwoca customers, we’re now turning to the open market to help more business owners exit.

That’s why we’re looking for a Growth Associate to join the team. This is a 6-month fixed-term role for someone smart, hungry and entrepreneurial. With the right traction the role will convert into a permanent role at the forefront of manda’s growth efforts.

The company 

Selling a small business is hard. Only one in five UK SME owners has a formal exit plan, yet half are counting on their business to fund their retirement. Below £10m in enterprise value, most M&A advisers can't make the economics work, so a generation of owner-managers is getting ready to step back with no realistic route to a sale.

manda exists to fix that. We match owners with serious buyers, from search funds to private equity, and handle the whole process in one place, including financial due diligence and acquisition finance. Our first sale is done, and we're now opening manda up beyond iwoca's own customers.

manda is part of iwoca, one of Europe's leading fintech lenders, which has provided more than £4 billion in funding to over 150,000 businesses since 2012. That gives us what a traditional adviser doesn't have: a deep footprint in the SME economy, a lender's data and infrastructure, and deals run on clean, automated processes rather than spreadsheets.

The team 

You'll report to manda's Venture Lead and work day to day with our Transaction Managers, the dealmakers who run each sale, and our Partnerships Manager, who builds our referral network with accountants, solicitors and wealth managers. You'll also work with iwoca's marketing & sales team and have access to their tools and know-how.

The role 

Your mission is to grow the number of businesses manda takes to market, by finding owners who are serious about selling and bringing them into a first meeting with one of our Transaction Managers.

With an ethos of smarter, not louder, you’ll build on iwoca’s existing models to work out which owners are getting ready to sell and which businesses will attract a buyer, then reach them personally by email, LinkedIn and phone. We'd rather approach the right few hundred owners well than the wrong ten thousand badly.

- Decide who we contact. Own the target lists and the logic behind them, and keep sharpening them on what actually predicts a seller and a strong business.
