title: Senior Marketing Manager, Integrated Marketing
description:
Our Global Structure 

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it’s a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We’re looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us take ideas from global strategy through to local activation across markets, delivering integrated campaigns that drive measurable business growth.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Integrated Marketing team. We own the Deliveroo brand globally and lead our biggest campaign moments. Working in a cross-functional squad alongside strategic teams, functional leads, and local markets, we turn big ideas into high-impact campaigns across our markets.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

- 
Global Campaign Ownership: Lead high-profile global marketing programmes and integrated campaigns from global strategy through to local market execution.

- 
Framework & Playbook Development: Design, scale, and maintain measurement frameworks, playbooks, and systems that enable global and local teams to execute best-in-class brand campaigns.

- 
Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with cross-functional squads, strategic teams, functional leads, and local market leads to align campaign strategies with core business goals.

- 
Stakeholder Management: Influence senior stakeholders across the global organisation without direct authority, ensuring alignment on messaging, execution, and performance metrics.

- 
Strategic Optimisation: Balance tactical execution with a longer-term strategic perspective to solve complex marketing briefs and continuously optimize brand performance.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential 

- 
Integrated Brand Leadership: Proven experience leading end-to-end global integrated marketing campaigns from initial strategy through to local market activation.

- 
Framework Development: Strong track record in establishing measurement frameworks, campaign playbooks, and operational systems that scale across multiple regions.

- 
Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior cross-functional stakeholders and matrix teams without direct line management authority.

- 
Strategic & Tactical Execution: Proven ability to operate independently on complex or ambiguous briefs, balancing day-to-day execution with longer-term brand strategy.

- 
Commercial Acumen: Strong expertise in linking brand initiatives and marketing campaigns directly to measurable business growth and commercial impact.

Nice to Have 

- 
Experience navigating three-sided marketplace dynamics or fast-paced consumer tech environments.

- 
Background working across international or multi-market structures.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day 

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment 

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role 

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture 

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Financial Services Insurance practice are looking for experienced Senior Managers and Directors to join our Specialty Insurance team. 

Our team works with leading insurers and London Market organisations to solve complex strategic and transformation challenges. We combine deep insurance expertise with business architecture, operating model design, data, digital, AI and technology capabilities to help clients transform underwriting, claims, operations and finance. 

We are particularly interested in individuals who bring strong expertise in Data, Digital & AI Transformation or Business solution Architecture & Industry SME knowledge delivering complex change. Candidates are not expected to specialise in both areas. 

What you will be doing 

At Senior Manager level: 

- 
Lead complex Specialty Insurance transformation programmes, bringing expertise in data, digital, AI or business solution architecture/operating model transformation. 

- 
Work with senior client stakeholders to define strategies, design practical solutions and deliver measurable outcomes across underwriting, claims, operations and finance. 

- 
Lead multidisciplinary teams across business and technology, managing delivery, governance, risks and dependencies.

Apply specialist knowledge to deliver either data and AI strategies, automation solutions, target operating models, business process redesign or wider technology-enabled transformation. 

- 
Build trusted client relationships, contribute to proposals and business development, and support the growth of our Specialty Insurance capabilities.

At Director level: 

- 
Shape and lead our Specialty Insurance transformation propositions, with a particular focus on Data, Digital & AI and technology-enabled business change. 

- 
Originate, shape and sell large-scale transformation programmes, building relationships with executive and C-suite stakeholders across the London Market and Specialty Insurance sector. 

- 
Provide strategic advisory leadership across either data and AI strategy, business architecture, operating model transformation and complex business change. 

- 
Lead strategic accounts and multidisciplinary programmes, taking accountability for commercial performance, client relationships and delivery outcomes. 

- 
Drive proposition development, go-to-market activity and capability building, developing high-performing teams and strengthening Baringa's market presence. 

Your skills and experience 

At Senior Manager level: 

- 
Strong experience within Specialty Insurance, the London Market or insurance consulting, with functional knowledge across underwriting, claims, operations or finance. 

- 
Demonstrable expertise in at least one of our priority areas : Data, Digital & AI (including data strategy, governance, GenAI, automation and technology transformation) or Business Architecture & Transformation (including target operating models, capability modelling, process redesign and organisational change). 

- 
Proven experience leading complex transformation programmes, multidisciplinary teams and senior stakeholder relationships. 

- 
Ability to translate strategic and technical challenges into practical business solutions, working effectively across business and technology functions. 

- 
Commercial awareness and experience contributing to client relationships, proposals, proposition development and business development. 

At Director level: 

- 
Significant senior leadership experience within Specialty Insurance, the London Market or insurance consulting, with established market credibility and executive relationships. 

- 
Deep expertise in Data, Digital & AI transformation or business architecture and operating model change, with the ability to shape and lead complex insurance transformation agendas. 

- 
Demonstrable track record of originating, shaping and selling large-scale consulting or transformation engagements, alongside strategic account management and commercial growth. 

- 
Strong experience advising executive and C-suite stakeholders, translating emerging technology and business transformation opportunities into compelling client propositions. 

- 
Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams, proposition development, capability building and talent development. 

What a career at Baringa will give you 

Putting   People   First. 

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

- Generous Annual Leave Policy:  We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 

- Flexible Working:  We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 

- Corporate Responsibility Days:  Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 

- Wellbeing Fund:  We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 

- Profit Share Scheme:  All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace 

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all.  Click here  to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve.

In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

title: Staff Mechanical Product Engineer (Production)
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Role 
The Staff Product Engineer serves as the primary design engineering presence on the production floor, bridging the gap between design intent and production execution. Embedded within the Global Head of Production organization with a dotted-line relationship to Platform and Payload Engineering Teams, this role owns the day-to-day engineering interface between design engineering teams and manufacturing operations across multiple production sites.
This is a senior individual contributor role requiring deep technical judgement, the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced production environment, and the credibility to influence both design engineers and production leadership. The Staff Product Engineer is expected to drive systemic improvements — not just resolve individual issues — and to develop process and tooling solutions that scale across product versions, variations, and manufacturing sites.

Key Responsibilities 

Production Floor Engineering Support 

- Serve as the primary design engineering point of contact on the production floor for assigned programs and product lines

- Mechanical Design Acumen: Broad mechanical engineering foundation spanning 3D CAD modeling, structural and thermal analysis, materials selection, and manufacturing process knowledge — able to apply design engineering skills directly to solve production problems rather than relying solely on escalation to design teams

- Autonomy & Initiative: Comfort with ambiguity and competing priorities in a fast-moving production environment; able to self-direct and prioritize without constant direction

- Communication: Clear, concise technical communication — written dispositions, engineering reports, and presentations to leadership

- Strong understanding of MRB processes, nonconformance management, and engineering disposition (use-as-is, rework, scrap, return to vendor)

title: Staff Mechanical Product Engineer (Platform)
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. title: Channel Solutions Engineer
description:
Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. At Algolia, we're passionate about helping organisations create fast, relevant, and intuitive digital experiences. Algolia AI search powers millions of experiences across ecommerce, financial services, travel and hospitality, media, marketplaces, SaaS, and other enterprise applications.

You'll work closely with Partner Managers, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and the global Partner Solutions Engineering team to help partners become trusted experts on the Algolia platform.

While reporting into the global Solutions Engineering team, this role is dedicated to our Global Partner Team which covers our partners in EMEA, AMER, LATAM and APAC. Build Strategic Relationships

- Collaborate closely with the global Partner Solutions Engineering organisation, particularly the EMEA team, to develop annual technical engagement initiatives and share best practices across regions

title: Senior Director Infrastructure Engineering
description:
About Volta 

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

The Role 

We are looking for a Senior Director, Infrastructure Engineering to lead engineering across Volta's global portfolio of AI factories. You will report directly to the VP, Development and Design within the Delivery organisation and lead a team of subject matter experts spanning every infrastructure architecture and engineering discipline, from power and cooling to structures, controls and network infrastructure.

You will own Volta's engineering design standards, developing and deploying them across our projects in EMEA and AMER. You will work day to day with your peers in the Design organisation to support live projects and shape Volta's Reference Design for AI factory infrastructure, and partner with the CTO and CPO organisations so that every site turns up compute consistently. You will build the engineering function, its standards and its ways of working as Volta scales.

What You Will Do 

› Lead, develop and grow a team of infrastructure engineering SMEs across architecture, electrical, mechanical, cooling, structural, civil, controls and network infrastructure disciplines, building the capability to support a fast growing global pipeline

› Develop and deploy Volta's engineering design standards and specifications for AI factories, making sure they are applied consistently across every project and region

› Work with peers in the Design organisation to provide engineering input into Volta's Reference Design for AI factory infrastructure, balancing performance, cost, speed of delivery and scalability

› Support live projects with engineering expertise from concept through detailed design, construction and commissioning, resolving technical issues quickly so delivery is never held up

› Partner with the CTO and CPO organisations to align facility design with compute, rack and network requirements, enabling consistent turn up of compute across the portfolio

› Track the evolution of AI hardware, including rack densities, liquid cooling and power architectures, and translate it into design standards that keep Volta's AI factories ready for next generation compute

› Own engineering governance, including design reviews, technical assurance and design authority for any departure from standard

› Work with Procurement to standardise specifications for long lead equipment, enabling framework agreements, prefabrication and modular delivery at scale

› Champion safety in design, reliability, maintainability and energy and water efficiency, working with Operations to design for how our facilities will be run

› Embed lessons learned from delivery and operations back into the standards, so every AI factory builds faster, safer and more efficiently than the last

› Provide engineering status, risk and decision reporting to the VP, Development and Design and the executive team

What You Will Bring 

› A degree in electrical, mechanical, civil or building services engineering, with chartered or professional engineer status (for example CEng or PE) preferred

› Significant experience in data centre or mission critical infrastructure engineering, including senior leadership of multidisciplinary engineering teams

› Deep technical expertise in at least one core discipline, such as power distribution or cooling, and a strong working knowledge across all infrastructure disciplines

› A track record developing and deploying design standards, reference designs or basis of design documents for a hyperscale, colocation or large scale data centre developer

title: Real Estate Analyst
description:
Company Description 

We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. 

Role Description 
As a Real Estate Analyst at Checkout.com, you will provide dedicated administrative, data management, and operational support to the Head of Real Estate, focusing on mitigating risk and increasing efficiency across the global portfolio. This role is essential for managing high-risk operational tasks, such as lease event tracking, lease administration, budgeting and data reporting to ensure a structured approach and prevent critical errors.

Key Responsibilities 

1. Lease Administration & Governance 

- Proactively track, monitor, and manage critical dates for all lease events, including renewals and break clauses, acting as the primary conduit for populating and managing the tools that host our Real Estate data.

- Support the execution of Real Estate contracts by coordinating with Brokers, Procurement, Legal etc. to finalise signing, updating project budgets, and archiving completed agreements.

- Manage operational risk by ensuring all key details related to lease obligations are accurately recorded, tracked and action is taken.

- For business case generation, gather comparable evidence, property valuations, and market data to drive strategic negotiations.

- Liaise with regional, business and central teams to capture the justification and data necessary for business case approval.

- Manage subleasing activities, including monitoring sub-tenant compliance, tracking sublease income and key milestones, and coordinating with legal and property management teams.

2. Financial and Procurement Reporting 

- Coordinate with Finance, Tax and Procurement teams for Real Estate budgets, including updating and managing the Real Estate OPEX and CAPEX budget tracking tools.

- Act as the central point of contact for all property-related budget reporting, preparing quarterly reviews in a clear, digestible format that includes Real Estate and Workplace costs - giving an all inclusive cost per desk / square foot / head.

- Assist in reporting refurbishment or new office delivery costs, against business as usual spend for operational office locations.

- Support the coordination of financial and legal documentation required for transactions, such as preparing group structure charts and financials for external parties (e.g., landlords).

3. Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Data Collation 

- Lead the coordination and collection of energy, water, and utility consumption data across the global portfolio to support future CSR reporting requirements.

- Manage the challenge of obtaining utility data in co-working and serviced spaces where direct meter readings are complex, including liaising with local teams, operators and landlords to gather the necessary information.

- Act as the conduit between the CEO Office and ESG/CSR teams to ensure our portfolio meets the needs of Sustainability policies and or regulatory requirements.

4. Departmental Administrative Support 

- Assist in due diligence and preparation of business cases by researching and reporting on regional office statistics (e.g., desk counts, utilisation, attendance, capacity & commercials).

- Act as a key liaison for business case presentation and refinement.

- Maintain dynamic headcount forecasts to ensure space planning aligns with evolving business needs, particularly for high-growth regions.

- Monitor and document team shift patterns to inform workspace strategy (e.g., HVAC service requirements, after-hours access, and desk rotation models).

- Monitor and manage utilisation reports for Serviced Offices, along with onboard and offboard leaves to locations where we do not directly manage access control.

- Maintain the central digital repository for all property documentation (leases, contracts, floor plans, and insurance certificates), ensuring strict naming conventions, accessibility, and version control are met to ensure 100% audit-readiness.

- Schedule and prepare agendas, collate pre-read materials, and document meeting minutes for key real estate governance forums, proactively tracking action items to ensure timely closure by stakeholders.

- Managing the administrative aspects of the "joiner/leaver" process for office access where no assigned Workplace / People person is assigned.

- Act as the primary administrator for processing property-related invoices, performing the initial "first-pass" review to flag discrepancies against purchase orders (POs) and ensuring all costs are accurately coded before final submission to Finance.

5. Health, Safety & Physical Security Management 

- Coordinate the global H&S audit schedule in partnership with SMEs, managing the central audit database, evidence library, action log, and training records to track progress and compliance.

- Support the weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting framework to surface risk trends and audit completion status, allocating audits to regional teams for execution.

- Own the scheduling, chasing, and evidence trail for the audit lifecycle, acting as the primary administrative point of contact to ensure smooth execution.

- Drive the audit lifecycle by ensuring all actions are identified, triaged, and managed to resolution, proactively identifying blockers and managing overdue items.

- Ensure regional teams interpret and apply the central H&S framework in accordance with local laws while maintaining the global baseline standards.

- Manage the integration of the H&S framework with wider Real Estate RACI to ensure clear accountability and prevent overlaps in responsibilities.

- Implement and maintain physical security policies and standards across all global office locations.

- Instruct periodic physical security risk assessments and audits to identify vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with security protocols.

- Oversee visitor management processes and physical security measures to safeguard personnel and assets.

title: Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Industries
description:

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Nos clients Industries en France, Ibérie et Italie incluent de nombreuses plus grandes entreprises de la région dans les services financiers, santé et sciences de la vie, fabrication, télécommunications, commerce de détail, énergie et autres secteurs. Vous serez responsable de la direction et de la croissance de l’équipe d’architectes de solutions qui partenaire avec les directrices et directeurs de compte pour aider les entreprises à adopter et déployer les produits d’Anthropic, notamment Claude Cowork, Claude Code et la Plateforme de Développement Claude (notre API). Votre équipe couvre plusieurs pays et secteurs à la fois, vous serez donc responsable de la réflexion stratégique sur les comptes d’industrie complexes et de l’identification et du déploiement de solutions qui résonnent dans chaque marché, avec sa propre langue, sa culture métier et son contexte réglementaire.

Responsabilités

- Restiez à jour et informée en vous intéressant activement à la recherche émergente et aux tendances du secteur en IA

Les candidates et candidats solides pourraient avoir :

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description:
UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services . We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way. 

As a Microsoft Solutions Partner , with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. 

We are a certified B Corporation , upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.

✨ Our values 

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value: 

- Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables. 

- Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy. 

- Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients. 

🤝 The team 

You will join our Enterprise Customer Success team for the EMEA, APAC, and NA regions, a group of Customer Success Managers, each responsible for a focused portfolio of our largest and most strategic accounts. 

You will join a team of 6, including 5 CSMs and Majhon , Head of Customer Success Enterprise, who will support you in achieving your goals. You will also be part of a global Customer Success community across our five offices. 

Here is what the Go-To-Market organization looks like at UpSlide: 

- Account Executives: Prospect, acquire new business acquisition and expand existing accounts 

- Consultants: Lead implementation projects, deliver client training, and ensure successful deployment 

- Customer Success Managers: Own a portfolio of accounts end-to-end, driving retention, renewal signing, expansion within existing entities, value realization, and long-term account growth 

- Support Engineers : Resolve day-to-day technical questions and issues, and ensure a smooth customer experience 

🖋️ Your responsibilities 

As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will own the end-to-end relationship with a portfolio of our largest, most strategic accounts . You will build deep, multi-threaded relationships with key stakeholders, lead high-impact business reviews, and act as a trusted advisor, proactively protecting and growing revenue across your book through both retention and expansion. 

This is a role for someone who thrives on depth: fewer accounts, higher stakes, and the ability to build genuine, senior-level relationships that compound into long-term growth, while knowing how to sync with regional counterparts on accounts that span multiple geographies, keeping a global view of the relationship without owning every part of it directly. 

Account Ownership & Revenue Growth (50%) 

Own the business performance, strategy, and health of your portfolio of strategic accounts: 

- Take full ownership of your portfolio (ARR, NRR, renewal, risk level) 

- Build and execute structured, tailored account plans for 100% of your accounts, with clear growth and retention objectives 

- Proactively identify both expansion opportunities and churn risk through data analysis and direct relationship insight, and own them through to resolution or close 

- Monitor account health through usage data, adoption metrics, contact network and mapping, and stakeholder engagement 

- Maintain accurate forecasting (renewals, churn, upsell potential) and rigorous CRM discipline (Salesforce accuracy and completeness) 

Customer Value & Expertise (40%) 

Drive measurable value and position UpSlide as a strategic partner: 

- Lead high-impact Business Reviews focused on ROI and value realization 

- Lead complex or sensitive conversations (renegotiation, escalations, dissatisfaction) with confidence and clarity 

- Secure executive sponsors and build multi-threaded relationships within each account 

- Develop and maintain strong product expertise and a deep understanding of client industries and use cases 

- Craft value-driven narratives tailored to each stakeholder's priorities 

Cross-functional Collaboration (10%) 

Align with internal teams to maximize customer outcomes and business impact: 

- Partner with Sales on the account expansion strategy and account mapping 

- Collaborate with Professional Services when deeper deployment or training support is needed 

- Work closely with Product and Support to relay structured feedback and improve the customer experience 

- Coordinate with CSMs in other regions on shared or global accounts 

- Contribute to Customer Success best practices and performance improvement initiatives 

To work on these tasks, you will mainly use the following tools: Microsoft Office, UpSlide, Salesforce, Gong, PowerBI, and Notion (or local equivalents). 

⚡Your goals 

You will be assessed on: 

- Net Revenue Retention (NRR) 

- Churn 

- Expansion / upsell contribution 

- Depth and health of executive relationships across your portfolio 

- Ability to maintain full ownership and visibility on shared accounts 

You are a great fit if you have: 

- 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related client-facing/revenue role, including managing enterprise or large, multi-entity accounts in a B2B environment 

- Proven experience managing renewals and churn on strategic / enterprise accounts, with meaningful revenue responsibility 

- A proven track record of generating expansion (upsell/cross-sell) within an enterprise account base 

- Experience in autonomously managing a portfolio of large or multi-entity accounts with significant revenue responsibility 

- Confidence leading executive-level conversations, including complex or difficult ones (renegotiation, dissatisfaction, escalations) 

- Advanced negotiation skills 

- A structured, strategic approach to account planning (objectives, stakeholders, action plans) 

- A value- and ROI-oriented mindset, able to build and defend a business case with senior stakeholders 

- Operational rigor: accurate CRM data, reliable follow-up, dependable forecasting 

- Excellent written and verbal communication in English and French 

- Comfortable working in an international environment, engaging with senior and executive stakeholders 

We’d love it if you have: 

- Experience with a CRM / Customer Success platform (Salesforce, Planhat, or equivalent) and analytics / BI tools (PowerBI or equivalent) 

- Knowledge of the financial services/consulting sector 

- Experience managing group or multi-entity account structures 

- Familiarity with SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, churn, forecasting) and reporting to leadership 

- Fluency in another language (e.g. German) 

✨ If you don’t tick all the boxes but you think you’d be a great fit, please apply and tell us why. 

Recruitment process 

- Screening call with Talent Acquisition : A conversation to walk through your experience, motivation, and fit for the role. 

- Interview with your future manager and a team-meet : A deeper dive into your Customer Success experience and approach to account management. This also includes a live exercise reflecting real challenges of the role, followed by a conversation with members of the wider team. 

- Final conversation with leadership : A closing discussion to align on ambition, expectations, and next steps. 

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive. On average, our process lasts 3 weeks.

What we offer 

🌍 International environment: Start-up with five offices (Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore) and users in more than 60 countries 

🌱 Training & professional development: Collaboration with our sister company, IPH , which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management 

🎉 Company events: Office socials and international company events (e.g. annual company seminar, team seminar, and sustainability actions taken throughout the year) 

🏠 Beautiful office: Office near Opéra (1er arrondissement) – a vibrant space with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a nap room, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc. 

💻 Hybrid work: A policy adapted to each team’s rhythm 

🧑‍💻 Work-from-home budget: €500 WFH equipment budget 

💆‍♀️ Wellness package: 50€ per month for physical and mental wellness activities 

👶 Family support: 

- Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents 

- 4 days fully paid leave for sick children up to 6 years old or up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement 

- Flexible return to work options 

- An additional 5 days are fully paid within 6 months after becoming a parent 

✈️ Holidays: 25 vacation days and 9 RTT (with one taken for Solidarity Day) 

✅ General: 

- Meal vouchers (Tickets resto) : €11 per day on your Swile card (210 tickets per year) 

- Healthcare insurance (Mutuelle) : Covered by Alan. You can extend cover to your partner and children 

- Commute (Transports) : Metro, RER, bike, or e-scooter - These options are reimbursed 50% by UpSlide 

As a B Corp-certified company, we have strong commitments toward our employees, community, clients, suppliers, and the environment. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels welcome. This commitment to diversity and inclusion is applied in our recruitment process and your employee experience once you’ve joined UpSlide ✨

- Assurer le suivi opérationnel et commercial des magasins de votre portefeuille.

- Analyser quotidiennement les performances opérationnelles des magasins.

- Assurer la bonne adoption des produits Deliveroo (application de réception des commandes, outils marketing, portail partenaire, etc.)

- Paramétrer et mettre en place les campagnes marketing.

title: Senior Growth Manager - 60 à 75K package + BSPCE
description:
Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect 

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us ! 

- Discover our company culture and values 

- Here is a product teaser 

- Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle 

- Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest 

- Articles on our A round ( techfundingnews , Maddyness , les echos , our blog )

Context

Vocca builds AI voice agents for medical practices: they answer patient calls, book and reschedule appointments, and free up time for care teams. 250 healthcare organizations use Vocca today, and we are a team of 50+ across Paris and New York.

In France we sell to imaging centers, to networks and health centers, and to independent practices. We have tested many acquisition channels without measuring them properly, so we can't say which one works best or for which type of practice. Our website is made to be read: a visitor can't try the product, estimate a return on investment or compare us with the alternatives. In the US, paid acquisition starts from zero.

The target is set: 100 MQLs in Q4 2026, then +30% every quarter. We are hiring the person who will own that number. You report to Pierre, Head of Marketing.

Your mission

Build Vocca's inbound lead engine. You own paid acquisition and website conversion, in France first and then in the US, and you are accountable for the quarterly MQL target: 100 in Q4 2026 and about 285 per quarter by the end of 2027.

Expected outcomes

After 1 months: 

- Tracking and attribution work: every lead has a source and a cost, and can be followed in the CRM up to the signed deal

- Google Ads and Meta accounts audited and rebuilt, with campaigns live for each segment

- A first ranking of channels by cost per MQL, and budget moved accordingly

- The first conversion pages live on the website

After 3 months: 

- The quarterly MQL target is met and on the +30% trajectory

- Cost per MQL and MQL-to-opportunity rate known for each channel and segment

- ROI calculator, comparison pages and a way to try the product live on the website

- Email and SMS nurturing running on leads who are not ready to buy yet

- A tested approach to practitioner communities, starting with dentists' Facebook groups

After 9 months: 

- About 285 MQLs per quarter, close to three times the Q4 2026 level

- Paid acquisition live in the US, with a first read on cost per lead

- A channel mix the sales team trusts, with lead quality reviewed with them on a regular basis

What you will own

Paid acquisition (the core of the job) 

- Run the Google Ads and Meta campaigns yourself, and test other paid channels when the numbers justify it

- Own the budget: split it by segment and channel, and cut what doesn't convert

- Write and test ads and landing pages without waiting for a brief

- Open paid acquisition in the US

Website and conversion 

- Turn the website into something visitors can act on: ROI calculator, comparison pages, product trial, lead magnets

- Build and test landing pages for each segment and specialty

- Work with our web agency, which runs SEO and GEO, so that paid and organic use the same keywords and pages

Nurturing and communities 

- Run email and SMS campaigns to leads and prospects. RevOps owns the tools and the CRM sync, you own the messages and the calendar

- Join the communities where practitioners talk to each other and turn them into a source of leads

- Try new channels as they appear and drop them quickly when they don't pay

Measurement 

- Report cost per MQL, conversion to opportunity and revenue for each channel

- Agree with sales on what a qualified lead is, and review lead quality with them

- Tell the team every month where the next euro should go

This role is for you if

Must have: 

- 4 to 7 years in growth or performance marketing with paid acquisition as your strongest skill. You have run Google Ads and Meta accounts yourself, on real budgets, and you can show the results

- You are a generalist out of curiosity. Beyond ads, you have built landing pages, set up tracking and written email sequences, and you prefer learning a tool to briefing someone else on it

- Fluent French and professional English.

What we will assess: 

- Numbers: you think in cost per lead, conversion rate and payback, and you can explain a campaign you stopped and why

- Doing it yourself: you build the campaign, the page and the automation, with AI and no-code tools when they save time

- Curiosity: you test channels nobody asked you to test

- Ownership: you have one number, and you say so early when it is off track

- Closeness to sales: you care about what happens to a lead after the form is filled in

- B2B lead generation for a SaaS product, experience marketing to healthcare professionals or small businesses

- Nice to have: paid campaigns on the US market.

This role is NOT for you if

- You want to specialize in one channel and stay on it

- You manage agencies and freelancers and no longer operate the accounts yourself

- You are looking for a brand or content role

Compensation and benefits

- 60-75K package

- Equity (BSPCE)

- Executive contract (cadre) on a forfait-jours basis, with 8 to 12 RTT days per year

- Hybrid: 3 days per week at our Paris office

- MacBook provided

- Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company)

- Health insurance: 50% of Alan covered; public transport: 50% of Navigo covered; EGYM Wellpass

- Annual offsite and team events throughout the year

Hiring process

- Video call with our Head of Talent Acquisition (30 min)

- Video interview with Pierre, Head of Marketing (45 min)

- On site Technical interview: a paid acquisition case, with Pierre

- Interview with Eliott, CEO or Maxime Chief of Staff

- Reference checks

- Offer

We aim to keep the process within 30 days . You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca? 

- An entrepreneurial adventure , with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

- A product already live , with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

- A true scaling phase , with everything still to build

- Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles. 

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman : Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

title: People & Workplace Experience Manager
description:
About Dust 

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. 

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. 

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 .

The role 

Dust is growing fast, and we want every person who joins us to feel welcome, supported, connected and able to do their best work. As our People Experience Manager, you'll shape how people experience Dust, from their first day and the moments that bring us together to the way our offices in Paris, London, New York and San Francisco support the team.

We're looking for someone who is operationally excellent and creatively ambitious. You'll handle the details carefully, and you'll also look for ways to make the employee experience much better. One day you might be redesigning part of onboarding, the next planning a company offsite, acting on survey feedback, or working with a site lead to improve one of our offices. 

This role works as a partner across the company. You'll work most closely with People Operations, who lead on the core people processes. Together, you'll make sure the employee experience is well run behind the scenes and thoughtful in how people actually experience it. In Paris, you'll also work closely with our Office Manager, who runs our HQ on site and leads much of our day-to-day office life and events. In London, New York and San Francisco, you'll coordinate with local site leads. You'll also work with IT, Finance, Legal, Marketing, leadership and outside partners. Your guiding principle: consistency where it matters, local adaptation where it creates a better experience. 

What you will do: 

Own the employee journey 

- Own the onboarding experience end to end, working closely with our People Ops Specialist, from pre-boarding and equipment to first-day logistics and the first few weeks, so new joiners can contribute from day one in every location.

- Work with People Ops, IT, Finance, hiring managers, our Paris Office Manager and site leads so every handoff in the employee journey is smooth.

- Partner with People Ops and IT on offboarding, so people leave with the same care they got when they joined.

- Be a trusted point of contact for everyday employee questions and needs, and know when to bring in People Ops.

Build culture and community 

- Run and improve our team rituals, including weekly lunches, team drinks, dinners and company gatherings.

- Organise one or two company offsites or retreats each year.

- Create moments that help people connect, celebrate progress and feel they belong, across offices and time zones.

- Pay attention to the details that make experiences feel personal and inclusive, such as dietary needs, accessibility, preferences and team milestones.

- Partner with People and Marketing on selected external and brand-building events.

Listen and turn feedback into action 

- Build feedback loops (surveys, conversations, informal check-ins) to understand how people experience Dust.

- Turn what people tell us into concrete recommendations and visible improvements.

- Define and track simple, useful measures of employee and workplace experience.

- Communicate clearly and consistently about updates, events, practical information and team norms. Be assertive when needed.

Shape our workplaces 

- Make sure our offices are safe, welcoming, functional and ergonomic, and that they reflect how we want people to feel at Dust.

- Work with our office manager on day-to-day operations: supplies, maintenance, access, equipment and services.

- Manage workplace vendors, contracts and budget, and look for efficient ways to improve the experience.

- Spot operational needs early and fix issues before they disrupt anyone.

Scale the experience as Dust grows 

- Help shape how our physical, hybrid and digital environments evolve as the company grows.

- Set up simple, scalable processes and clear ownership across People, IT, Finance and Legal topics.

- Keep the employee experience personal and high quality without making it bureaucratic.

What success looks like 

After your first 100 days, you will have:

- Built a smooth, consistent onboarding experience for every new joiner, in every location.

- Delivered team rituals, events and offsites that strengthen connection and culture.

- Set up feedback loops and a practical set of metrics that guide People Experience decisions.

- Created well-run, welcoming offices where operational issues are handled quickly and proactively.

- Established clear processes and ownership across People, workplace, IT, Finance and Legal.

- Helped Dust grow its employee experience without it becoming bureaucratic or impersonal.

What we are looking for 

- 4+ years of experience in People Operations, People Experience, Workplace Experience in a fast growing, globally distributed environment

- A proactive generalist who can handle many kinds of work at once without losing sight of the bigger picture.

- Real ideas, sound judgement and the confidence to improve how things work today.

- Strong operational ownership, project management skills and attention to detail.

- Warmth, empathy and a genuine interest in helping people feel comfortable and connected.

- Clear, direct, thoughtful communication, and discretion with sensitive situations.

- Confidence working with vendors, budgets and outside partners.

- The ability to build simple processes that scale, and to keep a high bar for quality while staying pragmatic.

- Comfort with a fast-moving environment where priorities can change, working on your own while collaborating across the company.

Location 

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust 

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. 

Learn how we think and work. 

- Our product constitution, a story about our mission 

- Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human , Stanislas Polu , VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

- Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI , Gabriel Hubert , Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

Compensation: €55K – €65K • Offers Equity

title: Directeur de Projet DATA CENTER
description:
Direction de Projets – Ingénierie, Construction & Infrastructures Critiques 

1. Présentation du poste 

Intitulé : Directeur de Projet Data Center (Data Center Project Director)

Rattachement hiérarchique : Directeur des Opérations / Directeur de Programme / Direction Générale

Périmètre : France et International

Secteur : Data Centers – Infrastructures critiques – Construction – Ingénierie

2. Mission principale 

Le Directeur de Projet Data Center assure le pilotage stratégique, technique, opérationnel et financier de projets complexes de conception, de construction, d'extension ou de transformation de Data Centers.

Il garantit la bonne exécution des projets dans le respect des engagements contractuels, des budgets, des délais, des exigences de qualité, de sécurité, de performance énergétique et de disponibilité des infrastructures.

Il intervient sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des projets, depuis les études de faisabilité jusqu'à la réception des installations, leur mise en service et leur transfert aux équipes d'exploitation.

Véritable chef d'orchestre, il coordonne les différentes parties prenantes et assure l'interface entre la maîtrise d'ouvrage, la maîtrise d'œuvre, les bureaux d'études, les entreprises de construction, les fournisseurs et les exploitants.

3. Responsabilités principales 

A. Direction et pilotage stratégique des projets 

- Définir la stratégie globale d'exécution et les objectifs du projet.

- Piloter des projets de Data Centers neufs (Greenfield), d'extension ou de rénovation (Brownfield).

- Superviser toutes les phases du projet, de la faisabilité à la livraison.

- Définir les jalons, les livrables et les indicateurs de performance.

- Mettre en place la gouvernance et les instances de décision.

- Arbitrer les choix techniques, économiques et organisationnels.

- Anticiper les risques et définir les plans d'atténuation.

- Assurer le reporting auprès de la Direction Générale, des investisseurs et des clients.

B. Management technique et coordination des études 

Superviser et coordonner l'ensemble des disciplines techniques :

Électricité – Courants forts et faibles 

- Réseaux HTB/HTA/BT et postes de transformation.

- Tableaux électriques, TGBT et distribution électrique.

- Groupes électrogènes et systèmes d'alimentation secourue.

- Onduleurs (UPS), batteries et systèmes de distribution.

- Architectures de redondance N+1, 2N et autres configurations adaptées aux exigences de disponibilité.

- Coordination des protections électriques, sélectivité et continuité de service.

CVC – Refroidissement et traitement d'air 

- Production et distribution frigorifique.

- Groupes froids, free cooling et refroidissement adiabatique.

- CRAH, CRAC et Fan Walls.

- Systèmes de refroidissement liquide (Liquid Cooling).

- CDU et solutions de Direct-to-Chip Cooling.

- Optimisation des performances thermiques et énergétiques.

Bâtiment et infrastructures 

- Génie civil, structure et architecture.

- VRD et raccordements aux réseaux.

- Sécurité incendie et systèmes de détection/extinction.

- Contrôle d'accès, vidéosurveillance et sûreté physique.

- BMS, DCIM, GTB et supervision technique.

- Intégration des infrastructures IT et télécoms.

Assurer la cohérence technique des études, la gestion des interfaces et la conformité aux exigences contractuelles et réglementaires.

C. Pilotage des études et de la conception 

- Superviser les études de faisabilité et les avant-projets.

- Piloter les phases de conception selon les référentiels contractuels applicables, notamment RIBA 0 à 4 pour les projets concernés.

- Valider les choix architecturaux et techniques.

- Organiser les revues de conception et les analyses de risques.

- Superviser la coordination BIM et les études de synthèse.

- Garantir la constructibilité, la maintenabilité et l'exploitabilité des installations.

- Piloter les démarches de Value Engineering.

- Optimiser le CAPEX sans compromettre les exigences de performance et de résilience.

D. Direction de la construction et de l'exécution 

- Définir la stratégie de réalisation et le phasage des travaux.

- Superviser les entreprises générales, les lots techniques et les sous-traitants.

- Coordonner les équipes de maîtrise d'œuvre et de construction.

- Garantir le respect des plannings et des jalons contractuels.

- Piloter les interfaces entre génie civil, électricité, CVC et infrastructures IT.

- Superviser les procédures de contrôle qualité.

- Veiller au respect des exigences HSE.

- Gérer les modifications, non-conformités et situations critiques.

- Organiser les opérations préalables à la réception.

E. Gestion financière et contractuelle 

- Construire et piloter le budget global du projet.

- Superviser les engagements financiers et le suivi des dépenses.

- Piloter les CAPEX et les prévisions à terminaison (Estimate at Completion).

- Identifier les dérives budgétaires et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

- Superviser les consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

- Piloter les contrats de maîtrise d'œuvre, d'ingénierie, de construction et de fourniture.

- Gérer les avenants, réclamations contractuelles et risques financiers.

- Optimiser les coûts et préserver les marges du projet.

- Assurer un reporting financier fiable et régulier.

F. Commissioning et mise en service 

- Définir et superviser la stratégie de commissioning.

- Coordonner les essais des équipements et systèmes techniques.

- Superviser les essais fonctionnels et les essais intégrés (Integrated Systems Testing).

- Vérifier les scénarios de fonctionnement normal, dégradé et secouru.

- Piloter la levée des réserves et la clôture des non-conformités.

- Garantir la remise des DOE, procédures et documentations techniques.

- Organiser la formation des équipes d'exploitation.

- Superviser le transfert opérationnel vers les équipes Facilities Management et Data Center Operations.

G. Management des équipes et des parties prenantes 

- Encadrer les chefs de projet, Design Managers, Construction Managers et responsables techniques.

- Coordonner les bureaux d'études, consultants et partenaires.

- Définir les responsabilités et les objectifs des équipes.

- Animer les réunions de pilotage et les comités de direction.

- Développer une culture de performance, de sécurité et de collaboration.

- Gérer les situations conflictuelles et les arbitrages complexes.

- Assurer une communication structurée avec les clients et investisseurs.

4. Compétences techniques requises 

Ingénierie Data Center 

- Excellente compréhension des architectures électriques et mécaniques des Data Centers.

- Maîtrise des enjeux de disponibilité, de résilience et de redondance.

- Connaissance des référentiels EN 50600, ISO/IEC 22237, des exigences Uptime Institute et des recommandations ASHRAE applicables.

- Compréhension des contraintes liées aux infrastructures IT à haute densité.

- Connaissance des enjeux de performance énergétique, notamment PUE et WUE.

Gestion de projets complexes 

- Maîtrise des méthodes de planification et de gestion des risques.

- Pilotage de projets multidisciplinaires à forts enjeux financiers.

- Gestion contractuelle et financière.

- Maîtrise des processus de conception, construction et commissioning.

- Expérience des environnements EPC, EPCM, Design & Build ou maîtrise d'ouvrage.

Outils 

- Microsoft Project / Primavera P6.

- AutoCAD / Revit / Navisworks.

- Environnements BIM.

- Power BI et outils de reporting.

- Outils de suivi budgétaire et de gestion documentaire.

5. Profil recherché 

Formation 

- Diplôme d'ingénieur ou formation supérieure Bac+5 en génie électrique, énergétique, mécanique, bâtiment ou construction.

- Une spécialisation en infrastructures critiques ou Data Centers constitue un atout.

Expérience 

- Expérience professionnelle significative, idéalement 12 à 15 ans minimum, en gestion de projets techniques complexes.

- Expérience confirmée en direction de projets de construction ou d'ingénierie de Data Centers.

- Expérience dans la gestion de projets à budgets importants et équipes multidisciplinaires.

- Bonne connaissance des processus de conception, construction et mise en service.

- Expérience internationale appréciée.

Langues 

- Français courant.

- Anglais professionnel indispensable, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.

6. Compétences managériales et comportementales 

- Leadership et capacité à fédérer des équipes pluridisciplinaires.

- Vision stratégique et forte orientation résultats.

- Excellentes capacités d'analyse et de décision.

- Maîtrise des enjeux financiers et contractuels.

- Capacité à anticiper et à gérer les situations critiques.

- Rigueur, organisation et sens des responsabilités.

- Excellentes aptitudes relationnelles et de négociation.

- Capacité à communiquer avec des interlocuteurs techniques et exécutifs.

- Orientation client et culture de l'engagement.

7. Rémunération 

La rémunération proposée pour ce poste s'établit entre EUR 12,000 et 20,000 par mois.

title: Associate Team Lead - Customer Support (T2)
description:
Résumé 

Nous recherchons un(e) Associate Team Lead Support N2 / Chef(fe) d’équipe Support N2 pour rejoindre l’équipe Support Niveau 2 de Pennylane, au service des dirigeants d’entreprise et des cabinets comptables.

Pennylane est une plateforme de gestion financière et comptable qui accompagne les dirigeants d’entreprise et les cabinets d’expertise comptable dans leur quotidien. L’équipe Support Niveau 2 intervient sur les demandes les plus complexes ou nécessitant une expertise métier et produit approfondie, en lien avec les équipes Support Niveau 1, Support Technique, Produit et Tech.

Ce rôle est un poste de management de proximité : tu seras le relais opérationnel du Team Lead Support N2 et accompagneras une équipe de 6 à 12 agents au quotidien pour leur permettre de répondre aux utilisateurs avec efficacité, qualité et empathie. Tu contribueras également au pilotage de l’activité, à l’amélioration continue du support et à des projets transverses.

Notre culture 

Au sein du Support, nous valorisons la transparence, la bonne ambiance, l’entraide et la résilience .

Nous restons proches de la réalité de nos utilisateurs, notamment des dirigeants d’entreprise et des professionnels de la comptabilité, afin de traiter chaque demande avec expertise métier, maîtrise du produit et empathie. Cette approche s’inscrit dans la culture Pennylane de Supporting SMEs et de proximité avec les utilisateurs.

Nous encourageons le feedback dans les deux sens, le développement de chacun et la prise d’initiative. Nous accordons de l’importance à l’autonomie, à la responsabilité et à la confiance, dans l’esprit de Community of Builders et de Radical Trust .

Concrètement, ton quotidien ressemblera à ça 

- Animer les points d’équipe et suivre la charge quotidienne.

- Accompagner les agents sur leurs tickets, leurs priorités et leurs situations complexes.

- Réaliser des écoutes ou analyses de conversations pour donner du feedback constructif.

- Suivre les indicateurs de performance et de qualité de l’équipe, comme le temps de première réponse, le temps de résolution, la satisfaction client et le volume de tickets traités.

- Participer aux rituels de pilotage opérationnel : suivi de la charge, priorisation des demandes, identification des alertes et coordination avec les autres équipes Support.

- Remonter les irritants utilisateurs aux équipes Produit, Tech ou Ops.

- Contribuer à améliorer les process, la documentation et les outils internes.

Responsabilités 

- Manager une équipe de 6 à 12 agents sous la supervision du Team Lead Support N2, en les accompagnant dans leur activité quotidienne, leur progression et leur épanouissement professionnel.

- Donner des feedbacks clairs, réguliers et transparents, réaliser des écoutes et analyses de conversations, suivre les bilans et plans d’accompagnement individuels, proposer des coachings et identifier les besoins de formation.

- Suivre les indicateurs de l’équipe et contribuer à la qualité du support, notamment le temps de première réponse, la satisfaction client, le temps de résolution, le volume traité, la prise en charge des nouveaux tickets et le suivi des tickets en cours.

- Participer aux rituels de pilotage et à la gestion des files de demandes communes, notamment lors des rotations de permanence, en identifiant les alertes et en remontant les besoins de renfort ou d’arbitrage.

- Être force de proposition pour optimiser les process, les outils, la documentation et les modes de fonctionnement du Support.

- Collaborer avec les équipes support de niveau 1, l’équipe technique, les équipes opérationnelles ainsi que les équipes produit et tech, faire remonter les irritants utilisateurs et contribuer aux projets transverses.

- Partager les bonnes pratiques avec les autres Associate Team Leads et contribuer à maintenir une communication fluide au sein du Support.

- Prendre ponctuellement en charge des demandes internes urgentes ou des situations complexes nécessitant l’expertise du Support Niveau 2, en sachant orienter ou escalader lorsque cela est nécessaire.

Ce poste est fait pour toi si 

- Tu aimes accompagner une équipe et faire progresser les autres.

- Tu sais garder du recul dans des situations opérationnelles parfois urgentes.

- Tu es à l’aise avec les indicateurs, tout en gardant toujours en tête la qualité de l’expérience utilisateur.

- Tu sais communiquer avec clarté, même quand les sujets sont complexes.

- Tu as envie de contribuer à structurer une équipe Support dans un environnement en forte évolution.

Qualifications 

- Diplôme Bac+2 ou Bac+3 minimum en comptabilité, management ou dans un domaine équivalent.

- Expérience d’au moins 1 an en management ou en accompagnement d’équipe, idéalement dans le secteur du support.

- Bonne capacité à analyser une situation, prendre une décision mesurée et proposer des solutions concrètes.

- Excellentes capacités de communication et de collaboration, avec assertivité et diplomatie.

- Goût pour le feedback, la pédagogie et l’accompagnement individuel.

- Aisance avec les outils informatiques, notamment les outils de ticketing et de documentation comme Intercom, Zendesk ou Notion.

- Capacité à s’adapter à un environnement en évolution rapide.

- Sens du service et attention portée à l’expérience utilisateur.

Les nice to have 

Ces éléments sont un plus, mais ne sont pas indispensables si tu as une forte appétence pour le support, le management de proximité et l’apprentissage produit/métier.

- Connaissances en comptabilité.

- Expérience préalable en tant que contributeur individuel au sein d’une équipe Support.

- Expérience dans un environnement SaaS ou start-up.

- Expérience dans le management d’une équipe principalement à distance.

- Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes Produit, Tech ou Ops.

- Anglais niveau B1 minimum.

- Utilisation de l’IA pour optimiser ses tâches.

Modalités pratiques 

- Tu reporteras au Team Lead Support N2.

- Le rôle combine management de proximité, pilotage opérationnel et contribution ponctuelle sur des situations complexes ou urgentes.

- L’équipe collabore principalement en français, avec des interactions possibles en anglais selon les sujets et les équipes.

You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Notre vision 

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane 

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ? 

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière.

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et de cabinets à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 

3 premiers mois :

- Tu te formes sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

4 à 6 mois :

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

Et ensuite... :

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.

- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

Compétences requises 

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul(e) et à trouver des solutions.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

title: DIGITAL & B2B MARKETING MANAGER H/F - CDI
description:
Chez Mistertemp’ Group, nous allions innovation digitale et proximité locale pour révolutionner le monde du recrutement (intérim, CDD, CDI). Présents en France, en Italie, en Espagne et au Canada, nous sommes fiers de figurer parmi les 12 startups HR Tech les plus innovantes en France et d’être lauréats des prestigieux French Tech 120 et Next 40. 

Grâce à notre plateforme technologique de pointe et à notre réseau de 250 agences, nous poursuivons une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen du recrutement. Pour relever ce défi, nous recherchons des talents créatifs, curieux et passionnés, prêts à évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et en constante transformation. 

Si ces valeurs vous inspirent et résonnent avec vos aspirations professionnelles, rejoignez l’aventure ! Nous recherchons un(e) Digital & B2B Marketing Manager (H/F) pour renforcer nos équipes au sein de notre siège basé à Clichy. 

Vos deux objectifs business 

- Générer davantage de RDV qualifiés pour les équipes Grands Comptes 

● Concevoir et opérer des dispositifs d'acquisition et de génération de leads B2B pour alimenter les équipes commerciales Grands Comptes.

● Mobiliser les leviers digitaux au service de la prise de RDV : SEO/contenu, campagnes, landing pages, nurturing, social selling…

● Piloter la qualification et le suivi des leads jusqu'au RDV, en lien avec les outils CRM (Salesforce).

● Suivre la contribution du marketing au nombre et à la qualité des RDV, et optimiser le coût et le taux de conversion.

● Travailler en collaboration avec les équipes Sales concernées, de la conception à l’optimisation des actions.

2. Développer le business des agences du réseau (250 agences) 

● Animer le réseau et outiller les agences pour booster leur prospection de clients PME : kits et supports marketing, méthodes, temps forts.

● Concevoir des opérations marketing à décliner localement, en lien avec les Directeurs de Développement (animateurs réseau), pour aider les agences à générer plus de RDV et de business localement.

● Mesurer l'impact des dispositifs sur le business des agences et les ajuster selon les retours terrain.

Sujets transverses 

Présence digitale du groupe 

● Piloter les sites du groupe et mener le projet de refonte.

● Définir et déployer la stratégie SEO/GEO et d'optimisation de la conversion.

● Gérer la présence sur les plateformes d'avis (Google, Trustpilot…) et les autres points de contact digitaux, et piloter la performance web.

Référent IA du pôle Marketing / Communication 

● Identifier et déployer des cas d'usage IA (via Claude principalement) pour optimiser les actions Marketing et Communication.

● Intégrer l'IA dans les process quotidiens du pôle et conduire une veille structurée sur les usages.

Pilotage & mesure de la performance 

● Définir les indicateurs clés et produire les reportings de performance des actions marketing et communication.

● Réaliser des analyses de données internes et de marché pour éclairer les décisions, gérer les enquêtes de satisfaction clients et agences, et assurer une veille concurrentielle.

Projets transverses & budget 

● Coordonner des projets transverses avec les équipes internes (Sales, Produit, Data, IT…).

● Gérer et suivre le budget marketing digital.
