title: Teamleider Integraal Archiefbeheer
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Wil jij een team verder helpen groeien en bijdragen aan betrouwbaar archiefbeheer binnen de Rijksoverheid? Als Teamleider Integraal Archiefbeheer geef je leiding aan ongeveer 15 medewerkers. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat belangrijke overheidsinformatie veilig wordt bewaard, goed vindbaar blijft en zorgvuldig wordt beheerd.

Je combineert aandacht voor mensen met kennis van archiefbeheer. Je helpt collega's zich ontwikkelen, verbetert werkprocessen en begeleidt veranderingen.

Je werkzaamheden zijn onder andere:

- Medewerkers begeleiden, coachen en stimuleren in hun ontwikkeling.

- De kwaliteit, planning en resultaten van het team bewaken.

- Kennisdeling organiseren tussen collega's met verschillende ervaringsniveaus.

- Werkprocessen verbeteren en nieuwe technologie toepassen waar dat waarde toevoegt.

- Samenwerken met andere afdelingen en organisaties binnen de Rijksoverheid.

- Meedenken over de toekomst van de afdeling en bijdragen aan belangrijke beslissingen.

Uniek aan deze baan

In deze functie krijg je de ruimte om echt verschil te maken. Je bouwt aan een team waarin ervaring, nieuwe ideeën en samenwerking samenkomen.

Je krijgt daarnaast:

- Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4.132 en € 6.275 bij 36 uur.

- Een Individueel Keuzebudget van 16,5% van je bruto jaarsalaris.

- Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.

- Mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

- Een volledige vergoeding van je woonwerkverkeer met het openbaar vervoer.

Je werkt minimaal vier dagen per week op locatie. Zo blijf je betrokken bij je team en de dagelijkse werkzaamheden.

Wie zijn we?

De Rijksorganisatie voor Informatiehuishouding (RvIHH) is onderdeel van het ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.

Wij helpen organisaties binnen de Rijksoverheid om informatie goed te bewaren, te beheren en toegankelijk te houden. Dat doen we met diensten zoals archiefopslag, digitaal informatiebeheer en ondersteuning bij digitale werkprocessen.

Binnen de afdeling Integraal Archiefbeheer werken collega's met uiteenlopende kennis en ervaring samen. We leren van elkaar, delen ideeën en zoeken voortdurend naar manieren om onze dienstverlening te verbeteren.

Je maakt deel uit van het managementteam en denkt mee over de ontwikkeling van de hele afdeling.

Wat neem je mee?

Je vindt het leuk om mensen te begeleiden en samen resultaten te bereiken. Je communiceert duidelijk, luistert naar verschillende ideeën en helpt collega's om veranderingen met vertrouwen aan te pakken.

Voor deze functie zijn de volgende kennis en vaardigheden waardevol:

- Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau.

- Ervaring met leidinggeven, coaching en teamontwikkeling.

- Kennis van archiefwetgeving en recordmanagement: het beheren van documenten en informatie.

- Inzicht in het verbeteren van processen en dienstverlening.

- Het vermogen om resultaten te beoordelen en verbeteringen door te voeren.

- Interesse in technologische ontwikkelingen en hun invloed op het werk.

Herken je jezelf in veel van deze punten, maar niet allemaal? We nodigen je graag uit om te solliciteren. Jouw motivatie, inzichten en ontwikkelbereidheid zijn belangrijk.

title: Freelance Back End / Typescript Developer
description:
At Schuberg Philis, we build mission-critical IT solutions that power some of the most essential operations of our clients. Reliability, craftsmanship, and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do. We are looking for a Senior Freelance TypeScript Software Engineer who enjoys designing and building resilient, high-performance systems that have a direct impact on large-scale operational processes.

As part of our team, you will help shape the future of critical digital infrastructures, working on complex challenges where software quality, scalability, and reliability truly matter.

We are looking for a Senior Freelance Software Engineer with an open mind and a genuine passion for software architecture. Together with our customers, we solve a wide range of challenges, from creating more user-friendly online banking platforms and designing business-critical portals and backend systems, to making industrial environments smarter through the combination of cloud technologies and IoT.

For this specific project, you will work closely with developers and architects to design and build software that connects operator- and customer-facing hardware with a large-scale backend platform supporting parcel logistics operations across an international network of hubs. The platform powers critical parcel handling processes throughout Europe and beyond, serving as a key component in the global logistics chain.

The platform enables parcel intake, sorting, routing, and grouping processes across distribution hubs. It actively interacts with parcels in real time, processing events generated by scanners, handheld devices, and automated sorting systems. Every parcel moving through the network is represented and tracked by the platform, making it one of the most visible and operationally critical systems within the organization.

For this assignment, we are specifically looking for freelance professionals. We offer an initial 6-month contract with the possibility of extension, providing the opportunity to contribute to the continued evolution of a mission-critical platform operating at international scale.

Our ideal colleague brings:

- 5-7+ years of professional software development experience

- Strong experience designing and building microservices and event-driven architectures in cloud environments

- Proven experience developing backend solutions with TypeScript and Node.js

- Hands-on experience building serverless applications on AWS, particularly with services such as AWS Lambda and DynamoDB

- The ability to write high-quality, maintainable, reusable, and well-tested code

- Experience working with large-scale distributed systems processing high volumes of real-time operational events

- Experience with CI/CD pipelines, such as GitHub Actions, and modern cloud-native development practices

- Experience integrating services and APIs within complex enterprise environments

title: Platform Engineer
description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car , a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton , Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe , we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

- Taking ownership and driving impact 

- Being open to change and feedback

- Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Your Mission 

At Catawiki, our Platform Horizontal has evolved from solely managing the cloud into a broad function supporting Reliability, Developer Experience, Security, and Quality. We take a holistic approach to creating systems and tools that help developers deliver applications seamlessly and reliably without getting bogged down in infrastructure complexity.
As a Platform Engineer , you’ll work at the intersection of development, infrastructure, and operations. You’ll help shape and execute our long-term platform vision, empowering Catawiki teams to deliver value to customers with speed, reliability, and security.

What You'll Do 

You’ll build and improve the platform capabilities that enable our engineering teams to develop, deploy, and operate applications effectively at scale.

- Build a self-service developer platform with a particular emphasis on developer experience, designing and maintaining platforms that abstract complexity and give teams the tools to deploy, monitor, and optimise their applications.

- Orchestrate cloud-native infrastructure , manage Kubernetes clusters and other cloud resources, focusing on performance, scalability, and cost efficiency through FinOps practices.

- Boost developer productivity by building and enhancing CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and reusable templates that accelerate development and deployment cycles.

- Drive reliability and scalability through applying practices for fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and scaling so applications run smoothly under changing conditions.

- Improve platform operations usage and enhance our observability stack to monitor platform health and resolve incidents proactively.

- Collaborate and innovate by partnering with product teams to understand their needs, build simple and impactful solutions, and champion cloud-native best practices across Catawiki.

What You'll Bring 

You measure what matters, introduce changes gradually, and treat failure as a normal part of learning. You use tooling and automation wherever possible to reduce toil, and enjoy sharing knowledge with others.

- Cloud-native expertise : At least 5 years of production experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.

- Automation mindset : Experience automating workflows and CI/CD pipelines and working with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.

- Observability experience : Hands-on experience using and maintaining tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or OpenTelemetry to improve reliability and performance.

- Strong ownership : You proactively address platform issues and work toward long-term scalability and resilience.

- Collaborative approach: You work effectively with developers and cross-functional teams to align goals and deliver impactful yet simple solutions.

- Continuous learning : You keep developing your knowledge of cloud-native tools, technologies, and practices in a fast-moving ecosystem.

How We Work 

The Platform Horizontal supports engineering teams across Catawiki by reducing infrastructure complexity and providing reliable, secure, and scalable foundations.

- We collaborate closely with product teams to understand their challenges and improve their development experience.

- We favour self-service capabilities, reusable solutions, automation, and measurable, gradual improvements.

- We share knowledge and treat reliability, security, quality, and developer experience as shared responsibilities.

Where You'll Be 

This is a Hybrid role based in Amsterdam. You will work from our Amsterdam HQ a minimum of 2 days per week. 
This role is open to candidates worldwide. For selected candidates, Catawiki can provide visa sponsorship and relocation support to the relevant location , subject to eligibility and applicable restrictions.

In Return 

You’ll be part of an enthusiastic, highly motivated team of 800+ Catawikians. 

- A competitive Annual Gross Base Salary depending on your level, competencies, and overall experience.

- A Work From Home Allowance to help with your monthly household bills.

- Commuting between your home and our office is covered by Catawiki.

- Amazing Office right in the centre of Amsterdam.

Why You'll Love Working with Us 

- Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.

- Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.

- A culture of connection defines us . We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.

- Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion ” . We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working 

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested? 

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support the review of your application. AI may help us assess how your experience matches the requirements of the role, but hiring decisions are always made by our recruitment team

description:
Utrecht | Strategisch leiderschap | 38,75 uur 

Maak het verschil als managing director bij Berenschot 

Nederland staat voor één van de grootste transities van deze generatie. De energietransitie, de druk op de leefomgeving, netcongestie, woningbouw, stikstof, klimaatadaptatie en ruimtelijke ordening vragen om nieuwe vormen van samenwerking tussen overheid, bedrijfsleven en maatschappelijke organisaties. Al 85 jaar helpt Berenschot als toonaangevend adviesbureau opdrachtgevers om in complexiteit richting te bepalen en resultaten te realiseren. Als managing director Energie & Leefomgeving speel je hierin een sleutelrol. Je bepaalt mede de koers van onze grootste maatschappelijke adviespraktijken en draagt bij aan de toekomst van Nederland. Heb jij ervaring in een van deze domeinen in de consultancy of als leidinggevende bij een van onze opdrachtgevers? Heb jij een sterk netwerk op C-level en ben je commercieel gedreven zonder de maatschappelijke opgave uit het oog te verliezen? Dan is dit jouw kans om het verschil te maken als managing director Energie & Leefomgeving bij Berenschot. 

Dit ga je doen 

Als managing director en tevens lid van het mt draag je actief bij aan de (uitvoering van de) strategie van Berenschot en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de strategierealisatie en financiële prestaties van de adviesgroep Energie & Leefomgeving (E&L). Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor een van de grootste adviesgroepen binnen Berenschot met circa zeventig professionals en een substantiële omzetbijdrage aan de groep. Je leidt het E&L-managementteam met vijf teamleads en draagt bij aan de verdere positionering en groei van Berenschot in de betreffende domeinen, voortbouwend op onze sterke reputatie. Je geeft richting aan de volgende groeifase binnen energie en leefomgeving, inspelend op de veranderende markt, waarin ook digitalisering en realisatie steeds belangrijker worden. Het zwaartepunt ligt hierbij op het goed positioneren van de adviesgroep Energie & Leefomgeving bij onze klanten buiten en het intern leiden van de E&L-teams naar de volgende fase. 

- Je hebt een heldere visie op de ontwikkelingen in de energiesector en de leefomgeving. Je kent onze opdrachtgevers, begrijpt hun vraagstukken en vertaalt dit samen met je teams naar een scherpe strategische koers, met commerciële kansen buiten en een strategisch personeelsplan binnen. 

- Je ondersteunt marktteams bij het ontwikkelen van nieuwe business en initieert, ontwikkelt en realiseert omvangrijke adviesopdrachten en strategische samenwerkingen. 

- Je onderhoudt en versterkt relaties op C-level binnen relevante klantsegmenten voor E&L: (netbeheerders, energieproducenten, warmtebedrijven, ministeries van EZK, IenW en LVVN, provincies en waterschappen). 

- Je bent een gezaghebbende gesprekspartner binnen het publieke debat op ten minste een van de proposities van E&L en begrijpt de context van het gehele veld, waarbinnen E&L opereert. Je vertegenwoordigt Berenschot in bestuurlijke netwerken, media, congressen en vakinhoudelijke platforms. 

- Je geeft niet alleen richting aan de groep met haar diverse teams, maar bouwt met de groep aan de volgende fase van E&L. 

- Je bent zichtbaar en benaderbaar op de werkvloer en legt verbinding. Je ondersteunt teamleads en professionals en daagt hen uit in hun ontwikkeling. 

- Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het opstellen en realiseren van een begroting, stuurt op declarabiliteit, bezettingsgraad en rendement. 

Als lid van het Berenschot-mt beïnvloed je niet alleen de ontwikkeling van de adviesgroep Energie & Leefomgeving, maar draag je medeverantwoordelijkheid voor de strategische koers, groei en cultuur van Berenschot als geheel. 

Dit neem je mee 

Je bent een zeer ervaren en bewezen succesvolle adviseur en/of leidinggevende met een scherp strategisch inzicht en een intrinsieke motivatie om bij te dragen aan de transities waaraan Energie & Leefomgeving werkt. 

De ideale kandidaat voor de functie: 

- Heeft een afgeronde universitaire masteropleiding. 

- Beschikt over minimaal vijftien jaar relevante werkervaring als adviseur, leidinggevende of eindverantwoordelijke manager binnen consultancy, overheid, energie, infrastructuur of leefomgeving en heeft affiniteit met de maatschappelijke opgaven waaraan we werken. 

- Heeft commerciële slagkracht en een stevig netwerk binnen de domeinen van de adviesgroep Energie & Leefomgeving. Je hebt aantoonbare succesvolle ervaring in het initiëren, ontwikkelen en realiseren van omvangrijke adviesopdrachten en strategische samenwerkingen. 

- Kent de dynamiek van een professional services firm, is energiek en weet kortetermijndynamiek te verbinden met een langetermijnontwikkeling. 

- Heeft innovatiekracht en is ondernemend ingesteld. Je bent een positief-kritische en strategische sparringpartner die op nieuwe zaken durft te anticiperen en vanuit helicopterview zaken verder weet te brengen. 

- Voelt zich thuis in complexe en uitdagende opdrachten op hoog bestuurlijk/ambtelijk niveau, heeft een proactieve houding, gevoel voor sociale processen en kan goed samenwerken. 

- Heeft bewezen leiderschapskwaliteiten in een professionele en bij voorkeur ook commerciële kennisomgeving. Je hebt flair, toont lef en daadkracht, en blijft daarbij in verbinding met de organisatie en betrokken opdrachtgevers. 

- Bent zichtbaar en benaderbaar voor professionals. Je weet talent aan je te binden en creëert verbinding in het E&L-managementteam en met professionals in de organisatie. Je motiveert en creëert draagvlak; niet vanuit macht maar vanuit natuurlijke verbinding. 

- Stimuleert samenwerking tussen disciplines en zoekt actief samenwerking op met collega-MD’s. 

Dit zijn je directe collega’s 

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Berenschot kenmerkt zich door een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. 

Dit bieden we jou 

Berenschot is een informele, slagvaardige organisatie met korte communicatielijnen waar er echt naar je wordt geluisterd. Er zijn volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele groei waarbij jouw initiatief wordt omarmd en gefaciliteerd. Je hebt hier de vrijheid om te ondernemen. Ons inclusieve personeelsbeleid omarmt diversiteit en biedt iedereen gelijke kansen.

Je komt in een betrokken en ambitieus team, dat aan de meest relevante maatschappelijke opgaven en transities werkt in de energiesector en in de leefomgeving. Je landt in een steward owned organisatie die altijd streeft naar maatschappelijke impact. Een organisatie waarin je ruimte krijgt om te ondernemen en om zelf initiatieven te ontwikkelen. 

Natuurlijk hebben we daarnaast ook uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden en geweldige ontwikkelmogelijkheden: 

• Een vast jaarinkomen ligt tussen de € 135K-€ 180K, afhankelijk van ervaring. 

• Een variabele beloning (bonusregeling), afhankelijk van prestaties. 

• Een winstdelingsregeling. 

• Een representatievergoeding. 

• 27 vakantiedagen. 

• Een mobiliteitsbudget waarbinnen je onder andere een auto kunt leasen. 

• Een uitstekende pensioenregeling. 

• Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken. 

• Een positie in een betrokken en ambitieus team. 

• Een organisatie waarin je ruimte krijgt om te ondernemen en zelf initiatieven te ontwikkelen. 

Solliciteer meteen 

Wil jij ook impact maken bij Berenschot? Stuur ons dan zo snel mogelijk, maar uiterlijk 1 november 2026, jouw cv en motivatie. Solliciteer eenvoudig via onderstaande solliciteerbutton. Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over de functie, neem dan contact op met Madelon van den Hoven (hr-manager ) of Marinke Wijngaard (directeur ). 

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit 

Na je sollicitatie ontvang je binnen enkele dagen een reactie. Bij een positieve uitkomst nodigen we je uit voor een kennismaking met collega’s uit jouw team en je toekomstige manager. De gesprekken vinden plaats vanaf 9 november 2026. Als de gesprekken goed verlopen, volgt er een assessment. Blijkt daaruit dat jij een echte Berenschotter bent? Dan doen we je een concreet aanbod. Hierna heten we je graag welkom in ons team.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
About Doit 

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe. 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. 

The Role 

Doit builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Lead Software Engineer owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems . This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

What You'll Own 

- Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

- Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

- Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

- Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

- Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

- Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

- Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

What We're Looking For 

- 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

- Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

- Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

- Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

- Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

- Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

Nice to have 

- Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

- Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

Location 

This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language 

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process 

Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Technical Product Manager - AI Finance App
description:
About KIRA 

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

What You'll Own

- Own a vertical end-to-end - outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

- Shape the technical design with engineering - system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

- Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX - and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

- Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs - licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

- Apply AI where it earns its place - define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

- Ship against external gates - build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

- Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation

What We're Looking For

- Product leadership - significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

- Technical foundation - solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

- Domain - experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

- AI judgement - hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

- Nice to have - engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcome

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description:
About Doit 

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe. 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. 

The Role 

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Neobank App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own 

- Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

- Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

- Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

- Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

- Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

- Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

- Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.

What We're Looking For 

- Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

- Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

- Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

- Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

- Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

- Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

- Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want 

- Can set direction and still go deep into details.

- Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

- Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

- Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

- Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.

This Role Is Not For 

- Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

- People who cannot go deep into product details.

- Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

- Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

- People who need large teams before they can create progress.

Location

Language 

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

title: Senior Events Growth Manager
description:
About Platform Engineering

Platform Engineering ( platformengineering.org ) is home to the world's largest community of platform engineers. Through PlatformCon and AgenticCon, one of the world's largest conferences dedicated to platform engineering, we bring together thousands of platform engineers, platform leaders every year. Alongside our events, we run a university, a newsletter read by hundreds of thousands of engineers, and Weave Intelligence, our research arm.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Events Growth Marketing Manager to own registration and attendance growth across our entire events portfolio. That starts with our flagship conferences, PlatformCon and AgenticCon, the biggest conferences in the platform engineering world, which travel to San Francisco, London, Sydney, New York and Berlin, and extends to our roadshows, roundtables, workshops, House of Kube (the largest party in the cloud native world) and the satellite events we run in cities around major conferences such as AWS re:Invent, KubeCon and Google Cloud Next. Your goal is to bring platform engineering leaders into the room and keep them coming back. This is a systems and relationships role, not a one off campaign role. You’ll build the growth loops, the audience, and the repeatable playbook needed to fill these events and drive high attendance every time. You’ll report to the Head of Growth.

What you'll do

- Own registration and attendance growth for PlatformCon and AgenticCon ticket sales, and for every other event we run, across San Francisco, London, Sydney, New York, Berlin and Amsterdam.

- Build growth loops and long term relationships with the platform engineering community, its practitioners and its leaders, so we have an audience to pull from in every city.

- Own our event pages on Luma and the end to end campaigns that fill them.

- Plan campaigns designed for a high attendance rate, so the right people do not just register but actually show up.

- Use HubSpot and Luma to build and target the right audience segments for each event.

- Collaborate with design team to ensure high quality event pages and with content for strong copy and assets.

- Brief and work with our performance marketing and lifecycle managers to get paid and email support behind each event.

- Build the systems and the playbook that let us fill these events repeatedly, so the approach compounds instead of starting from scratch each time.

What success looks like

Within your first 90 days, we want you to come back to us with a proposed playbook: how we should run our in person events, and the exact workflow you would follow every time a new event brief lands, from audience to event page to campaigns to attendance. By 180 days, we want that playbook proven on live events, with a rising attendance rate and a reusable audience building in each city.

What you'll bring

- A systems thinker who works in growth loops, not one off tactics.

- Experience in B2B SaaS marketing. Even better if you have worked somewhere whose core business is running events.

- A track record of building and growing audiences and driving real attendance at in person events, not just registrations.

- Strong hands on experience with CRM tools such as HubSpot for segmentation and targeting.

- Comfort running social campaigns and briefing paid campaigns.

- The ability to work independently with complete ownership, and to build a repeatable system rather than firefighting each event.

- Work closely with the design team to produce strong event visuals, both for our Luma pages and website pages, so every event looks as good as it performs.

- Comfortable with occasional travel to our event cities when an event calls for it.

Nice to have

- Experience with Luma as an event platform.

- Experience marketing events for a company whose primary business is events.

You do not need experience with data or automation tooling such as zapier, n8n or similar data flow systems. Our ops team supports all of that.

Why join us?

We run the biggest and most influential events in the platform engineering world. PlatformCon and AgenticCon are the flagship conferences of the entire space, and they travel to San Francisco, London, Sydney, New York and Berlin, alongside a full calendar of roadshows, executive roundtables, AI Platform Leaders events and House of Kube, the largest party in the cloud native world. These rooms bring together senior platform and engineering leaders from some of the biggest companies on the planet, including many from the S&P 500. You would own the growth of all of it end to end, with the mandate to build the audience and the playbook that make these events repeatable, and direct access to the Head of Growth and the wider leadership team.

title: Strategy Lead - Acquisition
description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Acquisition Strategy and Tech team is the integrated growth engine for iwoca in Germany. We bridge the gap between high-level commercial strategy and the technical systems that power our customer journey. By combining growth analytics, performance modeling, and full-stack engineering, we own the end-to-end acquisition funnel – from the very first touchpoint to a completed loan application. Our Core Focus:

Strategic Growth & Analytics: We serve as the central hub for our Direct Marketing and Sales channels. We translate complex data into actionable strategies, ensuring our outreach is both scalable and profitably managed.

Technical Infrastructure: We build and maintain the proprietary systems and models that drive our German operations. This includes optimizing the "User Experience" (UX) to ensure a frictionless onboarding process for small businesses.

Operational Excellence: We connect the dots between data-driven decision-making and real-world commercial impact. Our mission is to ensure every potential customer receives a clear, relevant, and rapid understanding of how iwoca can fund their business.

We are a fast-moving, cross-functional unit designed to turn strategic hypotheses into measurable results. Whether it’s refining a marketing model or shipping a new feature in the application journey, we ensure that iwoca’s expansion in the German market is backed by robust tech and a clear commercial North Star.

The role

This role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, data, and technology. Reporting into the Head of Direct Acquisition, you will lead a high-performing, interdisciplinary team of three and own acquisition and activation outcomes for the German market. Your primary objective is to co-define the growth strategy and partner closely with engineering and data teams to build the systems, onboarding journeys, and experiments that bring that strategy to life.

The scope of this role is broad and we're not looking for someone with deep expertise in every domain the team covers – spanning strategy, analytics, product development, and data science – but rather someone intellectually curious, and skilled at asking the right questions.

You'll define hypotheses, lead cross-functional initiatives, and own the roadmap for how iwoca engages with German businesses. You will be accountable for measurable impact on acquisition and conversion, bringing ideas to life through rigorous commercial insight, strong customer empathy, and practical delivery. As a Lead, you will also be responsible for coaching your team and establishing the operating rhythm for this new unit.

Market and problem understanding

- Deeply understand the German SME lending landscape, customer needs, and competitive context to sharpen our go-to-market strategy.
- Translate market and customer insight into clearly defined product problems and prioritised commercial opportunities.
- Inform targeting and segmentation strategies to help Marketing and Sales reach the right customers.
Product build and optimisation

- Own the roadmap for acquisition and onboarding, working with engineers and data scientists to develop tools such as lead scoring systems, eligibility checkers, and onboarding journeys.
- Work with marketing and sales to evolve website content, sign-up flows, and decisioning logic to increase conversion.
- Influence future team capability by helping define priorities, roles, and processes as we scale.
Experimentation and insight

- Design, run, and interpret A/B tests across messaging, targeting, onboarding tools, and product flows.
- Identify opportunities using first-principle reasoning supported by data, customer research, and funnel analysis.
Cross-functional collaboration

- Manage, coach, and develop a team of at the beginning two commercial strategy analysts and a data scientist focused on acquisition strategy and operational excellence.
- Lead cross-functional initiatives, aligning engineering, data, marketing, and commercial stakeholders around clear goals, hypotheses, and success metrics.
- Translate high-level business goals into testable hypotheses and actionable briefs for our technical teams.
- Help establish the operating rhythm, rituals, and roadmap processes for this new team.
The requirements

Essential:

- Strong commercial mindset with proven experience driving go-to-market strategy and measurable acquisition growth.
- Experience in growth strategy, revenue operations, or a highly analytical commercial role with a track record of driving tech-enabled or product-led growth.
- Proven people management or team leadership experience, with the ability to build culture and establish operating rhythms in a newly formed team.
- Fluency in German and strong written communication skills tailored to customer-facing environments.
- Strong analytical capability and experience with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing tools.
- Experience working with (or a strong desire to learn about) technical models such as lead scoring, predictive targeting, or qualification logic.
- Ability to work from first principles and thrive in ambiguity with curiosity and autonomy.
Bonus:

- Experience in fintech, lending, B2B SaaS, or regulated products.
- Experience working closely with engineering, product, or data science teams to ship features or models.
- Knowledge of the German SME ecosystem or B2B financial products.
The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

- Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.
- Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.
The benefits

A smart, motivated and international team (we represent over 35 different nationalities) with ridiculous growth-mindset.

26 days of vacation a year plus a free day for your birthday.

One-month fully paid sabbatical after 4 years.

Mental health support with direct access to certified psychologists via our partner OpenUp.

iwoca takes over a ski chalet in winter so that you and your team can ski or snowboard (and work) for a week. During summer we are drawn to the sun. We’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

Access to the gym membership program, €25 for either Fit711 or Urban Sports Club.

€30 contribution towards the Deutschlandticket.

Company Pension with Canada Life.

Great office locations. In Frankfurt in the middle of the city, our Berlin office is located in Prenzlauer Berg.

A paid volunteer day that gives you the opportunity to invest time to support a charity of your choice.

Corporate Benefits discounts.

’iwocans’ also benefit from fully stocked fridges in our offices with whatever is needed to strengthen them. There are snacks (both healthy and less healthy) for the whole day.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

- A learning and development budget for everyone, including a book budget.
- Learning German budget.
- Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

The Partner Acquisition Germany team builds the partner channel through which iwoca reaches small businesses in Germany: comparison platforms and brokers, banks, payment providers, business software providers and financial advisors who offer iwoca's finance to their customers at the moment it is needed. The team works with three partnership models, from a co-branded referral link and a partner portal to a full API integration, and measures its success by partners that are live and funding customers.

The team prioritises partners by strategic fit, works through warm introductions and existing networks wherever possible, and stays close to every new partner until the first customers are funded. It works hand in hand with Relationship Management and the product and engineering teams in London / Berlin / Frankfurt that build the integrations.

The role

This is a senior role with full ownership of the partners you pursue. Three things matter more than anything else: You will qualify before you sell, because the best partnerships begin with a genuine customer need. You know how to activate networks and create warm introductions rather than relying solely on cold outreach. And you consider a deal complete only when the partnership is live, working well and funding its first customers. You'll travel across Germany one to two days a week for face-to-face partner meetings, industry events and trade fairs.

Ownership and impact

- Own a portfolio of the highest-value partnership prospects in Germany, from first conversation to signed contract and live integration.

- Lead negotiations with founders, managing directors and heads of product or partnerships at banks, payment providers, business software platforms and financial intermediaries.

- Design the cooperation model and commercial terms for each partner so that the partnership works for both sides over years, not quarters.

- Bring every partner to go-live with a committed internal promoter and a first concrete use case, so that your work turns into funded customers and long-term value.

Autonomy, backed by a dedicated strategy and data function

- Spend your time on relationships and deals, with a Strategy & Data Manager who builds target models, business cases and CRM automation alongside you for your prospects and partners.

- Own your pipeline end to end and keep it transparent, so that forecasts and decisions rest on input and numbers everyone trusts.

- Decide together with the Head of Partner Acquisition which segments and partners you pursue and where you say no.

Influence on product and strategy

- Feed what you learn from partners directly into our partnership models, the integration roadmap and the go-to-market plan for Germany.

- Shape the activation playbook for new partners and the handover to Key Account Management together with the Head of Business Development.

- Represent iwoca at the industry events, trade fairs and partner roundtables that matter for SME finance in Germany.

The requirements

Essential: 

- At least five years of experience in B2B partnerships, business development or key account management in fintech, banking, payments or business software. You can show a proven track record of closing complex deals with six to twelve month sales cycles at C-Level, founder, board or head-of-department level.

- A working understanding of how a financing product is integrated into a partner's platform: APIs, embedded finance and how a partner's customer data can be used in the application journey. You won't build integrations yourself (our engineering teams do that), but you need to lead that conversation credibly.

- Professional fluency in German and English.

- Demonstrates curiosity to use and learn more about AI tools. You’ll already be comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to help solve problems, increase productivity and improve quality of work, showing good judgement about when to use them and the ability to explain the reasoning behind that use.

Bonus: 

- An existing network among German banks, payment providers, brokers or business software platforms.

- Experience with lending, working capital or other financial products for small businesses.

- Experience managing a partner pipeline in HubSpot and using data to prioritise targets.

Don’t take this list as prescriptive: it’s just to give you a sense of who might do well at the job. We’d still love to hear from you if you don’t hit every point on the list, or if you have other experience.

The salary

We expect to pay from €70,000 - €85,000 base salary plus a performance-related bonus for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

- Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

- Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

- A smart, motivated and international team (we represent over 35 different nationalities) with a ridiculous growth-mindset.

- 26 days of vacation a year plus a free day for your birthday.

- One-month fully paid sabbatical after 4 years.

- Mental health support with direct access to certified psychologists via our partner OpenUp.

- iwoca takes over a ski chalet in winter so that you and your team can ski or snowboard (and work) for a week. During summer we are drawn to the sun. We’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

- Access to the gym membership program, €25 for either Fit711 or Urban Sports Club.

- €30 contribution towards the Deutschlandticket.

- Company Pension with Canada Life.

- Great office locations. In Frankfurt in the middle of the city, our Berlin office is located in Prenzlauer Berg.

- A paid volunteer day that gives you the opportunity to invest time to support a charity of your choice.

- Corporate Benefits discounts.

- ’iwocans’ also benefit from fully stocked fridges in our offices with whatever is needed to strengthen them. There are snacks (both healthy and less healthy) for the whole day.

title: Environmental Compliance Manager (m/w/d) – PFAS & Kreislaufwirtschaft
description:
PFASuiki setzt den globalen Standard für die sichere und nachhaltige Zerstörung von PFAS. Mit elektrochemischer Oxidation (ECO) verwandeln wir belastete Wasserströme in ungefährliches Abwasser und helfen, eine der großen Umweltherausforderungen unserer Zeit zu lösen.

Wir suchen eine Entsorgungsfachkraft (m/w/d), die PFASuiki zum zertifizierten Entsorgungsfachbetrieb nach § 56 KrWG macht und diesen Status dauerhaft sichert. Als verantwortliche Person nach EfbV leitest und beaufsichtigst Du unsere Entsorgungstätigkeiten, erledigst alle Formalitäten mit Prüfstelle und Behörden und berätst unser Team in allen Abfall- und Entsorgungsfragen.

Aufgaben

- Zertifizierung als Entsorgungsfachbetrieb verantworten: Umfang festlegen (Tätigkeiten, Standorte, Abfallarten), Prüfstelle auswählen, Überwachungsvertrag abschließen, Erst- und Jahresprüfungen begleiten

- Betriebsorganisation nach EfbV aufbauen und pflegen: Organisationsplan, Arbeitsanweisungen, Betriebstagebuch, Versicherungs-, Zuverlässigkeits- und Fachkundenachweise

- Alle behördlichen Formalitäten erledigen: Anzeigen und Erlaubnisse nach KrWG, Anträge, Fragenkataloge und Fristen

- Geschäftsführung, Operations, Technik und Vertrieb in Abfall- und Entsorgungsfragen beraten, von der AVV-Einstufung bis zur Wahl der Entsorgungsroute

- Abfallströme aus unseren mobilen Einsätzen, Labor und Technikum einstufen, Analytik veranlassen und Entsorgungspartner qualifizieren

- Entsorgungsnachweise, Begleitscheine, eANV und Register führen und Kunden belastbare Nachweise über den Verbleib liefern

- Genehmigungsbedarf neuer Geschäftsmodelle bewerten

- Mitarbeitende unterweisen, interne Audits durchführen und Änderungen im Abfall- und PFAS-Recht verfolgen

Anforderungen

- Abgeschlossenes Studium, Fachschul- oder Berufsausbildung oder Meister in Chemie, Verfahrens-, Umwelt- oder Entsorgungstechnik oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet

- Mindestens drei Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Abfallwirtschaft, idealerweise mit gefährlichen oder flüssigen Abfällen

- Fachkunde nach § 9 EfbV mit anerkanntem Fachkundelehrgang

- Zuverlässigkeit im Sinne von § 8 EfbV, nachgewiesen durch Führungszeugnis und Gewerbezentralregisterauszug

- Sichere Kenntnisse in KrWG, EfbV, NachwV und AVV sowie Praxis mit dem eANV

- Erfahrung mit Zertifizierungsaudits und souveräner Umgang mit Behörden und Sachverständigen

- Strukturierte, gründliche Arbeitsweise mit sicherem Gespür für Fristen und Dokumentation

- Deutsch verhandlungssicher, auch im Behördenschriftverkehr; gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit im Team

- Führerschein Klasse B für Einsätze bei Kunden

Von Vorteil:

- Erfahrung mit PFAS, Feuerlöschschäumen oder POP-haltigen Abfällen

- Qualifikation als Abfallbeauftragte/r oder Gefahrgutbeauftragte/r

- Kenntnisse in AwSV, BImSchG und ADR

- Erfahrung mit ISO 14001 oder ISO 9001

Benefits

- Echte Wirkung: Du hilfst mit, eine der großen globalen Umweltherausforderungen zu lösen

- Verantwortung: Du baust den Entsorgungsfachbetrieb PFASuiki von Grund auf mit auf und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für alle Entsorgungsfragen

- Breites Aufgabenfeld: Abfallrecht, Zertifizierung, Behördenarbeit, Einsätze bei Kunden und die Markteinführung einer neuen Zerstörungstechnologie

- Startup-Kultur: Ein dynamisches, kollegiales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen unsere Technologie und Strategie direkt prägen

- Weiterbildung: Fachkunde- und Fortbildungslehrgänge sind bei uns fest eingeplant

- Attraktives Paket: Fixgehalt plus leistungsabhängige variable Vergütung

- Weitere Benefits wie Zuschüsse zu ÖPNV und Mittagessen

Bereit, mit deinem Entsorgungs-Know-how dafür zu sorgen, dass „Ewigkeitschemikalien“ der Vergangenheit angehören?

Werde Teil von PFASuiki und schaffe die regulatorische Grundlage, mit der unsere Technologie vom Pilotbetrieb in den kommerziellen Einsatz geht.

Wenn du fundiertes Abfallrecht mit einer praktischen, lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweise verbindest und gern Verantwortung übernimmst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The role

Customer Service Advisors are the first point of contact for potential customers as well as new and existing customers, and thus the “face” of iwoca. You handle incoming calls, emails and web chats, supporting entrepreneurs with general inquiries, new applications and repeat loans. You highly value our customer service and support customers with your excellent communication skills so they can successfully utilise our products.

A fundamental component for our success is to convince and inspire customers and partners of our mission - this ranges from hair salons and dental practices to financial advisory services and banks.

The requirements

Essential:

- Demonstrates curiosity to use and learn more about AI tools. You’ll already be comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to help solve problems, increase productivity and improve quality of work, showing good judgement about when to use them and the ability to explain the reasoning behind that use.
- We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and always looking to improve.
- You enjoy communicating with customers and live "customer centricity". Your greatest motivation is achieving success with our customers.
- You have completed a commercial training / business studies (kaufmännische Ausbildung / betriebswirtschaftliches Studium) and can add value with relevant professional experience in customer service (experiences in the banking environment or a fintech are a plus).
- You are highly motivated, organised, a true team player and have a 'hands-on' mentality.
- You possess C1-level German communication skills (both written and spoken) and are comfortable collaborating in English within our diverse, international office.
- An independent, team-oriented and reliable way of working is a given.
Don’t take this list as prescriptive: it’s just to give you a sense of who might do well at the job. We’d still love to hear from you if you don’t hit every point on the list, or if you have other experience.

Your mission:

You are responsible for the overall customer satisfaction and ensure that customer inquiries via phone, email or web chat are handled promptly and efficiently.

You answer questions about our products, the application process and our service in general, supporting both new and existing customers.

You assist entrepreneurs in completing their applications and providing the necessary documents required for a credit decision.

You collaborate with various teams within iwoca to achieve the best outcome for our customers.

You proactively participate in the development of iwoca by providing regular insights on customer feedback, opportunities to improve our processes or new offerings from our competitors.

Work-life balance is incredibly important at iwoca and we offer flexible working so you can make better use of your free time. This is a hybrid role in which you can split your time between the office and home.

We want to make iwoca a place where everyone feels welcome, where you can confidently be yourself. We understand that inclusivity, and diversity that comes through greater inclusivity, isn't an optional add-on; it's the core ingredient of what makes us great. We care about making iwoca a healthy and happy community for all of our team members to thrive in.

The salary

We expect to pay from €30,000 — €38,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

A smart, motivated and international team (we represent over 35 different nationalities) with ridiculous growth-mindset.

26 days of vacation a year plus a free day for your birthday.

One-month fully paid sabbatical after 4 years.

Mental health support with direct access to certified psychologists via our partner OpenUp.

iwoca takes over a ski chalet in winter so that you and your team can ski or snowboard (and work) for a week. During summer we are drawn to the sun. We’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

Access to the gym membership program, €25 for either Fit711 or Urban Sports Club.

€30 contribution towards the Deutschlandticket.

Company Pension with Canada Life.

Great office locations. In Frankfurt in the middle of the city, our Berlin office is located in Prenzlauer Berg.

A paid volunteer day that gives you the opportunity to invest time to support a charity of your choice.

Corporate Benefits discounts.

’iwocans’ also benefit from fully stocked fridges in our offices with whatever is needed to strengthen them. There are snacks (both healthy and less healthy) for the whole day.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

A learning and development budget for everyone, including a book budget.

Learning German budget.

Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Interesse an admkrs? (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Mission

Kurz vorab: Wir schreiben hier keine Stelle aus. Diese Seite ist für Leute, die admkrs kennen, unsere Arbeit verfolgen und einen konkreten Grund haben, warum sie genau hier hingehören. Wenn das auf dich zutrifft, lies weiter. Wenn du gerade an zwanzig Agenturen dieselbe Bewerbung schickst, ist das hier nicht der richtige Ort.

Du sagst uns, welche Lücke du bei uns schließt. Nicht wir dir. Wir sind rund 20 Leute in München, arbeiten für Marken wie ESN, arena und asambeauty an Performance-Kampagnen, Creatives, Video und eigener Technologie. Vieles davon ist öffentlich sichtbar: unsere Cases, unsere Creatives, unsere Tools. Schau dir das an und sag uns, wo du andocken würdest und was dadurch bei uns besser wird.

Dein Profil

- Du hast dir admkrs angeschaut und kannst in drei Sätzen sagen, warum wir und nicht irgendeine Agentur.

- Du hast ein Fachgebiet, in dem du richtig gut bist: Performance Marketing, Creative und Design, Video und Motion, Strategie oder Entwicklung.

- Du zeigst Arbeit statt Buzzwords. Ein Link zu Projekten, Creatives, Code oder Kampagnen sagt uns mehr als jedes Anschreiben.

- Du lebst in München oder bist gerade dabei, hierher zu ziehen. Wir arbeiten zusammen im Office am Gärtnerplatz, dafür muss dein Lebensmittelpunkt hier sein.

Warum wir?

- Kurze Wege: Strategie, Design, Video und Performance sitzen an einem Tisch, Feedback kommt in Minuten statt in Tagen.

- Kreative kennen die Zahlen, Media Buyer die Ideen. Wir entwickeln Arbeit gemeinsam weiter.

- Eigene Technologie: Unser Entwicklerteam baut Tools, KI-Skills und Schnittstellen für den Alltag. Was fehlt, bauen wir selbst.

- Ein Office, in das man gern kommt, mitten in München.

Darauf schauen wir

Wir lesen jede Bewerbung, die hier ankommt, und du bekommst in jedem Fall eine Antwort. Entscheidend sind drei Dinge: ein konkreter Grund für admkrs, sichtbare Arbeit und eine Vorstellung davon, welche Rolle du bei uns ausfüllen willst. Eine allgemeine Bewerbung ohne Bezug zu uns hat hier keine Chance. Das ist nicht unfreundlich gemeint, es spart uns beiden Zeit.

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Im Bewerbungsformular fragen wir, warum admkrs und warum du, in welchem Bereich du dich siehst und wo wir deine Arbeit sehen können. Wenn du dich über ein anderes Portal bewirbst, schreib diese Angaben bitte in deine Nachricht oder deinen Lebenslauf.

Wir nehmen uns Zeit für die Antwort, das kann ein paar Tage dauern.

title: Senior Sales Manager - EMEA
description:
InMobi (Corporate) 

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

InMobi Advertising 

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

Glance 

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

Overview of the Role: 

InMobi is seeking a passionate, ambitious, and driven Senior Sales Manager to drive new logo activation for InMobi's App Performance Solutions team across the DACH region and broader EMEA market. In this role, you'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and closing high-value opportunities with some of the largest brands across non-gaming verticals. This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role ideal for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and is passionate about helping performance marketers scale through programmatic app advertising.

You'll join a high-performing team spanning EMEA Sales, Client Growth, and Media Buying under App Performance Solutions — a team that will actively support your growth and success within the InMobi programmatic sales ecosystem. This is an exciting opportunity to make a visible impact across the EMEA region for a high-growth App Performance Solutions business comprising an AI/ML-driven DSP, Owned and Operated Glance TV, and Performance CTV.

This is a role for true hunters — those who thrive on building pipelines from scratch, opening doors others can't, and turning cold conversations into long-term revenue partnerships.

This is a fully remote role based in Germany. Proficiency in both German and English is required. Some travel is expected for client meetings, industry events, and in-person team sync-ups as needed. 

The Impact You'll Make: 

As Senior Sales Manager, EMEA, you will be responsible for driving sales from a portfolio of Direct Brands and Performance Agencies across the DACH region by creating and selling effective App Performance Solutions. You will also actively participate in shaping InMobi's App Performance sales strategy, go-to-market approach, and execution plan across your key region within EMEA.

- Identify, acquire, advise, and develop new relationships with targeted, strategic brands, agencies, and partners that ensure the growth and long-term success of InMobi's suite of App Performance Solutions

- Leverage your knowledge of the market landscape and InMobi's unique selling propositions and differentiators to develop new and enduring business with advertisers — including navigating the Programmatic and walled garden ecosystems to position InMobi App Performance Solutions as a must-have for brands' app growth and retention strategies

- Maintain strong relationships with ecosystem influencers, MMPs, agencies, and partners to keep InMobi top of mind for their clients

- Own the entire sales lifecycle — from outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification to proposal building, nurturing, activation, and strategic growth consulting

- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Client Growth, Media Buying, Legal, Finance, Ecosystem Partnerships, and Product to ensure seamless onboarding, execution, and account handover to the Growth team

- Represent InMobi App Performance Solutions at key industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities across EMEA to drive visibility and pipeline growth

- Maintain a disciplined approach to pipeline management, leveraging CRM tools for accurate forecasting and performance tracking

- Consistently exceed quarterly revenue targets through strategic account acquisition and strong client relationship management

The Experience We Need: 

- Industry experience . You bring 5+ years of hunting and selling experience to App businesses and Performance Agencies. You understand the challenges they face, can leverage your experience to develop compelling solutions, and have a track record of consistently meeting and exceeding revenue goals. You're known for building revenue where none existed — not just maintaining books of business, but creating them.

- An advertising technology expert . You've spent at least 6+ years in ad tech and know the EMEA ecosystem well. Experience at a leading Performance DSP, Performance CTV, Ad Network, Rewarded Platform, MMP, or other online advertising company is required. You think deeply about clients' growth and retention challenges and know how to recommend the right solutions.

- A trusted advisor and consultant . You have authentic communication skills and the ability to form consultative, credible, and long-standing relationships with your clients. In a marketplace flooded with vendors, your clients think of you first — not because you sold them, but because you solved for them.

- A high-energy, passionate self-starter . You are highly self-motivated by nature, ambition is in your DNA, and you are extremely comfortable in a fast-paced, risk-taking, and often ambiguous environment.

- Analytically strong and a compelling storyteller . You have strong analytical skills and the ability to peel back layers and find hidden opportunities. You don't just present numbers — you build narratives around them that move clients to action.

- A proactive problem solver . You have a proven ability to solve customer pain points and technical challenges while proactively creating solutions through cross-functional collaboration.

- Eager, curious, and a fast learner . You are naturally inquisitive, take a proactive approach, and seek out ways to support your colleagues. The ad tech landscape shifts constantly — signal loss, AI disruption, shifting buyer behaviour — and you lean in rather than wait for the dust to settle.

- Education . A BA/BS degree in a relevant discipline is required, or equivalent professional experience. An MBA or Master's degree is a plus.

- Language . Full professional proficiency in both German and English is required. 

At InMobi, you'll be surrounded by people who: 

- Think big and act fast — we're entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems

- Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work — we care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential

- Own their outcomes — we take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence

- Embrace freedom with accountability — we value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility

- Believe in lifelong learning — we welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren't afraid to take smart risks

Compensation & Benefits 

Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay equity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location.

Salary Range (Germany): 

The base salary or fixed pay for this role ranges from €132,500 to €167,250 (min to max of base salary). In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible to receive variable compensation in the form of an annual or quarterly performance bonus or sales incentive, as determined per InMobi policy. 

Note : Our ranges may vary based on final location and region of roles in accordance with the geographical differentiation in pay scales in the country. 

Benefits: 

As an InMobi employee based in Germany, you will have access to our full EMEA benefits package. Detailed benefits information is available upon request and will be outlined in full during the hiring process. 

Equal Opportunity & Inclusion 

InMobi is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, ethnic origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, disability, age, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law, including the German General Equal Treatment Act (Allgemeines Gleichbehandlungsgesetz — AGG).

InMobi is proud to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace. If you require an accommodation, please let us know, and we will work with you to meet your needs.

At InMobi, culture isn't a buzzword — it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences. Howsoever you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this role excites you.

Data Privacy Notice (GDPR) 

In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable German data protection law (Bundesdatenschutzgesetz — BDSG), InMobi collects and processes your personal data solely for the purpose of evaluating your application for this role.

Your data will be retained for the duration of the recruitment process and, where applicable, for a period thereafter in accordance with statutory retention obligations. Your data will not be shared with third parties outside of the recruitment process without your explicit consent.

You have the right to access, rectify, or request the deletion of your personal data at any time. To exercise your rights or for any data privacy enquiries, please contact: -----
By submitting your application, you confirm that you have read and understood this data privacy notice and consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes. 

— DEUTSCHE FASSUNG — 

InMobi Advertising ist ein weltweit führendes Technologieunternehmen, das Marketingfachleuten hilft, die entscheidenden Momente zu gewinnen. Unsere Werbeplattform erreicht über 2 Milliarden Menschen in mehr als 150 Ländern und wandelt Echtzeitkontext in messbare Geschäftsergebnisse um – auf Basis datenschutzfreundlicher Grundsätze. InMobi genießt das Vertrauen von über 30.000 Marken und führenden Publishern und vereint Intelligenz, Kreativität und Verantwortlichkeit. Durch die Kombination von Sperrbildschirmen, Apps, Fernsehgeräten und dem offenen Web mit KI und maschinellem Lernen bieten wir aufmerksamkeitsstarke Werbeplatzierungen, präzise Personalisierung und messbare Wirkung.

Mit Glance AI gestalten wir die Zukunft des KI-gestützten Commerce neu und revolutionieren das E-Commerce-Erlebnis durch inspirationsgeleitete Entdeckung und Shopping. Glance AI ist darauf ausgelegt, sich nahtlos in alltägliche Verbrauchertechnologie zu integrieren und jeden Bildschirm in ein Tor für sofortige, persönliche und freudvolle Entdeckungen zu verwandeln. Glance AI bietet zutiefst personalisierte Einkaufserlebnisse in Bereichen wie Mode, Beauty, Reisen, Accessoires, Wohnen, Haustiere und mehr.
