title: Senior iOS Developer (Remote)
description:
About Finom 

Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.

We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.

Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.

At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.

Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

The Role 

For hundreds of thousands of European entrepreneurs, our iOS app is Finom. It's how they check their cash flow over morning coffee, approve a payment between client meetings, and freeze a card the moment something looks off. We're mobile-first by conviction, not convenience — the app isn't a companion to the "real" product; it is the product. And as an AI-native platform, the features you build increasingly carry intelligence inside them: AI-powered accounting, smart categorization, and agentic workflows that quietly save business owners hours every week. When you ship something great, someone somewhere feels it the same day. 

That's why we're not looking for someone to implement tickets. We're looking for a Senior Mobile (iOS) Engineer who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, challenges assumptions when needed, and proactively spots opportunities to create better outcomes. 

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team — Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product — that owns a shared product area end-to-end. No handoff culture, no "not my layer": everyone in the team is solving the same customer problem, and you'll shape solutions from the first product conversation to the moment the feature is live in users' hands. Fewer silos means more flow — and real, end-to-end ownership. 

How We Build 

Agentic development is table stakes at Finom — for every craft, mobile included. Our engineers work with Claude Code and similar harnesses daily, and we've made it a first-class part of how the company operates, not an individual productivity hack. We follow a shared SDLC approach built around Spec-Driven Development (SDD): features start as clear, reviewable specs that both humans and AI agents execute against, powered by a shared AI development toolbelt and a growing library of skills, rules, and context maintained across guilds. You won't be figuring out AI-assisted development alone — you'll join an engineering organization that has already invested in the infrastructure, standards, and shared practices, and you'll be expected to use them, improve them, and raise the bar for others.

What You'll Do 

What You'll Do 

- 
Design and build new features for our iOS application, used daily by business owners across Europe: multi-account cash flow management, banking transactions and payments, physical and virtual card issuance and control, and AI-powered accounting automation. 

- 
Own outcomes, not just code. You'll follow your features into analytics, jump into customer issues without being prompted, and care about whether what you shipped actually moved the needle. 

- 
Build polished, responsive UIs with UIKit and SwiftUI — in a financial app, trust is built (or lost) in the details. 

- 
Drive technical decisions within your domain, discuss trade-offs openly with product managers, and explain constraints clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 

- 
Raise the bar on engineering quality — automated testing, thorough code reviews, and mobile security best practices are non-negotiable in a regulated fintech. 

- 
Mentor the engineers around you and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team. 

Who You Are 

Who You Are 

You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. Above all, you're curious — about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three. 

Curiosity. You want to understand the "why" behind every feature. You ask what problem it solves, question whether there's a simpler path, and explore how your decisions ripple into product, users, and revenue. 

Business acumen. You connect your work to company objectives. You understand the "so what" behind every decision, and you'd rather ship the feature that moves the right metric than the one that's merely interesting to build. 

Communication. You communicate clearly and concisely in English across technical and non-technical audiences — from fellow engineers to PMs to business stakeholders — and you genuinely enjoy the dynamics of a cross-functional team. 

T-shapedness. Your iOS craft runs deep, but your curiosity runs wide. You'll peek at the backend contracts, ask questions about the ML models, and dive into analytics to understand how your features perform. 

Ownership. You take responsibility not just for your code, but for the outcomes. You move without being prompted — whether that's improving team processes, jumping on a production issue, or mentoring a colleague. 

Your Experience Includes 

- 
5+ years of commercial iOS development with strong knowledge of Swift. 

- 
Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns. 

- 
Practical experience with the VIPER architectural pattern and the Coordinator navigation pattern — and the judgment to know when a simpler approach serves the product better. 

- 
Excellent knowledge of UIKit and experience (or a strong desire to grow) with SwiftUI. 

- 
Experience with layout development in code, particularly using SnapKit or similar tools. 

- 
Ability to write unit and UI tests. 

- 
Confidence with Git / GitLab, including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD. 

- 
Hands-on experience with agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as part of your daily workflow — writing prompts, configuring rules and skills, and critically evaluating AI-generated output with tests, linters, and review. This is table stakes for all engineering crafts at Finom, mobile included. 

- 
A builder's mentality: you care deeply about shipping great products, not just writing great code. 

Nice to Have 

Nice to Have 

- 
Background in fintech or financial products — you understand the stakes of working in a regulated environment. 

- 
Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain). 

- 
Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing rendering bottlenecks and hitting smooth 60/120fps on iOS. 

- 
Hands-on work with performance tooling: Instruments, XCTest, or similar. 

- 
Published apps on the App Store you're proud of. 

- 
An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share. 

- 
Deeper agentic engineering experience beyond daily tool use — setting up agent environments and harnesses, authoring reusable skills and behavioral rules, or contributing to a team's shared AI development practices. 

- 
Understanding of model capabilities and limitations — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively. 

- 
Awareness of AI security risks — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows. 

Recruitment Flow 

- Recruiter Interview

- First Technical Interview

- Coding / AI assisted coding interview

- Mobile System Design Interview

- Team Fit Interview (peer interview)

- Offer

What You Will Get In Return 

Make a genuine impact on the product 

Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product. 

Work in the EU 

Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe. 

Become a stock options holder 

Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders. 

Receive unwavering support and care 

Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling. 

Work & Swim program 

Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views. 

Equal Opportunity Statement 

At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Senior Information Security Officer
description:
Your Role in Our Story: 

ACT is strengthening its data, technology and AI capabilities as we build a more integrated digital platform alongside our core environmental commodities trading and market-making business. This transformation is commercially driven, enabling us to scale, deepen client relationships and support increasingly complex and digital markets.

As Senior Information Security Officer, you will own ACT’s enterprise information security strategy and governance at Group level, spanning our core operations, emerging digital businesses and client-facing technology platforms. You will define the security risk appetite, lead our response to an evolving threat landscape, and ensure security and resilience are embedded by design as our technology landscape develops.

Working across business and technology leadership, you will translate commercial ambition into a pragmatic and scalable security posture that protects our systems and data while maintaining the trust of clients, counterparties and regulators. In essence, your role involves:

Strategy & Governance 

- Own the Group-wide information security strategy and roadmap across ACT’s core market-making business and digital and client-facing platforms, aligned with business goals and industry frameworks such as ISO 27001 and NIST CSF. Define and maintain ACT’s cyber risk appetite.

- Establish and lead security governance, including policies, standards and control frameworks, with clear accountability across the Group. Report on security posture and material incidents to executive leadership and, where relevant, the Board.

Client Platforms & Secure-by-Design 

- Embed security-by-design into new products and client platforms, partnering with Data, Architecture and Commercial teams to ensure emerging digital capabilities are secure from inception, while acting as a credible security voice to clients and counterparties.

- Oversee application, product and SaaS security, embedding security throughout the software development lifecycle for internal and client-facing platforms, and assessing third-party services handling ACT and counterparty data.

Risk & Resilience 

- Lead enterprise security risk management, including risk assessments, vulnerability management and third-party/supply-chain risk, driving timely mitigation across core and digital environments.

- Direct incident preparedness and response, coordinating detection, containment, eradication and recovery, while continuously strengthening incident and crisis-management plans.

Infrastructure & Emerging Technology 

- Secure ACT’s cloud and infrastructure through Zero-Trust-aligned controls, including identity and access management, segmentation and encryption, across a hybrid and multi-platform environment.

- Govern emerging technology and AI security, extending security oversight to AI and data platforms, including model and data-exposure risks and AI-enabled threats, as ACT expands its use of AI.

Compliance & Leadership 

- Ensure regulatory and compliance alignment, including GDPR, DORA and relevant sector obligations, advising the business on required adaptations and coordinating audits and certifications.

- Lead the security function and strengthen security culture across the Group, developing the team, raising security awareness, and acting as ACT’s primary authority and trusted advisor on cyber security to executives and business leaders, working alongside existing teams and capabilities.

Your Expertise: 

To be successful in this role, we are looking for candidates with the following qualifications and attributes: 

- A Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science or a related field. A relevant Master’s degree is an advantage.

- 10–15 years of progressive experience in information security and cybersecurity, including at least 5 years in a senior security role, with ownership of enterprise security strategy, governance and risk management.

- Broad security leadership experience across incident response, cloud and infrastructure security, product/application security and regulatory compliance. Experience securing client-facing platforms or digital products is highly valuable.

- Experience within trading, financial services, commodities or another data-intensive and regulated environment is highly advantageous.

- Strong knowledge of security frameworks and standards, including ISO/IEC 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework and CIS Controls, with practical experience implementing them.

- Good understanding of data protection, regulatory and compliance requirements, including GDPR, DORA and standards such as SOC 2.

- Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM or CISA, or equivalent, are highly desirable.

- Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate complex security risks into clear business implications and advise technical teams, executives, business stakeholders and clients.

If you meet these criteria and are ready to contribute your expertise to a dynamic and challenging environment, we encourage you to apply.

Intero Integrity is an internationally operating specialist in the inspection, maintenance and emission monitoring of pipelines and industrial assets. We develop our inspection technology entirely in-house: from ultrasonic measurement systems and FPGA signal processing to the software our analysts use to interpret hundreds of kilometres of pipeline data.

The inspection results our software produces are used for safety-critical decisions about the integrity of pipelines and industrial installations such as heat exchangers. Reliability and correctness are therefore not a nice-to-have, but an absolute requirement.

title: Senior Integrity Engineer
description:
Senior Integrity Engineer 

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero 

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity .

Your team 

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters 

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

Hier is waar 

- We hebben gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling en het ontwerp van een duurzaam en modern gebouw voor het Nederlands Instituut voor Ruimteonderzoek (SRON), dat meetinstrumenten voor satellieten ontwikkelt. SRON verhuisde naar het Leiden BioScience Park en stelde hoge eisen aan het nieuwe gebouw op het gebied van duurzaamheid, cleanrooms en installatietechniek. - We hebben gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling van het nieuwe, duurzame DSM Lab 6 in Delft, waar Deerns alle technische installaties, elektrische systemen, IT-infrastructuur, beveiliging, mechanische systemen, HVAC (verwarming, ventilatie en airconditioning), transport- en utiliteitssystemen verzorgde. - Jij hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor (Hbo/ Wo) in Electrical engineering of een andere technische opleiding.

- Jij hebt al enige ervaring opgedaan als Engineer Elektrotechniek en bent klaar voor de volgende stap in je carrière.

- Jij hebt ervaring met werken in projecten en bent een uitstekende teamspeler.

- Je hebt uitstekende kennis van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal (zowel geschreven als gesproken).

- MS Office, Revit, BIM360 en andere berekeningsprogramma’s hebben geen geheimen voor jou.

Dit bieden wij 

- Een functie van 32-40 uur per week met een bijpassend salaris. 

- Uitdagende projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in Nederland en internationaal. 

- Een werkomgeving waarin innovatie en duurzaamheid dagelijks in de praktijk worden gebracht. 

- Aandacht voor jouw eigen ontwikkeling en vitaliteit met ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden, fiets- en sportregelingen, flexibele werkuren, 33 vakantiedagen en mogelijkheid tot aankopen van extra dagen. 

- Hybride werken, waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt om afwisselend thuis en op kantoor in Den Haag te werken. 

- Een team waar samenwerking en collegialiteit voorop staan en waar we informeel met elkaar omgaan. 

- Duurzaamheid zit in onze genen. Dit uit zich bijvoorbeeld in een mobiliteitsbeleid waar gezondheid en duurzaamheid voorop staan. Veel van onze kantoren liggen bij OV-knooppunten, fietsen wordt aangemoedigd en je reiskosten worden 100% vergoed op basis van OV. 

Over Deerns 
Deerns is als onafhankelijk ingenieursbureau gespecialiseerd in advies, ontwerp en uitvoeringsbegeleiding op het vlak van installatietechniek, bouwfysica, energievoorziening en duurzaamheid. Onze expertises dragen bij aan duurzame, intelligente en toekomstbestendige gebouwen die de processen van onze opdrachtgevers optimaal ondersteunen. We zijn verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp van de installaties en het realiseren van een goed comfort en een prettig klimaat in de meest uiteenlopende gebouwen; van kantoren, tot luchthavens en van ziekenhuizen tot datacenters.

Samen met multidisciplinaire projectteams geef je richting aan ontwerp en realisatie, met directe invloed op de dagelijkse operatie én de toekomstbestendigheid van luchthavens. Met jouw expertise en leiderschap til je niet alleen projecten, maar ook collega’s naar een hoger niveau.

De projecten waar je trots op kunt zijn 

- We werken aan het verduurzamen van Terminal 1 & 2 van Schiphol, zo’n 40% van de gehele terminal: De huidige installaties die zorgen voor een aangenaam binnenklimaat, maken gebruik van fossiele brandstoffen. Wij werken aan het ontwerp van de nieuwe installatie, die warmte en koude opslag combineert met warmtepompen zodat Schiphol energieneutraal de toekomst tegemoet kan. De uitdaging van dit project zit met name in het toepassen van nieuwe techniek in een bestaand gebouw waar ruimte moet worden gecreëerd om alle apparatuur en leidingen goed onder te brengen en te zorgen dat elke ruimte wordt voorzien van voldoende verwarming en koeling. Dit moet zorgen voor een aangename passagiersbeleving maar ook voor het aanbieden van een prettig werkklimaat voor de medewerkers op Schiphol, rekening houdend met hun dagelijkse activiteiten.

- We werken aan het nieuwe operationele gebouw van DC ANSP, de luchtverkeersleiding van het Nederlandse luchtruim in de Cariben. Dit is een faciliteit voor de luchtverkeersleiders die verantwoordelijk zijn voor area control, waarbij de operations room en de ruimte waar de apparatuur staat opgesteld aan strenge bouwfysische en klimaateisen moeten voldoen met een hoge mate van redundantie. De omgeving vraagt daarnaast om een robuust ontwerp dat bestand is tegen orkanen en aardbevingen.

- We werken op Schiphol aan diverse grote en kleine projecten waarin klimaatbeheersing een grote rol speelt door intensiever gebruik van diverse ruimtes en toename van de apparatuur. Schiphol is een unieke klant om voor te werken, vanwege de omvang van de luchthaven, de continue operationele eisen en de aanwezigheid van verschillende beveiligingszones. Wij worden veel ingezet om de oorzaak van klachten te achterhalen en de juiste oplossing te bieden, of om de juiste oplossing te vinden voor nieuwe apparatuur die hogere eisen stelt aan de installaties. Vrijwel altijd gaat het hier om locaties waar zich passagiers bevinden en Schiphol deze een comfortabele omgeving wil bieden, of waar medewerkers taken uitvoeren die essentieel zijn voor het primaire proces van de luchthaven, waarbij een prettig klimaat een belangrijke voorwaarde is.

Team 

Je werkt in een team van collega’s binnen een organisatie met ruim 750 medewerkers, actief in verschillende sectoren. Het hechte airports team bestaat uit projectmanagers, adviseurs, mechanical- en electrical engineers en specialisten in airportsystemen. Er is veel kennis aanwezig over luchthavenoperaties, gebouwgebonden installaties en specifieke luchthavensystemen. De cultuur is open en gericht op het delen van kennis en werkplezier. Je maakt deel uit van een integraal projectteam waarin ieders expertise optimaal wordt benut, wat zorgt voor sterke samenwerking en persoonlijke groei. De unit Airports werkt voor luchthavens in binnen- en buitenland, waardoor je aan diverse projecten werkt en geen dag hetzelfde is.

title: Designer Working Student - Employer Branding
description:
In a nutshell

We’re looking for a Designer Working Student to help bring Picnic’s people, culture and opportunities to life. You’ll join our Employer Branding team and help shape how candidates experience Picnic, with a particular focus on our LinkedIn page and campaigns.

You’ll create and edit visual content for our employer brand, combining design and video to tell stories that catch people’s attention. You’ll also take ownership of the processes behind our LinkedIn campaigns: helping plan content, coordinate assets, publish posts and keep campaigns running smoothly. From a first idea to the final edit and post, you’ll help make sure our content feels distinctive, engaging and true to Picnic.

You’ll work with colleagues across Employer Branding and our wider Creative team of 20+ specialists, including designers, videographers and copywriters. Together, you’ll make content that reaches candidates across the Netherlands, France and Germany.

Tricks of the trade

- Create employer brand content: Design and edit visuals and videos for Picnic’s LinkedIn page, campaigns and other employer branding channels.

- Own LinkedIn campaign processes: Help plan campaign content, coordinate the assets and timelines, publish posts and keep the process organised from start to finish.

- Bring stories to life: Turn ideas, interviews and raw footage into clear, engaging content that shows what it’s like to work at Picnic.

- Adapt content for different formats: Resize and refine designs and edits for different channels and placements, while keeping the look and message consistent.

- Support the creative process: Work with Employer Branding and Creative colleagues to develop ideas, gather feedback and deliver content on time.

- Learn and improve: Keep an eye on how content performs and use what you learn to help improve future posts and campaigns.

title: Senior AI Engineer

Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD 

GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a usable answer. This is done with agents: specialised AI components that each take on part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can’t just sound convincing. It has to be correct, and you need to be able to see which source it comes from. This isn’t a pilot: the platform is in production and used heavily every day.

As a senior, you build alongside the team, but you also keep the bigger picture in view. You know the different parts of the platform and how they affect one another. You help prioritise, spot obstacles early and make sure we’re heading in the right direction, both in how we work and technically. You look ahead: where could we go, and what do we need to know to get there? And you help medior colleagues grow by seeing exactly where they’re stuck, without taking the work off their hands.

- You give direction to the agent architecture of GenIA-L: which specialised agents are needed and how they work together.

- You break down legal processes and translate them into technical solutions. You decide how the components are best connected.

- You make sure our knowledge packages and the pipelines behind them can scale and stay up to date. A knowledge package is an expert-reviewed set of commentary, case law, legislative history and practical guidance for each article of law.

- You build the way we measure quality. Using evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability are genuinely improving. Not based on gut feeling, but on evidence.

- You help prioritise the team’s work and flag technical or process risks early.

- You explore new developments, test ideas in practice and turn them into proposals that make the product sharper or faster.

- You coach medior engineers and work directly with editors and subject-matter experts.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You follow new AI developments closely, but you don’t just follow the herd: you stay critical and aren’t afraid to say so. You can break a complex problem down into smaller pieces and keep oversight of a system with many moving parts. You take ownership, show initiative when things aren’t yet clear and think from the customer’s problem. You enjoy helping others move forward without taking over. And you like working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like.

- Extensive experience in software or ML engineering, around 5 years or more. Depth in recent projects counts for more than the number of years.

- In-depth knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries.

- You’ve built LLM applications and run them in production.

- Solid experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or similar orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer setup (RAG) isn’t enough.

- You’ve made the quality of LLM systems measurable with evaluation sets and observability, and can give concrete examples. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus.

- Strong backend experience, including REST APIs and Postgres databases.

- Experience with Kubernetes.

- Experience in the legal, tax or another knowledge-intensive domain is a plus.

title: Director Research & Development

Purpose of the job The Director Research & Development (R&D) leads the exploration and development of potential business and technology initiatives, from initial ideation through feasibility analysis, testing, validation and proof of concept (POC)/prototyping. For assigned initiatives, the role coordinates the full exploration phase and develops substantiated proposals for consideration and approval by the relevant governance bodies. 

The role requires a proactive, self-motivated approach, the ability to work independently and to manage multiple subjects concurrently. Initiatives may range from joint venture (JV) model enhancements and artificial intelligence (AI) to customer experience development and new approaches to distribution. 

KEY RESULT AREAS/ KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Ideation and concept generation 

- Ensure that potential initiatives align with SkyTeam’s strategic goals and assess their purpose, expected value, rationale and the implications of not proceeding.
- Ask relevant questions and gather appropriate information to support well-founded recommendations and help build consensus among member airlines.
- Organize and facilitate ideation and brainstorming sessions.
- Monitor developments in the transport industry and at IATA to identify emerging trends and opportunities or gaps for improving existing legacy systems.
- Generate, collect and develop ideas and concepts in partnership with member airlines and other contributors for marketable initiatives that could become SkyTeam priorities.

Exploration, feasibility and concept development 

- Lead the exploration of assigned initiatives, including relevant research and data analysis, feasibility assessments, business cases, business requirements documents (BRDs) and POCs/prototypes, as appropriate.
- Analyze business and technical challenges across different airline domains; identify and assess potential solutions and determine the most relevant product concept, design and feasibility approach.
- Develop evidence-based recommendations, supported by tangible data and analysis, that demonstrate the potential business value of the proposed initiative.
- Prepare proposals and supporting materials for review and approval by the relevant SkyTeam and member-airline decision-making bodies.

Stakeholder engagement and governance 

- Work effectively within SkyTeam’s matrix organization and collaborate with member airlines, internal teams and relevant external contributors.
- Engage with operational and technical stakeholders, including senior decision-makers, to understand requirements, assess options and build alignment around proposed concepts.
- Support informed decisions through clear analysis and recommendations. Strategic prioritization and formal initiative approval remain with the Executive Board (EB), Strategy Committee (StratCom) and relevant governance bodies.

Transition to implementation 

- Following approval, coordinate with Digital/Delivery to transfer the agreed concept, supporting analysis, business requirements and relevant POC findings for MVP development and implementation.
- Where assigned, act as project owner or coordinate relevant project activities within the agreed governance arrangements. Accountability for implementation transfers to Digital/Delivery.
- Budget, resource or external-partner responsibilities may be assigned depending on the approved initiative and are not standing responsibilities of the role.

Your profile REQUIRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE

title: Senior Quality Engineer - Tellent Intelligence (AI)
description:
Note: The listed salary range is based on the salary range for the Netherlands. Salary ranges may vary by location. 

About the Role 

As a Senior Quality Engineer – Tellent Intelligence (AI) , you'll own and grow the quality of the AI-powered experiences built by our Tellent Intelligence team alongside our existing QE team. You'll help shape how we test applications powered by large language models (LLMs) and AI agents, ensuring they are reliable, safe, and deliver high-quality experiences for our customers.

You'll expand our end-to-end test coverage in Playwright and help build robust approaches for validating AI-powered systems, where quality extends beyond functional correctness. This is a hands-on, collaborative role with genuine ownership, direct impact on product development, and the opportunity to shape how we test AI at Tellent.

Your 12-Month Journey 

- During your first 3 months: You'll get to know our Tellent Intelligence domain, engineering practices, AI-powered features, and quality standards. You'll learn our testing framework and development workflow while contributing to automated, exploratory, and AI-focused testing.

- Within 6 months: You'll take ownership of quality across key AI-powered features, expand our Playwright test coverage, and work closely with engineers to validate AI behaviour, prompts, and model-driven functionality throughout development.

- After 1 year: You'll be a trusted quality partner within the Tellent Intelligence team, driving improvements to our AI testing strategy, strengthening our automation framework, and helping shape how we build reliable, safe, and responsible AI experiences across Tellent.

What You'll Be Doing 

- Work closely with fellow Quality Engineers to bring our test automation strategy to life across the Tellent Intelligence domain, taking shared ownership and continuously improving it as our platform evolves.

- Partner with developers, AI engineers, and fellow QEs to embed quality early in the development process, sharing knowledge and shaping testing practices collaboratively.

- Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and automated test suites across frontend, backend, and AI-powered functionality.

- Develop into a product domain expert, using your understanding to identify risks early and guide quality decisions across the Tellent Intelligence domain.

- Design and execute testing strategies for AI-powered features, validating not only functional correctness but also the quality, relevance, consistency, and safety of AI-generated outputs.

- Develop approaches for testing non-deterministic systems by creating evaluation datasets, defining quality benchmarks, and identifying hallucinations, bias, regressions, and prompt-related issues as models and prompts evolve.

- Partner with engineers to validate prompt changes, AI agent behaviour, and safety guardrails, ensuring our AI behaves reliably and responsibly before reaching customers.

- Continuously improve how we evaluate AI quality by helping establish best practices, quality metrics, and testing frameworks for LLM-powered applications.

What You Bring 

- Strong QA experience: Several years of hands-on quality engineering, with senior-level ownership of testing for complex web applications.

- AI quality mindset: Experience testing AI-powered applications, LLM-based products, conversational AI, or machine learning systems is a strong plus. If you haven't worked directly with AI before, you're excited to learn and apply quality engineering principles to this rapidly evolving space.

- E2E automation: Experience building and maintaining end-to-end test suites in Playwright.

- API & backend testing skills: Experience testing APIs and backend services.

- Balance of product and technical thinking: Equally at home discussing product behaviour and digging into technical detail.

- Understanding of AI testing challenges: Familiarity with concepts such as prompt engineering, AI agents, hallucinations, model bias, evaluation datasets, and AI safety principles is a plus.

- Analytical mindset: Comfortable defining quality expectations for systems where outputs may vary while still delivering a great user experience.

- Communication: Fluent English for daily collaboration. Polish is a plus.

What We Offer 

- Hybrid or remote working setup across Amsterdam, the Cologne area, or Poland

- A chance to shape one of the most ambitious scale-ups in Europe and lead a company-defining tech transition.

- Work in a diverse, multicultural, and remote-friendly team.

- €1,500 annual training budget + 2 dedicated learning days

- Pension plan, travel reimbursement, and wellness perks.

- 28 paid holiday days + 2 additional days to relax.

- Work from anywhere for 4 weeks/year.

- Apple MacBook and top-tier tooling.

- €200 home office budget.

Please note: Benefits may differ based on your employment location. 

About Tellent 

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System ( Tellent Recruitee ), an intuitive HRIS ( Tellent HR ), and powerful Performance Management software ( Tellent Grow ).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we’re just getting started.

AI in our recruitment process 

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement , check our Privacy Policy , or chat with us at

title: Director of Engineering, Frontend technologies, Marketplace Technologies
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. 
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

About the Role 

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Frontend Technologies domain within Marketplace. In this role, your mission will be two-fold: 

- Pivot our frontend setup for bigger efficiency : we have been operating in mostly the same frontend setup for at least 6 years, and recognize that change is imminent.

- Drive strategic engineering initiatives : architect and implement platform-specific changes that enhance modularity, autonomy, resilience, and performance across Android, iOS, and Web. 

You will have to balance and prioritize foundational capabilities - such as Design Systems, CI/CD, Modularization, App Releases, Performance, and Global UI quality - to optimize both frontend developer velocity and user satisfaction.

You will lead 4 Engineering Managers and 3 Staff Engineers and set and implement the FE strategy, which will impact the roadmaps of 9 Product domains within the Marketplace.

In this position, you will 

Strategically: 

- Ensure the most effective frontend setup for the Marketplace. We have 40+ teams, each with 3 frontend engineers (iOS, Android, and Web) in the Marketplace unit. We know this will look different in two years. Deciding what different means, and getting 9 product domains to fund it, is the job

- Drive Technology Strategy: Set and drive the future technology strategy for frontends, establishing a modular, scalable architecture that enables rapid development and strategic growth. Basically - raise the technological bar for all Marketplace unit. 

- Refine the domain's identity: Take sole ownership of shaping its future, successfully integrating Design Systems and engineering to treat our frontend platforms as a cohesive product.

Tactically : 

- Lead frontends: Lead a horizontal, platform-focused domain containing Android, iOS, Web, and Design System teams.

- Lead Initiatives: Oversee Marketplace-wide technical tooling, core libraries, and frameworks. Lead strategic projects, i.e., frontend modularization and modernization (SwiftUI/Jetpack Compose), native automated testing.

- Elevate global UI quality: Integrate design systems and accessibility into the frontend ecosystem to consolidate technical, visual and interaction quality standards. Support UI experimentation.

- Ensure Resilience & Reliability: Maintain robust release processes, Marketplace frontend quality, and performance monitoring to reduce downtime and ensure a consistent member experience.

- Innovate & Optimize: Drive AI-efficiency enablement in frontend development and explore cross-platform frontend development opportunities to increase engineering speed and productivity.

A lot of this work will be influencing without formal authority : Champion the frontend technical vision among your director peers, influencing the leaders of 9 Product domains to accommodate and prioritize platform-wide changes across 40+ teams.

About you 

How much of a technical acumen? Enough to have in depth conversations with our direct reports. You will have 4 strong technical EMs reporting to you, as well as 3 world-class staff engineers. We don’t think you need to match their technical competencies (that’s a stretch!), but you have to be able to speak their language, understand problems at their essence, and be able to consolidate and multiply their inputs, including being able to disagree objectively.

Leadership: you have a track record of making level change in the organizations that you lead (rather than 20% change). Hybrid computer systems that combine classic high-performance computing with quantum computers are already being used to develop solutions in sectors such as logistics, healthcare, finance, energy, automotive and aerospace. Quantum physics has, in some respects, parallels to the machine language of our computers-the zeros and ones into which our keyboard or touchscreen instructions are translated for execution in the computer-only on a larger scale: it is the machine language of the universe. The second quantum revolution is based on the control of individual quantum systems, such as individual atoms. We use quantum computers to solve currently unsolvable problems, simulate molecules and their interactions, find drugs for diseases that are not yet curable, find new materials, or make artificial intelligence stronger. Quantum is now. 

Terra Quantum is a future-focused quantum services and technology company working on making the second quantum revolution a reality. Terra Quantum’s activities span all areas, markets, and industries globally.

description:

- Du analysierst die Performance unserer Videos anhand relevanter KPIs wie Views, Engagement, Conversion Rate und GMV.

Your profile

- Ausgeprägte TikTok-Affinität: Du bist auf TikTok zu Hause, verfolgst aktiv Trends und verstehst die Plattform, ihre Kultur, Algorithmen und Content-Formate. Du hast ein natürliches Gespür dafür, welche Videos Aufmerksamkeit erzeugen und viral gehen können.

- Du bist ein echter TikTok Native: Du konsumierst Content nicht einfach nur, sondern verstehst, warum bestimmte Videos funktionieren, erkennst neue Trends frühzeitig und kannst Inspirationen in kreative Ideen verwandeln.

- Kreativität: Du liebst es, neue Content-Ideen zu entwickeln, Skripte zu schreiben und innovative Videoformate auszuprobieren.

- Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist offen, kontaktfreudig und hast Spaß daran, neue Menschen kennenzulernen und langfristige Beziehungen aufzubauen.

- Leidenschaft für die Creator Economy: Du verstehst die Creator-Szene und erkennst schnell, welche Talente Potenzial haben.

- Hands-on-Mentalität: Du packst gerne selbst mit an, organisierst Drehs und setzt kreative Ideen gemeinsam mit Creatorn in die Praxis um.

- Analytisches Denken: Du hast Spaß daran, Video-Performance zu analysieren und aus Daten neue kreative Ansätze abzuleiten.

- Eigeninitiative & Organisation: Du arbeitest selbstständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und fühlst dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld wohl.

- Erste Erfahrungen im Influencer Marketing, Creator Management, Social Media oder in der Content-Produktion sind von Vorteil.

- Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Why us?

Das bieten wir dir

- Die Möglichkeit, eine der am schnellsten wachsenden TikTok Creator Communities Deutschlands aktiv mitzugestalten.

- Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit spannenden Marken, kreativen Talenten und erfahrenen E-Commerce-Experten.

- Ein kreatives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem deine Ideen schnell Realität werden können.

- Viel Eigenverantwortung und die Freiheit, neue Content-Formate auszuprobieren.

- Ein junges, ambitioniertes und internationales Team mit flachen Hierarchien.

- Ein modernes Office mit Möglichkeiten zur Content-Produktion mitten in Köln.

- Attraktive Benefits wie Urban Sports Club und einen Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket.

- Individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in der schnell wachsenden Welt des Social Commerce.

Bereit, die Zukunft des Social Commerce mitzugestalten? 

Bei GENUINE betreuen wir nicht einfach nur Creator – wir bauen eine Community auf, die die Zukunft des Social Commerce aktiv mitgestaltet.

Wenn TikTok deine Welt ist, Kreativität zu deinen Stärken gehört und du gerne mit Menschen zusammenarbeitest, möchten wir dich kennenlernen!

Werde Teil von GENUINE und hilf uns dabei, kreative Talente, erfolgreichen Content und echte Verkaufserfolge miteinander zu verbinden.

title: Social Media Creator & Video Editor, 100% Remote (m/w/d)
description:
Über FLOWZOOM 

Wir sind FLOWZOOM – eine Marke für hochwertige, innovative Reiseprodukte. Unser Fokus liegt auf Reisekissen, die Komfort, Funktionalität und ansprechendes Design verbinden. Seit 2018 sind wir auf Amazon zu Hause, jetzt bauen wir TikTok Shop Deutschland von Grund auf neu auf. Ihr besonderes Design macht unsere Reisekissen ideal für Short-Form-Videos mit Wow-Effekt: In wenigen Sekunden sieht man, was sie können.

Deine Mission 

Der kreative Part gehört dir. Du machst aus unserem Rohmaterial Creatives, die hängen bleiben, drehst selbst Short-Form-Videos und sorgst dafür, dass unser Brand Account Woche für Woche konstant postet. Das Ziel ist einfach: unseren Brand-Kanal mit starken, auf TikTok Shop optimierten Videos füllen. Zuschauer sollen kaufen und Creator sehen, welche Angles funktionieren und sich davon inspirieren lassen. Du entscheidest, wie FLOWZOOM auf TikTok aussieht und klingt und arbeitest eng mit unserem TikTok Shop Lead zusammen, der Kanalstrategie und Produktkatalog verantwortet.

Deine Aufgaben 

Creative Creation 

- Du schneidest Short-Form-Videos aus unserem bestehenden Rohmaterial, aus Material vom Team und aus deinem eigenen Footage (neue Hooks, neue Cuts, TikTok-Style)

- Du drehst selbst Short-Form-Videos für unseren TikTok Shop Brand Account

- Du veröffentlichst auf unserem Brand Account, hältst einen konstanten Posting-Rhythmus und gehst in den Austausch mit der Community

- Du bereitest die besten Videos gemeinsam mit dem Social-Media-Team für Instagram und Facebook auf

Content-Analyse 

- Du prüfst wöchentlich wie die Videos performt haben und verstehst warum (Hook, Format, CTA und Länge dokumentieren)

- Du hältst fest, was funktioniert – damit wir Creator-Briefings schärfen, unsere eigenen Videos verbessern und die stärksten Videos mit Ads boosten können

- Du hältst unsere Video-Bibliothek in Ordnung und dokumentierst systematisch Nutzungsrechte

Support im Creator Management 

- Du unterstützt bei Outreach, Onboarding und Aktivierung unserer TikTok-Shop-Affiliate-Creator – zum Beispiel, indem du Briefings verbesserst oder inaktiven Creatorn Beispielvideos schickst

Der Content, den wir im Kopf haben 

Ein Startpunkt, den du mitgestaltest:

- Du testest einen Mix aus Formaten: Videos mit dir vor der Kamera, faceless Content (POV, Voiceover, Produkt in Action) sowie Clips von Team und Creatorn

- Du filterst wiederkehrende Formate heraus: ein paar Serien, die unsere Zuschauer wiedererkennen und für die sie zurückkommen, z. B. „A vs. B"

- Authentische Travel- und Lifestyle-Momente: das Kissen im echten Leben (Flughafen, Flugzeug, Zug, Roadtrip) – kein reiner Verkaufs-Content

- Unser Ton: lustig, schnell und abenteuerlustig, aber ehrlich. Wir zeigen, was das Produkt wirklich kann.

Woran wir nach drei Monaten sehen, dass es läuft 

- Unser Account postet konstant 4–5 Videos pro Woche, in einem Format-Mix, der nach FLOWZOOM klingt

- Wir haben 2–3 wiederkehrende Formate gefunden, die am besten funktionieren

- Wir kennen unsere Top 3–5 Hooks und Formate – und sie sind dokumentiert

- Die Video-Bibliothek ist sortiert und bei jedem Clip sind die Nutzungsrechte klar

Das bringst du mit 

Must-haves 

- Du hast Erfahrung im Short-Form-Editing – idealerweise ein Portfolio an TikToks, Reels oder Shorts, das du zeigen kannst

- Du arbeitest sicher mit Schnitt-Tools (z. B. CapCut, Premiere oder Final Cut)

- Du fühlst dich vor der Kamera wohl

- Du kannst die Performance eines Videos anhand von KPIs analysieren (z. B. Engagement, Retention …)

- Du hast ein Gespür für TikTok, für Trends und für das, was Leute gern schauen

- Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und eigenständig

- Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und du sprichst fließend Englisch (unsere Teamsprache)

Nice-to-have 

- Du nutzt gern AI-Tools, die dir das Leben leichter machen – etwa um bei Ideen, Analyse oder Recherche Zeit zu sparen

- Du hast Erfahrung im Affiliate- oder Creator-Marketing

Nicht erforderlich 

- TikTok-Shop-Erfahrung. Ein Hintergrund in Content, Social Media oder E-Commerce zählt genauso.

Konditionen 

- 15–20 Stunden pro Woche, remote, flexible Zeiteinteilung

- Vergütung: Wir starten bei 16–18 EUR brutto pro Stunde, das sind rund 1.400–1.550 EUR brutto im Monat bei 20 Stunden/Woche. Wenn es gut läuft, ist Luft nach oben!

Wie wir ticken 

- Wir bauen auf der Meinung unserer Kunden auf: Customer Insights und das, was ihr Feedback uns zeigt, sind der Motor für alles, was wir erstellen

- Wir leben Ownership, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Transparenz

- Wir arbeiten als Team zusammen – und trotzdem jeder eigenständig und fokussiert

- Und das Beste: Wir arbeiten 100 % remote und sind flexibel bei den Arbeitszeiten

Was dich erwartet 

- Ownership über unseren Brand-Kanal und unserer Affiliate-Engine: Wir bauen von Grund auf neu und du prägst, wie das aussieht

- Direktes Feedback: Jede Woche siehst du, was deine Videos erreichen und was deine Arbeit bewirkt

- Ein internationales, entspanntes Team ohne komplizierte Hierarchien

You work as one of two engineers on our system, with a focus on the Python backend: data model, business logic, APIs and the integrations our operations run on. You share responsibility and cover for each other, in everyday work and during vacations.

Our stack 

- Backend: Python 3.12, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2, Alembic, PostgreSQL, on Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage)

- Portal: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, MUI, TanStack Query, generated OpenAPI client

- Apps: React Native with Expo, shipped through the app stores

- Integrations: Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Meet), Auth0, Aircall, WhatsApp and DATEV, plus payment and e-signature providers

- How we work: AI-assisted. Specifications, code and reviews are created with AI support, as our everyday standard, not as an experiment.

What you bring

- Solid Python experience in production, ideally with FastAPI and SQLAlchemy or comparable frameworks

- Confidence with relational databases and SQL, PostgreSQL in our case

- You already code with AI support as a matter of course, ideally with real enthusiasm. For us this is a requirement, because it is how we work every day.

- Fluent English. German is a plus.

- App store releases and Expo EAS

- Google Cloud, Google Workspace APIs, or experience with payment and e-signature integrations

- Experience in regulated domains such as health, care or fintech

- WebSockets and real-time features

- Freedom and responsibility from day one, flat hierarchies, no meeting marathons

title: AI Tech Lead, Remote (based in Europe)
description:
Virtusan is a Swiss based health coaching platform for sleep, stress and recovery that works with any wearable, including our own smart ring. We're hiring our first AI Tech Lead to build the intelligence behind our coach: turning biometric and behavioural signals into personalised programmes that help people sleep better and stress less. You’ll be the technical authority for AI across engineering; you make the calls on architecture and approach, set the standards others build to and stay hand-on in the code.

What you'll be doing

1) Signal interpretation: Turn wearable and in-app data into recovery, stress and sleep insights, using personal baselines and trend detection.

2) Multi-device data: Normalise metrics across vendors, weight sources by reliability, and handle missing data and device switches.

3) Recommendation engine: Personalise protocol sequences by dose and timing with classical ML (e.g. contextual bandits, sequential recommenders or RL).

4) Feedback loops: Learn from real user behaviour and biometric responses which protocols work, and for whom.

5) Evaluation: Offline metrics, online experiments and production monitoring for every model and LLM feature.

6) AI platform: Own the roadmap, training and serving pipelines, data quality and architecture on our Python and Azure stack.

7) Technical leadership: Make and own the key architecture and modelling decisions, and write them down (RFCs, ADRs etc.) so the team can build them.

8) Privacy: Make secure handling of sensitive health data part of the design from the start.

9) Collaboration: Help product, design and marketing shape AI features and understand what the models can and can't do.

Hands on: This is a builder role. You’ll be prototyping, evaluating and taking code through to production.

Requirements

- 6+ years in ML/AI engineering incl. 2+ years in a lead role, with at least one product taken from zero to production

- Python, FastAPI and production MLOps on Azure or another major cloud

- Time series, recommender systems, causal/uplift methods and strong statistics

- A/B testing, model evaluation and production monitoring

- LLMs and LangGraph (or similar) on Azure OpenAI, and knowing when not to use them

- Experience as a tech lead or staff engineer, making technical decisions that a team of engineers followed.

- Privacy-aware handling of health data

- Based in Europe and fluent in English

- Nice to have: bandits, RL or off-policy evaluation; health or wearable data; literature mining; AI in engineering workflows (coding agents, AI-assisted testing, CI).

Application process

Instead of a cover letter, please send us the answers to 2 of the following 3 questions together with your CV.

1) Tell us about an ML product you took from zero to production. What did you own, and what changed because of it?

2) You have a recommendation engine and want to know whether a protocol actually improves users' sleep. How would you measure that?

3) Tell us about a technical decision you made for a team that others disagreed with. How did you get alignment, and how did it turn out?

- Strong network or understanding of the DACH Agency Trading Desk landscape

- Fluent in German and English

- Independent, strong communicator, able to work under pressure, with strong negotiation skills

- Teamplayer and creative thinker with a questioning mindset.

title: Performance Engineer
description:
UK | Full-Time 

The Mission: Source.dev 

Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the Android Virtualization Framework , Security , and the Android Runtime (ART) .

Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation.

Source.dev was founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with SourceFS. 

The Core Product: SourceFS 

SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes.

Role Purpose 

The Senior Technology Risk Analyst is responsible for managing and continuously improving the Information Security Management System (ISMS) across Data & Technology Solutions. You will ensure that security policies, controls, risks, exceptions, and governance processes are properly maintained, evidenced, reviewed, and acted upon.

Reporting to the SVP Security and Compliance, you will provide the operational backbone for security governance across DTS. This is a hands-on Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) role. You will collaborate across security, product, engineering, infrastructure, architecture, legal, risk, compliance, and delivery teams to transform security governance into a dynamic, working management system rather than a static documentation exercise.

Key Responsibilities 

1. ISMS Ownership & Operation 

- Manage the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of the DTS ISMS.

- Maintain the ISMS framework, documentation, control library, policies, standards, and procedures.

- Ensure the ISMS accurately reflects how DTS operates across products, platforms, infrastructure, data, and engineering.

- Support alignment with frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA (where applicable), and wider WPP security requirements.

- Ensure ISMS artefacts are version-controlled, approved, reviewed, and communicated appropriately.

- Maintain clear evidence of security governance activity, control operation, risk treatment, and management reviews.

2. Policy Management & Control Governance 

- Own the lifecycle of DTS security and compliance policies, standards, procedures, and control documentation.

- Coordinate policy reviews with Security, Architecture, Infrastructure, Engineering, Product, Legal, Risk, and Enterprise Technology stakeholders.

- Ensure policies are practical, clear, enforceable, and aligned with DTS's operating reality.

- Track policy exceptions, waivers, compensating controls, and review dates.

- Ensure policy changes are communicated and seamlessly embedded into operational processes.

3. Risk Review Board Operation 

- Establish and continuously run the DTS Risk Review Board .

- Define the Board’s cadence, agenda, inputs, outputs, attendees, and escalation routes.

- Prepare comprehensive risk packs, dashboards, decision logs, and action trackers.

- Ensure risks are presented clearly, consistently, and with appropriate supporting evidence.

- Track decisions, owners, due dates, mitigations, exceptions, and residual risks.

- Escalate risks exceeding agreed thresholds to the SVP Security and Compliance, DTS leadership, the CISO office, or other appropriate forums.

4. Risk Register Management 

- Own and maintain the central DTS security and compliance risk register.

- Capture, assess, categorise, and maintain security, compliance, privacy, operational resilience, third-party, and technology risks.

- Ensure all risks have clear descriptions, owners, likelihood/impact ratings, inherent risk scores, mitigations, residual risk scores, treatment plans, and target dates.

- Partner with risk owners to ensure mitigations are realistic, funded, and actively progressed.

- Track overdue risk actions and escalate insufficient progress.

- Produce regular risk reporting for DTS leadership and wider WPP governance forums.

5. Control Assurance & Evidence Management 

- Support ongoing assurance activity by ensuring controls are consistently evidenced, tested, and reviewed.

- Maintain control evidence for ISO 27001, SOC 2, client assurance, internal audits, and other compliance needs.

- Coordinate evidence collection from Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Product, HR, Legal, and Enterprise Technology.

- Identify gaps between documented controls and actual operating practices, tracking remediation plans.

6. Compliance Support & Audit Readiness 

- Support DTS compliance obligations (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR-related controls, and client-specific requirements).

- Help prepare for internal/external audits, client reviews, security questionnaires, and due diligence exercises.

- Maintain an organized, always-ready evidence library and audit trail.

- Support management reviews required by ISO 27001 and other governance frameworks.

7. Exception, Waiver & Remediation Tracking 

- Manage the formal process for security exceptions, policy waivers, risk acceptances, and remediation plans.

- Ensure exceptions are documented, reviewed, approved, time-bound, and assigned to accountable owners.

- Track compensating controls, monitor residual risk, and manage the renewal/escalation of expired exceptions.

8. Third-Party & Supplier Risk Support 

- Help assess security and compliance risks associated with vendors, partners, tools, platforms, and managed services.

- Maintain supplier risk records and coordinate with Procurement, Legal, CISO, Enterprise Technology, and Product teams.

- Ensure third-party risk is appropriately integrated into the DTS risk register and Risk Review Board.

9. Security Governance Reporting 

- Produce clear, reliable, and actionable governance dashboards and reports for the SVP Security and Compliance and DTS leadership.

- Translate complex governance and technical data into clear business language, highlighting trends, overdue actions, and material risks.

10. Stakeholder Engagement & Culture 

- Foster a collaborative and practical security governance culture across DTS.

- Coach risk owners on how to describe, assess, treat, and monitor risks.

- Ensure risk processes support business delivery rather than becoming bureaucratic overhead.

Key Accountabilities 

The ISMS and Risk Officer will be directly accountable for:

- Effective operation, accuracy, and maintenance of the DTS Senior Technology Risk Analyst.

- Continuous, disciplined operation of the DTS Risk Review Board.

- Up-to-date, approved, and realistic security policies, standards, and control documentation.

- Structured tracking of risks, exceptions, waivers, and remediation plans.

- Audit-ready evidence management and reliable governance reporting to leadership.

Skills & Experience 

Required: 

- Proven experience in information security governance, risk management, compliance, audit, or ISMS operation .

- Strong working knowledge of ISO 27001 and practical ISMS management.

- Familiarity with SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA , cloud security, SaaS platforms, and enterprise security controls.

- Experience maintaining risk registers, policy frameworks, control libraries, and audit evidence repositories.

- Experience running or supporting risk committees, governance forums, or control review boards.

- Ability to collaborate with technical teams and translate technical issues into business risk/compliance language.

- Strong organizational skills, high attention to detail, and a constructive yet persistent approach to driving action.

Preferred:

Leadership Expectations

- Pragmatic & Delivery-Aware: Build trust with technical teams by making governance useful, proportionate, and aligned with delivery.

- Proactive: Follow through persistently on actions, dates, and evidence, and escalate bottlenecks clearly.

Success Measures

title: Senior Technical Accountant
description:
Our Story 

Hello there. We’re Zopa. 

We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com ! 

We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. 

If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

We are looking for a Senior Technical Accountant to join our growing Finance function, reporting to the Head of Technical Accounting. You’ll provide technical accounting support for ongoing business activities, new products and other initiatives, and play a key part in the Technical Accounting team’s work, from accounting policy assessments to horizon scanning, audit engagement and the annual report. Strong stakeholder management is key to this role. 

The demands on the Finance team are high as Zopa grows at pace, so you’ll need to build effective and influential relationships within Finance and the wider business. Our team are self-starting problem solvers who are agile and thrive on bringing past experiences and networks to a diverse range of challenges. You’ll be part of an impressive Zopa team, who are super collaborative and happy to roll their sleeves up and get involved in whatever needs doing to achieve their goals. 

A day in the life 

- 
Carry out technical accounting assessments for new transactions, products, significant contracts and other business initiatives, and draft clear accounting papers and memos. 

- 
Play a key part in the Technical Accounting team’s ownership of the annual report and accounts, drafting parts of the report and coordinating other sections written by teams across Finance and the wider business, and helping to bring them together into the final report. 

- 
Manage stakeholders effectively and work well with other Zopa teams, including Product, Legal, Treasury and Risk, building strong, influential relationships and giving clear, practical technical accounting advice. 

- 
Support the development, implementation and upkeep of accounting policies and the accounting manual and give practical guidance on how policies should be applied across the business. 

- 
Help put new accounting treatments into practice: make sure finance systems and processes are set up to support new activities, embed them into business-as-usual (BAU) processes and hand them over to the BAU teams. 

- 
Support the technical accounting for balance sheet activity, including SPPI testing and hedge accounting assessments and documentation under IAS 39 and IFRS 9. 

- 
Support the timely and accurate delivery of month-end reporting where needed. 

- 
Work directly with the external auditors on accounting policy and technical accounting matters, answering queries and providing evidence and papers. 

- 
Carry out horizon scanning of new and proposed legislation, regulation and accounting standards that affect financial and corporate reporting, prepare impact assessments, and highlight high-impact or high-risk changes. 

- 
Help shape and deliver our work to automate the production of the annual report, an area where this role will be fundamental. 

- 
Look for ways to use AI and automation to improve technical accounting, policy and reporting processes, and put them into practice. 

- 
Keep up to date with developments in financial and corporate reporting . 

About you: 

- 
Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or equivalent) with relevant post-qualification experience. 

- 
Experience of working in the financial services sector (ideally banking or consumer finance), or trained at a top six accountancy firm with financial services experience in a technical accounting role. 

- 
Solid working knowledge of IFRS and how it applies to financial services products and transactions. 

- 
Clear written communication, with experience of drafting technical accounting papers or memos and explaining complex accounting to non-accountants. 

- 
A questioning mindset, and the ability to drive change to systems and processes to improve efficiency. 

- 
A team player and problem solver. You’ll show great initiative to listen, analyse, research, investigate and provide solutions to problems relating to financial accounting and reporting. 

- 
Comfortable managing several pieces of work at once in a fast-moving environment, and building trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels. 

- 
Curious about AI and how you can use it in your everyday work. 

- 
Motivated, energetic and passionate about excellence and innovation. 

Bonus points for 

- 
Technical knowledge of IFRS 9 (expected credit losses, EIR), hedge accounting (IFRS 9 and IAS 39), IFRS 2 (share-based payments), and IAS 38 (intangible assets). 

- 
Experience of operational accounting. 

#LI-LK1

At Zopa we value flexible ways of working. 

We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

*Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

Diversity Statement 

Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments. 

Our approach to AI in interviews 

At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030 , we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs. 

Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process. 

Behavioural and competency-based interviews : please don't use AI . These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other. 

Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.
