title: Principal Engineer, Platform
description:
Firmus Technologies 

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific. 

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

Firmus AI Cloud 

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

ROLE SUMMARY 

Firmus Technologies is seeking a Principal Engineer, Platform to own the platform Firmus engineers build and release on, in public cloud and in our own data centres. Self-service and security come first: through one golden path, an engineer should be able to create a service, get an environment, and ship to production securely with minimal support. Everything you design must work across sites and scale to hundreds of thousands of GPUs in gigawatt-scale AI factories. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Architecture and Decisions 

- Own the architecture of the engineering platform and its multi-site management plane, in public cloud and on premises. Set a target architecture two to three years ahead and plan the steps from today's system to it. 

- Design the platform around a repeatable scaling unit. Capacity grows in identical units, a failure stays inside one unit or site, and each site meets a defined standard before it carries the platform. 

- Decide how internal Kubernetes and hypervisor clusters are built, networked, upgraded, and recovered. Keep Kubernetes conformant and close to upstream releases, with upgrades that need no downtime. New sites come up from code and the site deployment kit, and recovery is tested regularly. 

- Decide how services are packaged, released, and promoted with progressive rollout, and how a failed release is rolled back and contained across sites. 

- Lead design reviews for significant changes across the teams, sign off architecture decision records, and settle technical disputes escalated by engineers. Decide at pace with incomplete information, write down the assumptions, and revisit a decision when the evidence changes. 

Build and Evolve 

- Own engineer self-service with an API-first design. The CLI, automation, and any developer portal all use the same platform API. Treat every ticket to the platform team as a gap in self-service and close the most common ones first. 

- Keep a service catalogue in code, with an owner for every service and scorecards that show each team where its services stand against the golden path, production-readiness, and security standards. 

- Provide multi-cluster deployment for internal teams and the customer product: one pipeline to every region and data centre, the customer product isolated from internal workloads, and sites that keep running when the orchestrator is unreachable. 

- Let AI agents work on the delivery path under the same controls as engineers, with their own identity, least privilege, sandboxing, and a person approving every production change. 

Reliability, security, and cost 

- Set SLOs and error budgets for the platform and use the budget to decide when reliability work comes first. 

- Lead the technical response to major incidents in the platform and make sure every post-mortem ends with a fix that stops it happening again. 

- Set the standard every change meets before it goes live: code review, acceptance tests, builds traceable from source to deploy, and the application security team's controls in every pipeline by default. 

- Provide secrets, certificates, and single sign-on as platform services, built to the security team's identity and secrets standard, with mutual TLS between services and credentials issued from code, short-lived, and rotated automatically. 

- Build continuous compliance for SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 into the platform, with controls written as policy in code, evidence collected automatically, and drift detected and corrected. 

- Automate patching without disruption and land urgent and embargoed security fixes within defined timelines. Nodes are replaced site by site from rebuilt images, within each service's disruption limits and with automatic rollback. 

- Own cost at the design level, including cloud spend, with one shared path for every team and site. 

Technical leadership 

- Grow engineers through mentorship, design review, and code review. Hiring and performance review sit with the Engineering Manager. 

- Set how the team uses AI to build software effectively and securely, with review gates and automated architecture checks that keep AI-generated code within the agreed design. 

- Own the technical interviews and assessments for platform engineers and hold every candidate to that bar. 

Partnership and communication 

- Shape the platform roadmap with product, infrastructure, network, and site-delivery leaders, and have the platform ready before each new region or data centre goes live. 

- Agree ownership in writing at each boundary with infrastructure, network, security, software, data and observability, and settle disagreements directly. 

- Represent the platform team in customer and auditor reviews of security, reliability, and compliance. 

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

- 10+ years in platform, infrastructure, or software engineering, including at least 3 years at principal level or equivalent, setting the technical direction that multiple teams delivered against. You are still hands-on and intend to stay that way. 

- Has owned a golden path other engineers used to ship: infrastructure as code (such as Terraform or OpenTofu), CI/CD, and GitOps (such as Argo CD or Flux), with progressive rollout, rollback, artifact signing and provenance, and security gates in the pipeline. 

- Has run a platform as a product, with self-service through templates and a platform API or CLI that teams adopted, measured by adoption and delivery performance rather than uptime alone. 

- Has built, upgraded, and recovered Kubernetes on self-managed servers, including on virtualised infrastructure, as well as in a public cloud such as AWS, across more than one site. 

- Deep, practical knowledge of Kubernetes internals: the API server and etcd, scheduling, networking (such as Cilium, with mutual TLS), storage, and admission control. 

- Strong in Go or Python, with services, controllers, or tools other teams consume, not only infrastructure code. 

- Has built security into a platform: secrets management (such as Vault or OpenBao), certificate automation, short-lived credentials, and fleet patching with no visible impact on services, under SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, or an equivalent control set. 

- Has run a reliability programme other engineers followed: SLOs and error budgets, change control, and incident reviews that changed the system. 

- Clear written and verbal communication in English, able to explain problems, decisions, and trade-offs to engineers, executives, and customers. 

- Willing to join the on-call rotation for the services you own and to travel overseas occasionally. 

Location & Reporting 

- Location: we are open to offer capable candidates to be based in either Australia or Singapore 

- Report to: Senior Manager, Platform Engineering 

Employment Basis 

Full-time

Diversity 

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

description:
We’re building the next generation of employee benefits infrastructure. 

At Happl, we help global teams design, manage, and scale benefits that actually work for their people by using AI, across flex allowances, benefits, insurance, recognition, and wellbeing, all in one intelligent platform.

Happl is backed by leading investors such as YCombinator, 6Degrees Capital, Haatch, Portage , and more, known for backing leading companies such as Deel, Rippling, Airbnb, Coinbase, Dropbox , and most recently was awarded a place in the UK’s top 100 startups for 2026 .

About the role 

As Financial Controller at Happl, you’ll own the financial engine of the business — everything from the cash in the bank to the numbers our board and investors use to make decisions runs through you. You’ll run the monthly close, the full revenue cycle, the compliance calendar across two jurisdictions, and our treasury position, and you’ll decide how all of it gets built, systemised, and automated.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with a direct line to leadership. You won’t be managing a process someone else designed — you’ll be deciding what good looks like across revenue, cash, compliance, and reporting, then making it happen. You’ll work closely with the CEO, the board, our investors, and our outsourced bookkeeping, audit, and tax partners, holding all of it to a standard that matches the product we’ve built.

We’re FCA-regulated and YCombinator-backed, having raised $11m to date, and we give global employers a single place to design, deliver, and manage benefits across 160+ countries and 70+ languages — which means the finance function behind the product has to be just as sharp as the product itself. We’re entering our next phase of growth, with an ambitious revenue trajectory and an expanding international footprint, and this role sits at the centre of it.

What you’ll be doing 

- Owning the monthly close on a fixed timetable — management accounts, balance sheet integrity, accruals, prepayments, and the revenue and cost reconciliations that sit behind them

- Writing the commentary that explains what’s actually happened in the business, not just what the numbers say

- Producing the monthly investor reporting pack and the financial sections of board materials — ARR and revenue analysis, cash and runway, burn efficiency, unit economics, cohort and retention metrics, and budget versus actual

- Owning the full revenue cycle — invoicing, collections, aged debt, and revenue recognition across a multi-currency, multi-contract subscription base

- Leading the rollout of automated billing and revenue recognition tooling, moving us from manual tracking to a system that scales without adding headcount

- Managing our two legal entities — a US TopCo and a UK operating company — including statutory accounts, audit preparation, intercompany accounting, transfer pricing mechanics, and FX exposure between them

- Owning the compliance calendar end to end across both jurisdictions — UK VAT returns, corporation tax, US federal and state filings, sales tax where applicable, and payroll taxes

- Supporting our FCA regulatory reporting obligations and the financial controls that sit behind them

- Running monthly payroll across jurisdictions , pension and benefits administration, employee expenses, and the finance side of onboarding and offboarding

- Owning the cash position and treasury strategy — cash flow forecasting, working capital, FX management, and structuring how we hold company funds to earn a sensible return without taking risk we shouldn’t

- Managing our outsourced bookkeeping , accounting, and tax partners — holding them to deadlines and quality, and pulling work in-house where doing so makes us faster

- Owning the finance tech stack and having a strong opinion on it , actively replacing manual work with automation and AI-assisted workflows across reconciliations, invoice processing, variance analysis, and reporting drafts

- Leveraging AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to speed up your own work and build the systems that let finance scale without adding headcount

- Acting as the financial conscience of the business , with a direct line to the founders and a real say in how we grow

What we’re looking for 

- Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA), or qualified by experience with a track record that stands up to scrutiny

- Genuine ownership of a monthly close cycle and management reporting pack, start to finish

- Strong technical grounding in revenue recognition, accruals accounting, and balance sheet control

- Comfortable with tax and compliance across VAT, corporation tax, and payroll, ideally spanning both the UK and US

- AI-native in your approach — you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can talk specifically about what you’ve automated and what it saved you

- Exceptional attention to detail, alongside the judgement to know when precision matters and when speed does

- A clear communicator — you can explain a number to a non-finance audience without patronising them or losing them

- Ideally, SaaS or subscription business experience, particularly ARR reporting and deferred revenue, and familiarity with modern billing infrastructure like Xero or Stripe

- Comfort with SQL, Python, or low-code automation tools is a bonus, not a requirement, but it will make your life here significantly easier

What to expect 

Being Financial Controller at Happl is not a maintenance role. You’ll be building the finance function as you run it — choosing the systems, designing the controls, and deciding how billing, revenue recognition, and reporting should work as we scale into new markets and currencies. That’s not a caveat; it’s the role.

Some weeks will be genuinely rewarding — a reporting pack you built gives the board real clarity, a manual process you automated saves the team hours every month, a treasury decision you made puts real value on the table. Some will be hard — closing the books on a fixed timetable, holding partners and advisors to a deadline, and making judgement calls across two jurisdictions with incomplete information.

What you get in return is real scope. You’ll own the whole picture — revenue, cash, compliance, treasury, and reporting — across two jurisdictions and 160+ countries of operations, with a direct line to the founders and reporting that goes straight to the board and our investors. This is the foundation of a finance function that will grow with the business, and the right person grows with it.

description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We’re looking for an experienced security engineer who’s independent, excited about getting things done, and ready to hit the ground running. You'll primarily be responsible for our application security, working with our product teams to work on new systems to enhance our security posture. Our customers trust us with their money, and you’ll be at the forefront of making sure we retain that trust!

This broadly scoped role will allow you to get your hands on many different types of security projects, from direct application security to helping our infrastructure team think about security for our databases. 

As we integrate AI-powered agents into our engineering and operations workflows, you'll help define and enforce the guardrails around how we use them safely. This includes securing agentic tooling against prompt injection, excessive permissions, and data exfiltration — and building the policies and technical controls to govern AI usage across the company.

Some experience with common industry certifications like ISO-27001 and PCI-DSS would be beneficial, although you won’t be expected to run or oversee audits.

Our to-do list changes constantly, but here are some recent projects:

- Design our agentic SIEM/SecOps pipelines to evaluate and tune AI-driven triage, alerting, and response automation

- Secure our MCP integrations against prompt injection, tool misuse, and credential exposure

- Tune and maintain code security review agents tailored to Wave's codebase, threat model, and regulatory environment

- Develop internal AI governance standards covering acceptable use, data handling, and audit requirements for LLM-powered tools

- Centralise application-level login and permissions enforcement including privileged access management

- Rework our approach to secrets management with ephemeral secrets and tighter access scopes

- Security review of our public-facing APIs

- Have opinions on how to secure agentic AI systems and want to put them into practice

title: Technicien Réseaux & Télécom Itinérant (H/F)
description:
Poste : Technicien (position 2.1, coefficient 275, convention collective Syntec) · Basé en France · Interventions sur notre infrastructure, partout en France et à l'international

Vous aimez le terrain, les sites qui ne se ressemblent pas et le moment où le lien monte enfin. Chez Azurreo, vous installez, raccordez, testez et dépannez notre propre infrastructure réseaux et télécoms, celle qui fait tourner nos activités et nos plateformes à travers le monde.

Un poste de terrain, mais avec des horaires fixes du lundi au vendredi, des heures supplémentaires payées et inscrites au contrat, des frais avancés par l'entreprise, et vos habilitations financées si vous ne les avez pas encore.

Qui nous sommes

Azurreo est la branche télécommunications et technologies de Seelon Holdings, groupe d'investissement international présent sur quatre continents. Nous sommes un acteur de référence du test de performance des réseaux : notre plateforme SignalVerify mesure la qualité de service et la qualité d'expérience des réseaux dans plus de 144 pays.

Depuis plus de quinze ans, nous accompagnons opérateurs télécoms, intégrateurs, constructeurs et grandes entreprises dans le déploiement et la maintenance de leurs infrastructures en Europe, au Moyen-Orient et en Afrique : plus de 250 projets livrés dans plus de 25 pays.

Pour soutenir cette activité, Azurreo exploite et entretient son propre réseau d'infrastructures techniques en France et à l'international. C'est cette infrastructure que vous aurez en charge : celle qui permet à nos équipes et à nos plateformes de fonctionner, jour après jour, partout où nous sommes présents.

À quoi ressemble une semaine

Aucune semaine n'est identique :

- Installation. Montage d'une baie sur l'un de nos sites, raccordement, brassage, étiquetage, tests, mise en service.

- Dépannage. Une liaison qui ne monte pas depuis trois jours. Le plan de câblage ne correspond pas à l'existant. Vous cherchez, vous mesurez, vous trouvez, et vous écrivez ce que vous avez trouvé.

- Datacenter. Rack & stack, cross-connects, mise en place d'équipements actifs.

- Déploiement multi-sites. Plusieurs de nos sites dans la même semaine : bornes Wi-Fi, switches, configuration de base, comptes rendus.

- Missions à l'international. Certaines semaines vous emmènent sur nos sites hors de France.

- Journées base arrière. Préparation du matériel, gestion des stocks et de l'outillage, maintenance préventive, mise à jour des tickets. Toutes les semaines ne sont pas des semaines de route.

Ce que vous ferez

- Installation et déploiement. Installation et mise en service d'équipements télécoms et informatiques sur nos sites. Câblage, raccordement et brassage. Déploiement de routeurs, switches, bornes Wi-Fi et équipements de connectivité. Préparation du matériel avant intervention, participation aux migrations et déploiements sur nos infrastructures.

- Maintenance et support technique. Maintenance préventive et corrective de nos équipements. Diagnostic des incidents et mise en œuvre des dépannages. Remplacement et reconfiguration d'équipements défectueux. Vérification du bon fonctionnement après intervention.

- Suivi et reporting. Rédaction des comptes rendus d'intervention, mise à jour des outils de suivi et des tickets d'incidents, gestion du matériel confié, participation aux stocks et inventaires, remontée des anomalies aux équipes concernées.

- Qualité et sécurité. Respect des procédures qualité et sécurité d'Azurreo et des consignes propres à chaque site, usage approprié des équipements et outils mis à disposition.

Les technologies que vous rencontrerez

- Réseaux : TCP/IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, VPN, LAN / WAN

- Constructeurs : Cisco, Huawei, Aruba, Fortinet, Juniper

- Télécoms : fibre optique, FTTH, FTTO, RJ45, brassage, baies informatiques

- Datacenter : rack & stack, cross-connect, installation, maintenance

Vous ne maîtrisez pas tout cela ? Personne ne le maîtrise entièrement. Nous cherchons de bonnes bases techniques, de la curiosité et de la rigueur. Le reste s'apprend.

Parlons des déplacements franchement

- Les déplacements en France et à l'international font partie intégrante du poste : ce n'est pas occasionnel, c'est une exigence.

- Le rythme varie réellement selon les projets : certaines semaines sans déplacement, d'autres avec des découchés en France ou à l'étranger. Nous ne garantissons pas de rythme fixe.

- Le véhicule utilitaire est mis à disposition pour les interventions en France : ce n'est pas un véhicule de fonction et il ne rentre pas chez vous le soir.

- Les imprévus font partie du métier : matériel non livré, local fermé, câblage existant non conforme au plan.

- Il y a de la manutention, des faux plafonds et des locaux techniques exigus.

- En contrepartie : tous les frais professionnels sont pris en charge en amont, les horaires restent fixes, les heures supplémentaires sont payées, et vous ne passez pas vos journées au même bureau à faire la même chose.

Le profil que nous cherchons

Indispensable 

- Résider en France

- Permis B en cours de validité

- Disponible pour des déplacements fréquents, en France et à l'international

- Formation ou expérience dans les télécommunications, les réseaux ou les infrastructures techniques

- Connaissances en réseaux informatiques, câblage RJ45 et fibre optique

- Capacité à diagnostiquer et résoudre des incidents techniques

- Français courant, anglais niveau A2 minimum (à l'oral et pour lire de la documentation technique)

- Maîtrise des outils bureautiques courants

- Autonomie, rigueur, organisation

- Capacité à travailler en mobilité et à vous adapter à des environnements techniques variés

Apprécié, mais pas exigé 

- Anglais au-delà du niveau A2

- Expérience sur équipements Cisco, Huawei, Aruba, Fortinet ou Juniper

- Fibre optique : raccordement, soudure, mesures. Wi-Fi, datacenter

- Certifications réseau (CCNA ou équivalent) et habilitations à jour : AIPR, habilitation électrique, travail en hauteur, CACES nacelle, SST. Si vous ne les avez pas, nous organisons la formation pour que vous les obteniez.

Formation : Bac Pro SN, BTS SIO, BTS CIEL, BTS Télécommunications, BUT/DUT Réseaux & Télécommunications, Licence professionnelle Réseaux, ou expérience équivalente. Ce que vous avez fait compte autant que ce que vous avez étudié.

Ce que nous vous offrons

- Des horaires fixes du lundi au vendredi et pas d'astreinte

- Des heures supplémentaires payées, majorées et inscrites au contrat

- Des frais avancés par l'entreprise

- Vos certifications et habilitations financées si vous ne les avez pas

- Une formation continue réelle, avec accès direct aux ingénieurs de l'entreprise

- Des missions variées, en France et à l'international, sur notre propre infrastructure

- Une entreprise internationale à taille humaine

Le processus de recrutement

- Étude de votre candidature par notre équipe recrutement

- Entretien RH, en visio (30 à 40 min), avec le recrutement, sur votre parcours, vos attentes et le poste en détail

- Entretien technique (45 à 60 min) avec votre futur manager, sur la technique, le terrain et votre méthode

- Entretien final (30 min) avec Adam Anbari, gérant d'Azurreo EURL

L'embauche est conditionnée à une visite médicale d'aptitude au poste.

Comment candidater

Envoyez-nous votre CV. Pas besoin de lettre de motivation ; quelques lignes sur une intervention dont vous êtes fier (ce qu'il y avait à faire, ce qui a coincé, comment vous l'avez réglé) nous parlent davantage.

Azurreo étudie toutes les candidatures à compétences égales, sans distinction d'origine, de sexe, d'âge, de situation personnelle ou de handicap.

title: Sales Representative & Business Developer – Dutch Market
description:
Over OOOVATION

OOOVATION is een in Frankrijk geboren onderneming gespecialiseerd in het ontwerpen en vervaardigen van op maat gemaakte medailles en trofeeën voor sportevenementen, bedrijven en grote organisaties. Met een duidelijke missie om tegen 2030 de Europese marktleider in aangepaste prijzen te worden, breidt de organisatie snel uit naar internationale markten zoals Nederland. 

Wat je gaat doen

Als Sales Representative voor de Nederlandse markt ben je verantwoordelijk voor de uitbreiding en het beheer van het klantenbestand in dit specifieke segment. Je onderhoudt contacten met organisatoren van sportevenementen en bedrijven, introduceert de op maat gemaakte trofeeën en medailles, en begeleidt het volledige verkoopproces van de eerste kennismaking tot de uiteindelijke levering.

Wat de rol vraagt

Je brengt commerciële ervaring mee in een buitendienstfunctie en bezit sterke communicatieve vaardigheden om duurzame klantrelaties op te bouwen. Een resultaatgerichte aanpak en doorzettingsvermogen zijn essentieel om de Nederlandse markt verder te ontwikkelen en de groeidoelstellingen te behalen.

Voldoe je niet aan elk enkel punt, maar herken je jezelf wel in het grootste deel van de profielschets? Reageer dan alsnog. 

Voor deze functie is een uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands essentieel. Engels is eveneens belangrijk. Daarnaast is een basiskennis van het Frans een groot pluspunt, zodat we tijdens de opleidingsperiode gemakkelijk met elkaar kunnen communiceren.

De functie is niet noodzakelijk gevestigd in Yssingeaux, Frankrijk. Je start met een opleidingsperiode van één maand op ons hoofdkantoor in Frankrijk om onze producten, werkwijze en bedrijfscultuur te leren kennen. Na deze opleiding ga je rechtstreeks aan de slag op de Nederlandse markt.

We zoeken iemand met ambitie, ondernemerschap en leiderschapskwaliteiten. Ons doel is niet alleen om de Nederlandse markt verder te ontwikkelen, maar ook om daar op termijn een lokaal team op te bouwen.

We zoeken daarom een toekomstige leider die bereid is om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, een team aan te sturen en een sleutelrol te spelen in de internationale groei van OOOVATION. 

Arbeidsvoorwaarden

Je ontvangt een bedrijfstelefoon en een laptop van de zaak voor de uitvoering van je werkzaamheden.

De pensioenregeling is geregeld via een bedrijfspensioenregeling.

De regeling omvat daarnaast particuliere ziektekostenverzekering, thuiswerken en opties voor remote werken.

Salaris

Het salaris bedraagt EUR 2,500–4,500 per maand.

title: Conseiller de vente
Founding lead Product Designer
description:
Raison is on a mission to provide humans with better skills so they can feel confident and have more opportunities in the AI era. We help companies make sure 100% their teams master AI, directly in the flow of work (Teams, Slack) so that AI knowledge spreads across the organization instead of pooling in a handful of champions. 

We are passionate entrepreneurs believing that the ongoing AI revolution should be shared by all employees; and that the future of corporate interactions should not be restricted to private human-machine chats. Raison is capturing what champions create with AI, turning it into shared, governed skills, and propagating them so everyone feels capable and empowered; acting as a powerful lever to accelerate the AI transformation of corporates. 

We recently raised €2m from a top French VC + BPI and a selection of high-profile business angels who believe AI mastery is the highest-leverage application of AI inside companies.

Tasks

User Research & Discovery 

- Own field research: contextual inquiry, user interviews, and observation of how teams actually work with AI and where it breaks.

- Build and maintain a deep understanding of our core users — individual contributors, champions, managers, and corporate buyers — and the context they operate in.

- Synthesize messy field data into sharp, actionable insight: jobs-to-be-done, adoption blockers, and the conditions under which a skill transfers between people.

- Establish a continuous discovery habit so research is a foundational reflex, and champion the user's perspective in every product decision.

 

Product & Experience Design 

- What our experts do by hand today is the spec for what the product must automate tomorrow. Your job is to watch that closely enough to design it.

- Design the surfaces: the client dashboard execs present to their board, the internal console our experts use to run a dozen live communities at once, and the conversations themselves.

- Most of our product lives inside someone else's client. You are designing in Teams and Slack, not screens we control — no onboarding, no landing page, no second chance. A four-minute message to an accountant who has never opened Copilot is the hardest design problem we have.

- Work mostly on enterprise, and partly on higher education, where we also have live deployments. Two audiences, two vocabularies, one product: part of your job is deciding what stays shared and what has to differ, so we build one coherent system rather than two half-products.

- Work hand-in-hand with our AI product engineers so your field learnings ship as features, then get re-tested at the next pilot.

- Own the design system: components, tokens, patterns, and the copy that goes with them.

Requirements

- 4–8 years in product design, UX design, or a hybrid design-research role, ideally on complex, multi-user B2B products.

- A strong portfolio that shows both craft and thinking: we want to see how you operated, not just what shipped.

- A skilled researcher who can design a study, run it in the wild, and turn qualitative chaos into clear direction.

- Experience designing inside environments you don't control - a messaging client, an extension, an embedded product - or a clear appetite for it.

- Comfortable designing for AI-driven and adaptive experiences, where the interface has to handle uncertainty, personalization, and non-linear workflows.

- Excellent visual and interaction design skills: typography, spacing, motion, and the small details that build trust.

- Autonomous and opinionated, but you hold your opinions loosely when the evidence says otherwise.

- Genuine curiosity about AI and how people actually learn at work.

- Fluent in French and English, spoken and written. Spanish is a plus.

- You want the ownership, equity, and career-defining challenge that only comes from being early.

- Bonus: deeply passionate about something outside of work.

Benefits

- A founding role with equity and direct influence on company strategy.

- Competitive salary, benchmarked to the Paris startup ecosystem.

- Flexibility: remote-friendly with regular in-person collaboration in Paris and an office in Montmartre with a beautiful Sacré-Coeur view.

- A front-row seat to one of the most important shifts in how humans learn.

- A small, sharp team that ships fast and trusts each other to figure things out.

- If you care deeply about making powerful tools feel human and want to shape a product from the very beginning, this is your role. Apply now and help us build the future of learning.

- Raison is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team.

title: Ingénieur Sécurité des Procédés - Process Safety Engineer (H/F)
description:
📜 Contexte 

Dans le cadre du renforcement de l'équipe Sécurité des Procédés d'un site industriel situé à Genève, Suisse , nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés (H/F) afin de contribuer à la maîtrise des risques liés aux procédés chimiques et à la sécurité des opérations industrielles.

Rattaché(e) au Département HSE / Sécurité des Procédés , vous évoluerez dans un environnement industriel exigeant et apporterez un support technique aux équipes de Production, de Maintenance et d'Ingénierie.

Votre rôle sera axé sur la prévention des accidents majeurs, la conformité aux standards et réglementations applicables, ainsi que l'amélioration continue de la performance sécurité des procédés du site.

📌 Votre rôle 

En tant qu' Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés , vous interviendrez comme expert(e) technique sur l'ensemble des sujets liés à la sécurité des procédés.

Vous contribuerez à l'identification, à l'évaluation et à la maîtrise des risques procédés sur les installations existantes, les modifications techniques et les nouveaux projets.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes EHS, Ingénierie, Production et Maintenance , ainsi qu'avec des interlocuteurs externes et les autorités locales lorsque nécessaire.

Vos missions

🎯 Responsabilités 

🔹 Analyse des risques procédés 
• Réaliser et mettre à jour les analyses de risques procédés, notamment les études HAZOP, What-If et LOPA .
• Identifier les scénarios de risques potentiels et recommander les mesures de prévention et de protection adaptées.
• Contribuer aux études de sécurité des installations existantes et des nouveaux projets.

🔹 Sécurité thermique & analyse technique 
• Interpréter les résultats d'essais de sécurité thermique tels que DSC, C80 et RC1 .
• Identifier des solutions concrètes pour maîtriser les risques liés aux réactions chimiques et aux procédés industriels.
• Analyser des données techniques complexes et formuler des recommandations claires.

🔹 Ingénierie & projets industriels 
• Participer aux revues de conception des équipements et des installations industrielles.
• Contribuer aux projets d'investissement et aux modifications d'installations sous l'angle de la sécurité des procédés.
• Veiller à la prise en compte des exigences de sécurité tout au long de la conception.

🔹 Gestion du changement & conformité 
• Participer aux processus de gestion du changement (MOC) .
• Évaluer l'impact sécurité procédés des modifications techniques et vérifier leur conformité aux exigences applicables.
• Soutenir la mise en œuvre et le suivi des standards de sécurité des procédés conformément à la politique EHS de l'entreprise.

🔹 Support aux opérations & à la maintenance 
• Apporter un support technique aux équipes d'exploitation et de maintenance sur les sujets de sécurité des procédés.
• Apporter votre expertise sur des thématiques telles que l'inertage, les pressions, les températures et les compatibilités chimiques .
• Accompagner les équipes dans la mise en œuvre des bonnes pratiques de sécurité des procédés.

🔹 Audits, réglementation & études de sécurité 
• Participer aux audits et inspections de conformité réglementaire.
• Contribuer aux analyses quantitatives des risques (QRA) , aux études de protection contre les explosions et aux autres évaluations de sécurité.
• Veiller au respect des standards et réglementations applicables en matière de sécurité des procédés.

🔹 Formation & sensibilisation 
• Former et sensibiliser le personnel aux principes et bonnes pratiques de sécurité des procédés.
• Promouvoir une culture forte de la sécurité des procédés sur le site.
• Communiquer les exigences réglementaires et techniques aux interlocuteurs concernés.

Vos compétences

💼 Votre profil 

• Diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master en génie chimique, chimie ou domaine équivalent .
• Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en sécurité des procédés dans un environnement industriel chimique ou pharmaceutique.
• Expérience confirmée dans la réalisation d'études de sécurité des procédés.
• Maîtrise des méthodologies HAZOP, LOPA, SIL et ATEX .
• Bonne connaissance des standards internationaux de sécurité des procédés tels que API, CCPS, IEC 61511 et SEVESO .
• Capacité à lire et interpréter des P&ID, schémas de procédé et spécifications d'équipements .
• Fortes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec l'aptitude à synthétiser des informations techniques complexes.
• Excellentes qualités de communication et capacités pédagogiques.
• Esprit d'équipe, proactivité et autonomie.
• Français courant et bon anglais technique , notamment pour la lecture et la rédaction de documents HSE internationaux.

Avantages

🏆 Conditions du poste 

• 📍 Lieu : Genève, Suisse 
• 🕒 Taux d'activité : 100 % 
• 📅 Date de démarrage : flexible

title: Control & Flight Test Engineer
description:

You want to work at the frontier of high-performance autonomous systems?

Join us at CDDS to bring next-generation of control, state-estimation and computer cision algorithms into high-speed kinetic interceptor drones. 

CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones (Mavics, FPV racers and fast fixed wings). Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while effectively countering unauthorized or threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments.

Tasks

Your Mission

We are looking for an exceptional Control & Flight Test Engineer to drive the control, vision, hardware and operational stack of our interceptor drone platform to the next level. You will test, tune and develop state-estimation, control and vision algorithms that directly determine successful target interception. You will act as the eyes and ears of the R&D team on customer demos and field tests abroad. You will gain a big insights in all our systems as you have to make sure that they are working such that it can be deployed to a user.

You will work closely with all teams, meaning control, vison, software and hardware experts — ensuring your and the teams algorithms translate directly into field performance.

Core Responsibilities 

- Designing and validate low-latency guidance and control strategies

- Help to push our multi-sensor fusion algorithms for state estimation

- Verify and test new computer vision approaches

- Test and Validate Low-Level Control Software and Hardware Changes

- Raise risks and issues you see on the field to the R&D team

Your Profile 

- PhD or MSc in Robotics, Control Engineering, Electrical Engineering or similar field with strong academic record (from ETH Zürich or equivalent)

- Strong analytical mindset with the ability to derive, evaluate, and validate a complex system

- Good understanding of classical & optimal control, Kalman filtering, state estimation, and linear algebra (rotations and transformations in SE(3))

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Why we do what we do

The mind is our window to the world. It can paint everything outside in grey or in bright colors. Whoever finds access to that window can change their perspective every day, and psychological hurdles can become chances to grow. Happiness spreads from one person to the next and across a whole society, like a quiet revolution, one mind at a time.

Who we are

Our mission inspires us and challenges us. Our skills, thoughts and ideas go into a product that reaches thousands of people, and that brings responsibility with it. The work asks for passion, integrity and the courage to try things no one has tried before.

A team full of people who are crazy enough to think they can change the world they live in. Yes, we are a hardworking team, but not for us alone, not for money or personal fame, but for the people we serve at the center of our efforts: Our team, clients, psychologists on our platform and supporters across the country.

Why this role exists

Aepsy serves three audiences, each with its own timeline. Clients need support now. Psychologists are building their practice. Employers are deciding whether to unlock access for their whole team.

This role leads performance marketing for all three: how people find Aepsy, what actually works, and what the numbers suggest we do next.

Marketing at Aepsy is a small, focused team, and every role has a clear place in it. The Creative Marketing Lead owns copy and shapes the campaigns. The Art Director builds the visual language. The Growth Performance Architect owns the measurement architecture. You work closely with all three, bringing campaigns to the right people through the right channels, finding out what worked, and helping the team decide what to keep, change or stop.

Performance with principles

Our values shape how we advertise. Privacy is non-negotiable. Anyone visiting a mental health platform deserves the highest level of privacy and data security. That means no urgency or fear in our messages, no before-and-after claims, and no targeting or retargeting based on health data or other sensitive personal information.

Sometimes this makes a number harder to reach. It also builds trust that lasts, and that trust is why people choose Aepsy. If strong performance combined with strong principles sounds like the challenge you’ve been looking for, we’d love to hear from you.

What you’ll do

- Own performance across all funnels. Clients may decide within days. Employers take longer and involve several people. Together with the colleagues closest to each audience, you define what success means for each one.

- Run paid media end to end on Meta, Google, TikTok and LinkedIn. That covers structure, bidding, audiences, creative rotation, and both awareness and conversion, plus the judgement to know which of the two you’re working on.

- Read the numbers and get more out of them. The Growth Performance Architect builds the measurement setup with you. You turn it into insights the team can act on.

- Turn patterns into decisions. Why do people who considered Aepsy drop off before deciding? Does the response to a creative suggest it should run weekly rather than monthly? Answering questions like these is the core of the role.

- Shape how people find support. Search is changing fast, and new ways of discovering things are emerging. You’ll help decide how people find Aepsy when they need it most.

- Help build the team’s marketing rhythm. You’ll set up the flow for campaigns, newsletters and more, from first idea to delivery, so the whole team can rely on it.

What you bring

- Three to four years in performance marketing, including campaigns you’ve run end to end and at least one that didn’t go as planned and taught you something.

- A data-driven mindset with a real feel for brand and content.

- Confidence running Meta and Google on your own, and experience with TikTok or LinkedIn for reaching HR leads and psychologists. Bring the channels you’ve found work best.

- Judgement that weighs data together with values. The field is sensitive, Switzerland is a small multilingual market, and the mission matters.

- Fluent (Swiss) German and English. Aepsy works in four languages, German is the largest market, and most partners and HR leads communicate in German.

- A habit of noticing a step that repeats and improving it, using AI in your daily work.

Strongly preferred

- SEO and GEO basics, and curiosity about how AI search engines choose which sources to cite.

- Lifecycle marketing experience: segmentation, triggers and deliverability.

- Experience at an organisation with strong convictions, and enjoyment of doing great work within clear principles.

What we offer

- Work that matters. Every campaign you improve helps someone find support a little sooner. Your skills serve something bigger than a conversion rate.

- A team that has your back. The Creative Marketing Lead, Art Director, Growth Performance Architect and Head of Marketing are each strong in their field. You’ll never have to face a number alone.

- A strong foundation. You’ll build on a product people trust, a network of qualified psychologists, partnerships with employers and insurers, and values clear enough to make hard decisions easier.

- Room to shape things. There are three audiences, several funnels, a content area being rebuilt, and a search landscape that AI is changing. Your ideas will have impact, and you’ll see it.

- A short line to decisions. You’ll report directly to the Head of Marketing and have access to leadership strategy.

- Modern tools , including AI, and the freedom to use them well.

- Time to recharge : five weeks of holiday and a mental health benefit (of course).

Together with us

We’re a young, ambitious team with diverse backgrounds and beliefs. We love conversations about the big picture and about the small details. We believe in what we do and work hard for a slightly better world. We’re also friends, parents, partners, stand-up comedians, yoga beginners and Zen monks who enjoy life.

Sleep on it. Read it again. Then take a deep breath and send us:

- Your CV and a personal cover letter . We read every letter carefully, so tell us what motivates you, why this mission matters to you, and why this role, right now.

- Whatever shows your thinking best . A short note is enough. One campaign you can explain well is worth more than a full portfolio.

In our conversation we’ll be curious about two things: a number that proved you wrong, and something you decided to stop doing.

PS: Please skip the generic, AI-generated cover letter. A few honest lines in your own words mean much more to us. The time you save is better spent in the sun, on a walk in the forest or with a friend. Life is too beautiful for impersonal cover letters :)

title: Manufacturing Engineer - Industrialization & Production
description:
Sunflower Labs is an internationally operating company providing a fully autonomous, AI-powered drone security system built to protect commercial, industrial, and residential properties. Security that flies ahead of every threat.

About the Role 

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Manufacturing Engineer to join our Manufacturing team and act as the technical bridge between R&D and Production.

You will take ownership of released product data and turn it into stable, documented, and efficient production processes. This includes DFM/DFA review, production readiness, assembly instructions and SOPs, tooling and test-process support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

We are seeking you, a professional with a strong foundation in manufacturing electronic or electromechanical products, hands-on technical troubleshooting, and practical programming or scripting used in production or test environments. Experience with robotics, autonomous systems, or similarly complex hardware is a plus.

Your Responsibilities

R&D to Production / Industrialization : 

- Own the transfer of released products, revisions, BOMs, drawings, specifications, and technical data from R&D into production.

- Perform DFM/DFA reviews and identify issues affecting manufacturability, assembly, testing, quality, cost, or cycle time.

- Provide structured manufacturing feedback to mechanical and electrical teams.

- Define production readiness and ensure engineering changes are correctly implemented on the production floor.

- Support New Product Introduction (NPI) and transition prototypes into repeatable production.

Production Documentation & Daily Support : 

- Create, approve, and continuously maintain assembly instructions, SOPs, test instructions, inspection instructions, and rework procedures.

- Ensure production documentation always matches the latest released product revision.

- Provide day-to-day technical support to technicians and remove process or tooling-related production blockers.

- Troubleshoot assembly, test, fixture, tooling, and configuration issues and drive root-cause resolution.

- Work with R&D when production issues require design, software, test, or documentation changes.

Tooling, Lean & Continuous Improvement : 

- Develop, improve, and maintain production fixtures, jigs, test setups, tools, and supporting scripts.

- Improve assembly sequence, workstation layout, standard work, material flow, and production methods.

- Reduce rework, waiting time, manual workarounds, process variation, and cycle time.

- Apply Lean Manufacturing principles such as 5S, standard work, visual management, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

- Several years of hands-on experience in manufacturing engineering, production engineering, industrialization, NPI, or a similar role.

- Practical experience manufacturing and troubleshooting electronic or electromechanical products.

- Strong understanding of assembly processes, production tooling, fixtures, testing, and manufacturing documentation.

- Ability to independently review drawings, tolerances, BOMs, specifications, and released engineering data.

- Practical knowledge of DFM/DFA, root-cause analysis, and structured problem solving.

- Programming or scripting skills sufficient to understand, modify, and debug production or test tools; Python or similar is a strong fit.

- Experience creating and maintaining assembly instructions, SOPs, and controlled production documentation.

- Ability to work independently across R&D and Production and take ownership of manufacturing readiness.

- Good spoken and written English.

- EU/EFTA citizenship or a valid Swiss work permit.

Nice to have : 

- Experience with robotics, drones, aerospace, automotive, or other complex hardware products.

- Experience with both mechanical and electrical assemblies and production test systems.

- Experience designing production fixtures, jigs, or test equipment.

- Experience with FMEA, 8D, 5 Why, Lean, 5S, or Kaizen.

- Experience with ERP/MRP or PLM systems such as Odoo, Aligni, or similar tools.

- Basic German.

Benefits

- Flexibility to work from home when tasks allow, without fixed weekly work-from-home days.

- Comprehensive training on products and production procedures.

- Hands-on experience with advanced drone and robotics technology.

- On-site parking, occasional team lunches, and team events.

We are looking forward to receiving your detailed CV together with cover letter and certificates.

3. Realtime monitoring & bottleneck-analyse voor Thinkwise-applicaties (Engineering) 
Verschillende kernapplicaties draaien op het low-code platform Thinkwise. Als gebruikers traagheid melden, kost het nu weken om de oorzaak te vinden. In deze opdracht bouw je monitoring die de performance over de hele stack realtime inzichtelijk maakt: van UI en applicatielaag tot database en netwerk. Die performance komt live op een scherm op de werkvloer van onze developers. Daarnaast ontwikkel je rapportage- en analysetooling waarmee developers bottlenecks precies kunnen aanwijzen en oplossen waar ze ontstaan. Zo vinden we problemen in uren in plaats van weken.

Onze Servicedesk en het S&AM-team krijgen veel meldingen binnen in Jira. Terugkerende problemen worden nog te weinig bij de bron opgelost. In deze opdracht breng je de ITSM-processen in kaart en leg je ze vast: processtromen, werkinstructies en rollen. Je toetst ze aan good practices zoals ITIL. Daarna ontwerp en implementeer je problem management als een vast proces, zodat terugkerende issues structureel verdwijnen.
Past bij: Business IT & Management, IT Service Management of verwant. 

5. Datagedreven leadgeneratie met FleetCareXL & BAS World (Product) 
Via FleetCareXL weten we precies hoe voertuigen onderhouden worden en wat dat kost. De verkoophistorie van BAS World vertelt ons veel over restwaardes. In deze opdracht combineer je deze twee databronnen in een proof of concept. Die berekent het ideale vervangmoment: wanneer onderhoudskosten gaan stijgen terwijl de restwaarde nog hoog is. Dat levert kostenbesparing op voor klanten en leads voor in- en verkoop. De opdracht kan ook andersom worden ingevuld. Dan onderzoek je hoe we FleetGuide selfservice of fullservice actief kunnen aanbieden aan klanten van BAS World.
Past bij: Data Science, Business Analytics, Software Engineering, met commerciële interesse. 

Kortom: veel verantwoordelijkheid, veel samenwerking en een opdracht met echte impact.

We zijn actief sinds 1962. Sindsdien vestigden wij onze naam als een betrouwbare kracht in de Automotive. Als familiebedrijf zijn wij wereldwijd actief in kopen, onderhouden en verkopen van vrachtwagens, trekkers, trailers, bouwmachines, bedrijfswagens en landbouwmachines.

We are growing rapidly and constantly expanding our global contactless payment ecosystem. To support this momentum, we are looking for a proactive Embedded Software Engineer to take ownership of designing, developing, and implementing software for our state-of-the-art payment terminals.

In this role, you will be the driving force behind turning business needs into reality, starting by translating requirements into clear, functional designs. You will work closely with our hardware engineers and the broader technical team to build the platforms that power millions of transactions worldwide. This is an exceptional opportunity for a creative engineer who enjoys solving complex hardware-software integration challenges and wants to continuously develop their skills in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Responsibilities 

- Design, develop, and implement high-quality embedded software and drivers for our cutting-edge payment terminals across various platforms. 

- Translate customer and business requirements into robust functional designs. 

- Set up and maintain the development and build environments, ensuring a smooth and efficient engineering workflow. 

- Evaluate and implement new development tooling to continuously improve our software engineering processes. 

- Collaborate closely with hardware developers to build scalable platforms, skillfully troubleshooting and resolving any technical issues that arise during integration. 

- Review and assess code, ensuring high quality standards are met, including evaluating deliverables from external subcontractors. 

- Continuously challenge yourself to acquire new knowledge, explore new technologies, and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement. 

About Payter 

At Payter, we are innovators, pioneers, and leaders in the dynamic realm of unattended/self-service contactless and cashless payment technology in a wide range of markets such as Electrical Vehicle Charging, Transportation, Retail, Hospitality, Vending, Charity, Parking, and beyond. The adaptable Payter platform accommodates a diverse range of payment technologies (NFC, EMV, ApplePay, GooglePay, etc.), international banking processes, closed-loop payment and loyalty schemes, and telemetry. 

Through continuous innovation and in-house development, we redefine how vendors connect with their customers, empowering them to boost revenue, enhance user experiences, and access real-time sales and performance data. We support a broad range of technologies, from Contact & Contactless EMV, Mifare, WiFi, 5G, Bluetooth, Touch Screens and more. Our state-of-the-art products have an extremely long service life, are of high quality, compliant with multiple international standards, boast great design, are user-friendly for all, multifunctional, and easy to integrate. 

Examples of successful collaborations include: 

- EV Charging: Fastned, Shell, BP, Ionity, Alfen, EVBOX 

- Cashless Charity Donations: Hartstichting, WWF, Save the Children, Royal British Legion 

- Food & Drink Vending: Coca Cola, Lavazza, Starbucks, Jacobs Douwe Egberts, Costa, Heineken, Maas International, Franke, WMF, Wurlitzer, Selecta 

- Hospitality & Public Locations: Compass Group, Sodexo, Albron, TU Delft, TU Eindhoven 

- Gaming & Entertainment: Pinball, Slot Machines, Gaming Arcades, Efteling 

- You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field. 

- You have strong, proven knowledge of C and Android (this is required), while knowledge of Java is a strong plus. 

- You possess solid knowledge and hands-on experience developing embedded applications and drivers across various platforms. 

- You have extensive experience in platform development, working seamlessly alongside hardware engineers. 

- You are skilled in version control and release management practices. 

- You are highly independent, proactive, and consistently bring new, creative ideas to the table. 

- You are capable of conducting thorough code reviews, including those of third-party vendors or subcontractors. 

- You ideally have knowledge of GPRS, contactless applications, or mobile phone applications (this is a nice-to-have). 

What We Offer 

- A challenging role with highly varied work in a successful, young, and fast-growing international organization. 

- 25 vacation days + 12 balance days per year for an optimal work-life balance. 

- Attractive pension scheme with just 3.6% employee contribution, we cover the rest. 

- Enjoy complimentary lunch at the office every day. 

- A flexible hybrid working environment.

title: Junior Data Consultant
description:
Onze Missie 

LOGEX is koploper in data-analyse in de gezondheidzorg. Wij zetten complexe zorgdata om in heldere inzichten waarmee zorgorganisaties grip krijgen op kosten, betere behandelresultaten realiseren en sturen op waardegedreven zorg. Onze oplossingen worden dagelijks gebruikt door meer dan 80 zorginstellingen, zowel publiek als privaat, en maken het verschil in de gezondheidszorg van morgen.

Jouw impact en verantwoordelijkheden 

- Je verhoogt de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening door het valideren van financiële en zorginhoudelijke data. 

- Je communiceert met klanten over hun data-aanlevering en de oplevering van LOGEX modellen. 

- Je ontwikkelt je in de breedte en biedt ondersteuning aan meerdere teams en klanten als er vragen liggen met betrekking tot de kwaliteit van data. 

- Je signaleert en realiseert kansen om interne operationele processen te verbeteren. 

- Je draagt bij aan automatisering van onze operationele processen, mogelijk door inzet van AI. 

Team 

Je maakt deel uit van het Financial Analytics Service team, dat momenteel bestaat uit 40 mensen met diverse achtergronden in de gezondheidszorg en data-analyse. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor het implementeren en onderhouden van onze oplossingen en benchmarks, die zowel medische specialisten als de planning- en controleteams in ziekenhuizen ondersteunen. Onze oplossingen helpen ziekenhuizen en medische specialisten bij maandelijkse rapportages over prognoses, het aanpakken van capaciteitsvraagstukken, portefeuillebeslissingen, het verbeteren van patiëntenzorgpaden en andere belangrijke strategische keuzes. 

Jouw profiel 

- Relevante werkervaring: Je hebt 0–2 jaar werkervaring en affiniteit met de financiële sector en/of de gezondheidszorg. 

- Een HBO- of WO-opleiding afgerond, bij voorkeur met een focus op gezondheid, data of economie. 

- Data-affiniteit: Je hebt interesse in data. Je werkt nauwkeurig, signaleert trends en spoort fouten of afwijkingen op. 

- Communicatie: Je kunt effectief communiceren met diverse teamleden en interne stakeholders. 

- Je bent resultaatgericht, werkt gestructureerd en hebt een pragmatische instelling. 

- Bereidheid om te leren en aan te passen aan innovatieve technologieën, tools en processen. 

- Een proactieve benadering om nieuwe taken op te pakken en kansen te zoeken om bij te dragen. 

- Je krijgt energie van het verbeteren van werkprocessen. 

- Taalvaardigheden: Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. 

Wat wij bieden: 

Bij LOGEX hebben we één superkracht: data-analyse. Wij kiezen ervoor deze superkracht in te zetten om de huidige problemen in de gezondheidszorg aan te pakken door gegevens te vertalen naar betere zorg. 

- Een uitstekend beloningspakket (salaris, vakantiegeld, NS Business card, telefoon- en internetvergoeding) 

- 25 vakantiedagen (op fulltime basis) om nieuwe energie op te doen, met de mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen 

- Een informele werkomgeving met gedreven collega’s 

- De mogelijkheid tot hybride werken 

- Een laptop en alles wat je nodig hebt om thuis een comfortabele en ergonomische werkplek in te richten 

- Persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling via onze LOGEX Academy 

- Toegang tot onze partner op het gebied van mentale gezondheid; OpenUp 

- Regelmatig borrels na het werk en nog veel meer evenementen 

- €240 jaarlijkse health benefit

- Mogelijkheid om een elektrische fiets te leasen via het fietsplan.

Klaar om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van de zorg? 

Je kunt solliciteren via onderstaande knop en je CV uploaden. Voor meer informatie, of als je vragen hebt, kun je contact opnemen met Wesley Schreuder op 

Ons bedrijf zet zich in voor het creëren van een werkplek die gelijkheid, diversiteit en inclusie bevordert. Wij geloven dat een diverse workforce essentieel is voor ons succes. Terwijl we blijven streven naar een werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt – ongeacht ras, gender, seksuele geaardheid, leeftijd, religie of andere kenmerken – moedigen wij iedereen aan om te solliciteren.

title: Medior Web & Mobile Full Stack Developer
description:
The mission 
Help build fair, engaged and high-performing teams.
We believe everyone deserves a fair opportunity to develop and be rewarded for the value they bring. That’s why we build software that helps organizations set clear expectations, define what a role entails, assess performance fairly, support employee growth, and make compensation transparent and explainable. From clear roles to fair rewards, all within one continuous process. Will you join us in driving this change?

Please note: for this role, it’s important that you already live in the Netherlands and are able to work from our Utrecht office at least three days a week.

The opportunity 
As our new Medior Web & Mobile Full Stack Developer, you’ll help build and improve our SaaS platform across all surfaces: mobile, web and backend. You’ll work on our React Native mobile app as we scale it into a fully independent experience for mobile-first markets. You’ll contribute just as actively to our web platform, from intuitive user interfaces in React to scalable APIs and backend services in Node.js .

Your average week in Utrecht:

- Building and shipping new features in our React Native mobile app (around 50% of your time)

- Building and shipping new features on our web platform, with React on the frontend and Node.js on the backend (around 50% of your time)

- Shaping features together with product and design to improve the user experience

- Working in structured weekly sprints with your team

- Writing clean, scalable and maintainable code in TypeScript, React, React Native, Node.js and MongoDB

- Building and improving performant, secure REST APIs

- Contributing to technical discussions and architecture decisions, including our mobile strategy

- Reviewing pull requests to keep quality high

- Improving developer workflows, CI/CD and automated testing

- Owning features from idea to deployment, across mobile and web

In short: your work directly makes our platform faster, smarter and more scalable, helping our customers grow and pushing Learned to the next level 🌱

The team 
You’ll join a development team of 6 developers in Utrecht, working closely with 11 colleagues in Sri Lanka through a buddy system that keeps lines short. The team is led by Alex, our CTO. We’re an international company of 55 people (7+ nationalities) serving 350+ customers, increasingly at enterprise level. With the EU Pay Transparency Directive coming up, demand for our product is growing fast, and so is our roadmap.

Your growth 

- A clear growth path towards a Senior Full Stack Developer role

- Learning every day from experienced, senior colleagues across mobile, web and backend

- Hands-on experience building AI features into a product used by hundreds of companies

- A personal development budget of €1,000 per year

- An open feedback culture: we practice what we preach

The musts 

- You already live in the Netherlands and can work from our Utrecht office at least 3 days a week

- Around 3+ years of experience as a Full Stack Developer

- At least 1 year of experience building production apps in React Native

- Solid experience with TypeScript, React and Node.js (or comparable stacks), including REST APIs

- Experience building or integrating AI features in a product (e.g. LLM features, agents or retrieval)

- You enjoy switching between mobile, frontend and backend, and owning features end-to-end

- You communicate clearly and confidently in English

- You’re proactive, take ownership and love learning together through feedback

The nice-to-haves 

- Experience with MongoDB or similar databases

- Experience with CI/CD, automated testing and cloud infrastructure

- Experience publishing apps to the App Store and Google Play

- Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally HR tech

The benefits 

- A salary between €4,000 and €5,500 gross per month (based on 40 hours, depending on experience), with room to grow

- 25 vacation days (based on full-time)

- A pension plan (10%, of which we pay 50%)

- A personal development budget of €1,000 per year (based on full-time)

- A MacBook Pro and everything you need to do your job well

- Travel expense reimbursement via our mobility plan

- A hybrid setup: at least 3 days at the office, flexible beyond that

- The option to work remotely from abroad for up to 6 weeks per year

- Daily healthy lunches, Friday drinks and monthly team activities 🎉

- An ambitious, international environment where we challenge each other and celebrate wins together

Sounds good? 🙌 We’d love to hear from you. Who knows, we might be meeting each other soon.

title: Staff Software Engineer (Agentic Search) - Runtime
description:
About Nebius: 

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product 

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible.

We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role 

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to work on the runtime systems of a novel search engine tailored for agentic AI consumption.

In this role, you will focus on building low-latency, high-throughput systems that serve search queries in real time. You will work on the critical path of user-facing requests, where performance, predictability, and efficiency directly impact product quality. You will design and operate systems that handle thousands of requests per second under strict latency budgets, optimising every layer from request handling to data access and response assembly.

In this position, your responsibility will be to 

- Design, implement, and operate core runtime services for serving search queries at scale

- Build and optimise request flows, including query processing, retrieval orchestration, and response assembly under strict latency budgets

- Develop systems that maintain performance and predictability under high load

- Optimise CPU, memory, and data access patterns in performance-critical paths

- Ensure reliability, observability, and predictability across production services

- Build well-tested systems with clear responsibilities and interaction contracts, while remaining flexible as architecture evolves

- Define and implement observability primitives, including structured logs, metrics, traces, and latency breakdowns

- Monitor throughput, latency, and resource usage, and drive improvements in performance and cost efficiency

- Collaborate with indexing and ML teams to integrate retrieval and ranking components, keeping ML logic decoupled from core system internals

- Support experimentation and iteration through controlled rollouts and rigorous benchmarking

You may be a good fit if you: 

- Have 8+ years of experience as a software engineer working on production backend systems

- Have strong hands-on expertise in C++ or Rust in real-world, high-load services

- Have built and operated high-load, low-latency user-facing systems handling thousands of RPS under strict latency constraints

- Understand performance at a systems level — CPU, memory, networking, and data access

- Have operated your own code in production: deployed it, debugged incidents, and rolled back changes when necessary

- Think end-to-end about request flows rather than staying within isolated components

- Can balance correctness, latency, and development velocity, making pragmatic tradeoffs when scope or time requires

- Collaborate effectively across engineering, ML, and product teams, communicating clearly in cross-functional settings

Strong candidates may also have experience with: 

- DBMS internals (open source or SaaS) and cloud infrastructure

- High-load web applications or large-scale APIs

- Performance-critical systems such as trading platforms or real-time data pipelines

- Low-level performance tuning and hardware-level optimisation

- Open-source contributions or active involvement in the engineering community

- Competitive programming or CTF participation

- SHAD or similar advanced technical programmes

- Conference talks or technical publications

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process. 

Benefits & Perks: 

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius: 

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Cleanroom Equipment Technician

In Zoetermeer werkt ons grafeenteam aan de toekomst van de halfgeleiderindustrie, van onderzoek en ontwikkeling tot industrialisatie. Op het snijvlak van materiaalkunde en halfgeleidertechnologie ontwikkelt het team de processen om grafeen te produceren, te karakteriseren en te integreren. Die processen vormen de basis van onze geïntegreerde grafeenfotonica. Het team pioniert met nieuwe procestechnologie en schaalt die op tot productierijpe oplossingen. Zo wordt baanbrekend onderzoek omgezet in de bouwstenen van de chips van morgen.

De functie 

Black Semiconductor is op zoek naar een gemotiveerde Technicus (m/v/x) om ons team op locatie in Zoetermeer, Nederland, te versterken.

Je speelt een cruciale rol bij het waarborgen van de betrouwbare werking van alle technische systemen die onze cleanroomomgeving ondersteunen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onderhouds-, storingsanalyse- en reparatiewerkzaamheden aan voorzieningen zoals luchtbehandeling, gas-, water- en elektrische systemen. Deze functie is ideaal voor een praktisch ingestelde professional met technisch inzicht die graag zelfstandig werkt, technische uitdagingen oplost en nieuwe vaardigheden ontwikkelt in een sterk gecontroleerde en innovatieve omgeving.

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden 

- Zorgdragen voor een veilige en betrouwbare werking van cleanroomvoorzieningen, waaronder HVAC, toevoer- en afvoerlucht, gas-, water- en elektrische infrastructuur.

- Probleemoplossende instelling, sterke vaardigheden in storingsanalyse en bereidheid om te werken in een cleanroomomgeving met strikte kwaliteits- en veiligheidsnormen.

- Comfortabel met praktisch werk in cleanroom-, laboratorium- en facilitaire omgevingen, inclusief het gebruik van ladders om verhoogde gebieden te bereiken en het werken in beperkte ruimtes onder de cleanroom wanneer dat nodig is.

- In staat om fysiek veeleisende onderhouds- en installatiewerkzaamheden veilig uit te voeren, zoals het vervangen van HEPA-filters, het bedienen van afsluiters, het positioneren van gascilinders en het verplaatsen van zware vacuümpompen. Voor zware lasten worden geschikte hulpmiddelen en ondersteuning van collega’s ingezet.

Ervaring in de halfgeleiderindustrie is niet vereist. Je ontvangt de nodige training en ondersteuning om de apparatuur te leren kennen en je technische vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen.

Hoe succes eruitziet

- Technische kennis en vaardigheden continu uitbreiden , snel nieuwe systemen en technologieën eigen maken en tegelijkertijd de hoge standaarden handhaven die vereist zijn binnen een cleanroomomgeving.

Onze werkcultuur 

Mensen boven processen. Bij Black Semiconductor is flexibiliteit essentieel — wij zorgen ervoor dat werk zich aanpast aan het leven, en niet andersom. Wij leven openheid. Samenwerking en inclusiviteit vormen de hoekstenen van onze cultuur. Wij geloven in openheid en bouwen aan vertrouwen en respect. Individualiteit is onze gezamenlijke kracht, die innovatie stimuleert en ons vooruit helpt.

title: Staff Software Engineer: Applied AI
description:

Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. About the role 

Monumental are already deploying robots into the real world at scale, building beautiful, bespoke homes. Our robots are on sites across the Netherlands and the UK and will be in the US within a year. Every deployment teaches us something about our hardware; you’ll push our R&D fleet to become one ready for large-series production: you'll own taking us from tens of robots a year to hundreds, and then thousands. You'll also keep that growing fleet deployable, and making design changes yourself to improve reliability and serviceability.

Scaling a fleet means solving whatever is in the way: limited space, no clear production process, lead times we can't live with and modules that don't survive the harsh conditions of a construction site. Our robots are built from modules at every level of maturity, so expect to work with the hardware R&D team at early stages of development to validate R&D designs as fast as we can.
